By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent Danish & German is a prerequisite for this role

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

42f3cbd440c7b1b2.title: Senior Manager (w/m/d) - Finance Integration & Transformation
42f3cbd440c7b1b2.description:
Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior Manager (w/m/d) - Finance Integration & Transformation

Als Senior Manager (w/m/d) - Finance Integration übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration

  • Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme.

  • Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher.

  • Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Finance Transformation & Standardisierung

  • Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg.

  • Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.

  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.

  • Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte.

  • Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert.

  • Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.

  • Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess: 

  1. Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe.

  2. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.

 

Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!

Du möchtest den Wachstumskurs einer dynamischen Unternehmensgruppe durch anspruchsvolle M&A-Transaktionen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) - Berlin

Als Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) gestaltest Du die Buy-&-Build-Strategie der Arsipa Gruppe aktiv mit und steuerst anspruchsvolle Buy-Side-Transaktionen eigenverantwortlich von der Identifikation potenzieller Akquisitionsziele bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung für Unternehmensbewertungen, Transaktionsstrukturen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse und koordinierst interne sowie externe Stakeholder. Im engen Austausch mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie unserem Management leistest Du damit einen direkten Beitrag zum weiteren Wachstum der Arsipa Gruppe. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

Steuerung von M&A-Transaktionen

  • Buy-Side-Transaktionen steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Unternehmensbewertungen führst Du durch und entwickelst geeignete Transaktions- und Finanzierungsstrukturen.

  • Angebote und relevante Transaktionsdokumente erstellst und verhandelst Du gemeinsam mit dem M&A-Team.

  • Due-Diligence-Prozesse begleitest und koordinierst Du über die relevanten Fachbereiche hinweg.

Deal Sourcing & Akquisitionsstrategie

  • Potenzielle Akquisitionsziele identifizierst und analysierst Du mit besonderem Fokus auf den Health-, Safety- & Environment-Markt.

  • Geeignete Zielunternehmen sprichst Du proaktiv an und entwickelst bestehende Kontakte im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie weiter.

  • Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen nutzt Du, um attraktive Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu bewerten.

  • Strategische und wirtschaftliche Potenziale möglicher Akquisitionen beurteilst Du und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management vor.

Projektsteuerung & Stakeholdermanagement

  • Sämtliche am Transaktionsprozess beteiligten internen und externen Stakeholder koordinierst Du eigenständig und stellst einen strukturierten Deal-Prozess sicher.

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie CEO und CFO zusammen.

  • Externe Berater:innen steuerst Du zielgerichtet und sorgst dafür, dass die relevanten Workstreams effizient zusammenlaufen.

  • Transaktionsprozesse behältst Du hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Meilensteinen und relevanter Entscheidungsgrundlagen kontinuierlich im Blick.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

  • Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking oder einer vergleichbaren transaktionsnahen Tätigkeit bringst Du mit.

  • Nachweisliche End-to-End-Deal-Erfahrung, idealerweise auf der Buy-Side, ermöglicht Dir die eigenständige Steuerung von Transaktionen.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Projektsteuerung von Small- bis Mid-Cap-Transaktionen sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

  • Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity- bzw. Buy-&-Build-Umfeld wäre von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse im Health-, Safety-, Healthcare- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld wären ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführungen, Investor:innen und externen Transaktionsberater:innen ist wünschenswert.

  • Eine strukturierte, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke helfen Dir, komplexe Transaktionsprozesse sicher zu steuern.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Prozesse, Strukturen und Standards im M&A-Bereich gestaltest Du aktiv mit und erhältst unmittelbare Einblicke in die Umsetzung unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie - unterstützt durch Warburg Pincus.

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung im Deal-Prozess: Von Deal Sourcing und Unternehmensbewertung über Due Diligence und Transaktionsstrukturierung bis hin zur Vertragsverhandlung und zum Closing übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Schritte unserer Buy-Side-Transaktionen.

  2. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen aus dem Fachbereich M&A.

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen aus dem Fachbereich M&A und dem Management.

40a403c3f765e9ae.title: Lead 2D Artist
40a403c3f765e9ae.description:
Founded in 2012, N-iX Games is one of the biggest game development and art production vendors in Ukraine, working with leading publishers and media enterprises around the globe. The team of 240+ professionals focuses on full-cycle game development, VR solutions, and content creation for all the most popular platforms. The studio has successfully collaborated with over 100 clients, including Paradox Interactive, Supermassive Games, Netflix, Tempo Storm, Wargaming, Activision-Blizzard and many others.

We strive that the work we deliver has a certain level of excellence and are looking for like-minded, exceptional talents. As Art Lead, you will lead our creative and gifted Art Team ensuring the ultimate quality of art assets we produce. This is a great opportunity for those who want to work on exciting projects and use their artistic talent to create compelling games enjoyed by millions.

Requirements:

  • At least 5 years’ experience as a 2D artist in Game Development
  • Strong portfolio with at least 2 commercial projects unrelated to casinos and slots
  • Deep knowledge of 2D art (composition, anatomy, color theory)
  • Basic knowledge in related fields (3D modeling, animation, technical art) and the ability to combine these areas within a single project to achieve a cohesive product vision
  • Ability to develop a comprehensive and competitive art style for games
  • Ability to estimate assigned tasks in terms of people and hours
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to express thoughts clearly and concisely
  • Confidence in presenting and justifying ideas to management and clients
  • Keeping up with the latest trends in Game Art
  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English level

Good to have:

  • Experience as an Lead Artist in Game Development
  • Skills working with Unity and/or Unreal engines
  • Passion for video games

Job responsibilities:

  • Leading the estimation process of art assets and game features
  • Developing the art vision of projects, leading the creation of a visual style, design, and overall look & feel of games
  • Developing concept artwork, defining art style guidelines & processes
  • Communicating with clients to identify opportunities for improvement to ensure that the product is of the highest quality
  • Leading the art production of internal & external teams, providing detailed feedback to artists
  • Ensuring that final production art is up to expected standards of design and polish

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits
  • not applicable for freelancers

a2077cb3c3097234.title: 2D Artist
a2077cb3c3097234.description:
We are looking for a creative and skilled Middle/Senior 2D Artist to join our team working on Disney Magic Kingdoms.

As part of a cross-specialization team, you will contribute to the creation and evolution of game content from early concepts to polished in-game and promotional assets.

Your main artistic direction will be 2D generalist work, including concept art, promotional art, and casual/cartoon-style assets.

Daily power-ups

  • Create concept art for props, environments, isometric buildings, and decorative elements;
  • Design icons, currencies, and other UI assets;
  • Produce promotional artwork, including complex scenes, characters, and backgrounds;
  • Develop visual ideas from initial sketches through polished final concepts;
  • Prepare concepts and visual references for 3D production;
  • Review 3D assets and provide artistic feedback to help ensure consistency with the original concept.

Your allies

You will work closely with 3D Artists, Game Designers, UI Artists, and other members of the development team, collaborating across disciplines to bring new game content to life.

Leveling up

You will have the opportunity to work across different types of 2D art, strengthen your concept and promotional art skills, collaborate with experienced specialists, and contribute to a globally recognized Disney game.

Next mission briefing

Our recruitment process may include:

  • First interview: Recruiter interview;
  • Test: Art assessment;
  • Second interview: Art/Technical interview;
  • Final interview: Project/Team interview, if required.

Your next level

This role is a great match for an experienced 2D Artist who enjoys combining concept development, casual stylization, promotional artwork, and collaboration with 3D production within a live mobile game.

YOUR TOOLKIT

  • Strong understanding of light, value, color, and composition, with the ability to confidently apply these principles in practice;
  • Practical experience with concept art and design principles;
  • Experience working with casual and/or cartoon art styles;
  • Basic knowledge of 3D tools, at least for creating blockouts during the concept stage;
  • Ability to generate, develop, and communicate original visual ideas;
  • Strong creative and problem-solving mindset;
  • Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams;
  • Ability to organize your work and meet production deadlines;
  • Previous experience working on mobile games.

YOUR PLAYER PROFILE
  • Middle or Senior level experience as a 2D Artist / Concept Artist / 2D Generalist;
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating relevant concept art, casual/cartoon artwork, and visual design skills;
  • Advanced 3D skills would be a plus;
  • Formal education in Fine Arts, Design, or a related field would be a plus;
  • Understanding of the mobile games market, visual trends, and player expectations would be an advantage.

Loots & Perks

  • Possibility to work remotely in a global product company;
  • Competitive salary based on your experience and qualifications;
  • 21 days of paid vacation;
  • 5 days of paid sick leave;
  • National holidays as non-working days;
  • Medical insurance;
  • Access to psychologist support;
  • Parental leave;
  • Access to our educational platform with courses, training programs, and certifications;
  • Employee Referral Program;
  • Technical support and equipment.

Ready to hit start?

You will be working on Disney Magic Kingdoms a mobile tycoon game where players build and expand their own Disney theme park, unlock iconic Disney characters, complete story-driven quests, and enjoy regularly updated events and content.

To consider your application, we require a full version of your CV in English and a portfolio link.

Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an art assessment as part of the selection process.

Ready to bring your artistic vision to the Kingdom? Apply and join our team!

Ready to level up your career?

We're looking for an exceptional Game Artist & Animator to create world-class slot game experiences, from concept and illustration to animation and implementation.

You'll create stunning slot game visuals, bring them to life through animation, and help deliver polished, game-ready assets from concept to implementation. The ideal candidate is passionate about slot games, understands what makes them visually engaging, and is comfortable working across art, animation, AI-assisted workflows, and production pipelines.

Please note: Submitting a portfolio is mandatory for this application.



Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Create high-quality game art including symbols, characters, backgrounds, UI, logos, and marketing assets.
  • Create polished animations including symbols, characters, features, wins, and VFX in Spine and After Effects.
  • Use AI tools to rapidly generate concepts, mockups, references, and visual explorations.
  • Prepare and deliver game-ready assets, animation exports, sprite sheets, and localization-ready files.
  • Collaborate closely with artists, developers, designers, and producers throughout production.
  • Help improve workflows and solve technical art challenges.

Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Have 3+ years of professional experience as a Game Artist, Animator, or similar role.
  • Demonstrate strong portfolio demonstrating both illustration and animation skills.
  • Have expert knowledge of Photoshop, Spine, and After Effects.
  • Have strong understanding of animation fundamentals, especially timing, spacing, and motion appeal.
  • Have proven experience using AI tools (Midjourney, ChatGPT, Leonardo, Flux, or similar) for concept generation, ideation, visual exploration, and production workflows.
  • Have Understanding of game asset export, optimization, and production pipelines.
  • Hold strong technical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with developers.
  • Bring experience in the online Slots/iGaming industry is a strong advantage.
  • Have strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Have passion for quality, attention to detail, and ownership of your work.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Experience with technical art tasks such as sprite sheets, localization workflows, asset implementation, and workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Eastern European slot markets, player preferences, visual trends, and top-performing games.
  • Knowledge of current iGaming trends, competitors, and emerging mechanics.

Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • Creating high-quality games that reach players across global markets.
  • Ownership, accountability, and delivering results that make a real impact.
  • Creativity, craftsmanship, and maintaining exceptional artistic standards.
  • Stability, professionalism, and the benefits of being part of a large, successful company operating in a regulated market.
  • A supportive team environment where talented professionals work together to create successful games.

HOW TO APPLY?

Portfolio required. Please submit your CV together with a portfolio showcasing relevant examples of your artwork. You can include a link to your portfolio in your CV or in the "Your message to the hiring manager" section of the application form.

LOGIC LABS UNIT

Logic Labs is a globally distributed game development unit and part of the Playtech family. Our team brings together talented artists, developers, product specialists and maths experts to create high-quality slot games for players across global markets. With colleagues working across Europe and Australia, we combine creativity, technical expertise and innovative ways of working to deliver engaging and visually compelling gaming experiences. Joining Logic Labs means becoming part of a highly motivated and collaborative team where you will contribute to exciting new productions, develop your expertise and help create successful games in a supportive environment.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

23feb24f1eb09d35.title: 3D Animator
23feb24f1eb09d35.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior 3D Animator to create polished gameplay animation for characters and creatures across projects ranging from casual to AAA. The ideal candidate combines strong artistic skills with technical expertise in rigging and in-engine animation, bringing both realistic and stylized characters to life.

Responsibilities

  • Create polished gameplay animation for characters and creatures: locomotion, combat, traversal, interactions, and reactions.
  • Create and maintain production-ready rigs.
  • Implement, debug, optimize, and polish animation and runtime systems in Unreal Engine, Unity, and proprietary engines.
  • Prepare references; export, validate, and integrate animation assets.
  • Collaborate with Art, Design, Engineering, Technical Art, Audio, and Production.
  • Support cinematics, facial animation, lip-sync, and mocap when needed.
  • Define quality standards, workflows, and documentation; conduct animation reviews.
  • Mentor animators, estimate tasks, flag risks early, and support hiring, onboarding, and team growth.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in game development and experience shipping AAA games.
  • Expert Maya skills and a strong understanding of classical animation principles.
  • Experience with realistic and stylized animation, with strong gameplay feel, responsiveness, readability, and player feedback.
  • Production rigging expertise: skinning, deformation, IK/FK, constraints, and retargeting.
  • Hands-on experience with animation systems in Unreal Engine, Unity, or proprietary engines, including state machines, blend trees/spaces, animation layers, root motion, and in-place animation.
  • A strong portfolio showing artistic quality, technical expertise, and clear ownership.
  • Creative talent, attention to detail, ownership, strong communication, and effective teamwork.
  • Intermediate+ English.


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with real-time cinematics and scripted sequences.
  • Experience with facial animation, lip-sync, blendshape systems, and VO pipelines.
  • Body/facial mocap experience: solving, retargeting, cleanup, and hand-keyed polish.
  • Experience with Control Rig, procedural animation, IK, or other runtime solutions.
  • Python and MEL skills; experience developing animation tools and pipelines.
  • Animation leadership and team development experience.
  • Basic 2D animation/VFX knowledge.
  • Perforce experience.


About Us

Founded in 2004, Virtuos is one of the largest independent video game development companies. We are headquartered in Singapore with offices in Asia, Europe, and North America. Specializing in full-cycle game development and art production, we have delivered high-quality content for more than 1,500 console, PC, and mobile games. Our clients include 23 of the top 25 gaming companies worldwide.

About Our Team

Volmi - A Virtuos Studio is an outsourcing company that specializes in game development and game content creation. Over the past 9 years, we have successfully completed over a thousand different projects and have gained considerable experience in creating 2D and 3D art, as well as developing turnkey games. Since 2022, we have been a part of Virtuos, the world's leading game developer, and have become the first Virtuos studio in Eastern Europe.

In particular, we have contributed to the development of popular games such as Diablo 2: Resurrected, Metro Exodus, Sniper: Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, Smite, Paladins, Gwent: The Witcher Card Game, and Marvel Snap. Therefore our team creates high-end gaming content and games for various Mobile, PC, Console, and VR projects.

What We Offer

  • VOLMI collaborates with leading global studios and publishers, allowing you to work on diverse and innovative game projects;
  • The company provides opportunities for professional advancement, including access to training, workshops, and other learning programs, helping employees develop their skills and knowledge;
  • Clear and transparent employee growth assessment system with regular feedback for your career development;
  • As part of Virtuos, VOLMI offers access to an international network of studios, opening up opportunities to work on global projects and with teams from around the world;
  • The VOLMI environment values creativity and innovation, allowing employees to realize their ideas and participate in exciting creative processes;
  • The modern office is located in the heart of Kyiv — on Podil, one of the most atmospheric districts of the city;
  • Medical insurance;
  • Support for employees during blackouts to ensure uninterrupted work both in the office and remotely for employees outside the Kyiv region;
  • The possibility of remote work and flexible schedule on corporate equipment;
  • A transparent system for employment types and interaction with employees, as the company is a resident of Diia.City;
  • Opportunities to engage in corporate social responsibility (CSR) projects.

7c6f31b2835f6b68.title: Middle/Senior VFX/Technical Artist
7c6f31b2835f6b68.description:
N-iX Games is looking for a talented Middle/Senior VFX/Technical Artist to design, create and implement special effects for our self-developed console game made with Unreal Engine. You will be responsible for creating effects, setting up levels and lighting, and finalizing the visual style of in-game special effects and overall level look to deliver the best results. The ideal candidate should demonstrate expert creativity and strong technical and artistic skills.

Founded in 2012, N-iX Games is one of the biggest game development and art production vendors in Ukraine, working with leading publishers and media enterprises around the globe. The team of 240+ professionals focuses on full-cycle game development, VR solutions, and content creation for all the most popular platforms. The studio has successfully collaborated with over 100 clients, including Paradox Interactive, Supermassive Games, Netflix, Tempo Storm, Wargaming, Activision-Blizzard and many others.

We strive that the work we deliver has a certain level of excellence and are looking for like-minded, exceptional talents. If you are excited about the opportunity to collaborate on awesome games, both indie and AAA, and work with a cutting-edge tech stack alongside other passionate experts, we invite you to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain art pipelines in Unreal Engine 5, from asset import to in-game integration
  • Create and optimise materials, shaders, and Material Functions, balancing visual quality and performance
  • Drive the creation of special effects (VFX) using Niagara and the particle system, to achieve the best possible look for our game
  • Profile and optimise the game’s rendering performance (CPU, GPU, memory), working with tools such as Unreal Insights and the GPU Visualizer
  • Finalize the visuals on each of the 40+ in-game levels by addressing such aspects as lighting, special effects, post effects, etc.
  • Drive the creation of special effects to achieve the best possible look for our game
  • Evaluate new Unreal Engine features and propose improvements to the team’s workflows

Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Technical/VFX artist
  • A strong portfolio of work which demonstrates the ability to create high quality artwork suitable for games
  • Solid knowledge of Unreal Engine, as well as knowledge of the particle system and the creation of particles
  • In-depth knowledge of setting up lighting & scene optimization
  • Good experience with creating and utilizing custom shaders

Nice to have:

  • Intermediate knowledge of English (or higher)
  • At least one shipped commercial PC or console title
  • Experience with procedural content generation (Houdini, PCG framework)
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git) and build pipelines
  • Familiarity with sci-fi, strategy, or simulation game visuals

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits
  • not applicable for freelancers

63322ac1f4e7ea7b.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

About the Role
Alta Ares is looking for a multidisciplinary 3D & visual content artist with strong expertise in video production, photography, post-production, and 3D design.

The ideal candidate combines technical proficiency with a strong creative vision and is capable of managing the entire visual production process, from concept to final delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute professional video shoots and photography sessions.

  • Handle video editing, color grading, compositing, and post-production.

  • Create high-quality 3D assets, environments, animations, and photorealistic renders.

  • Integrate CGI, motion graphics, and visual effects into live-action content.

  • Develop visual concepts and contribute to the creative direction of projects.

  • Ensure high production standards across all visual deliverables.


Candidate Profile

  • Strong proficiency in professional camera systems, lighting, and cinematography.

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and/or DaVinci Resolve.

  • Advanced 3D expertise using Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, or equivalent software.

  • Solid understanding of 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, rendering, and animation.

  • Experience with CGI integration, compositing, and motion design.

  • Strong attention to detail, creative autonomy, and technical problem-solving skills.

Please submit your CV and a portfolio or showreel demonstrating your experience in video production, photography, and 3D creation.

Portfolio quality, technical expertise, and creative execution will be key selection criteria.

84fbc7ccf86b0f1c.title: AMI Scientist - Geometry and 3D Vision
84fbc7ccf86b0f1c.description:
About AMI

We are building a new breed of AI systems that (1) understand the real world, (2) have persistent memory, (3) can reason and plan, and (4) are controllable and safe.

We are a team of scientists and engineers building frontier world model-based AI. We combine the scientific rigor of a top-tier research institute with focus on engineering excellence and execution.

We are a global company, with offices in Paris, Montreal, New York, and Singapore. Come build the future of AI with us!

About this Role

AMI believes AI agents should predict and plan using an internal model of the world — their world model. We’re looking for new team members to advance the state-of-the-art in world modeling. We believe that video is a rich and abundant source of data reflecting how the world works, and that in general models need to be able to process continuous, high-dimensional data from a variety of sensors to: (a) understand context about the current state of the physical world, (b) make predictions about how the world will evolve, possibly as a result of actions taken, and (c) plan and adapt sequences of actions to complete complex tasks, possibly in dynamic, complex environments.

 

You will work with a team on world model research efforts, with a specific focus on 3D geometry of the real world, including::

  • Self-supervised learning methods to efficiently learn from video and other continuous, high-dimensional signals

  • New architectures that efficiently learn to predict world dynamics from video and other high-dimensional signals

  • Scalable algorithms for pre-processing and curating video data

  • Evaluations for benchmarking world model understanding, prediction, and planning

  • Efficient algorithms for model-based planning and reasoning

 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field

  • Proficiency in Python

  • Ability to design, run, and analyze experiments independently

  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, large-scale training, and accelerator-based (GPU or TPU) compute environments

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: 3D/4D reconstruction, SLAM or SfM, depth and pose estimation, point tracking.

  • Hands-on proficiency with a rendering or simulation engine (Blender, Isaac Sim, etc.), including scripted scene generation and batch rendering pipelines.

  • Demonstrated record of contributing to advanced research projects via publications and/or major model releases

  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks for world models

  • Experience releasing and maintaining open-source projects

  • Proficiency in a deep learning framework (PyTorch or JAX)

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com

Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.


Ready to level up your career?

Playtech‘s Origins Studio is looking for a proactive Senior Game Artist with excellent communication and problem-solving skills.


Your influential mission. You will...

  • Produce high-quality slot game artwork, including symbols, backgrounds, game elements, logos and marketing assets
  • Create fast, high-quality mockups to present ideas for final game designs
  • Prepare assets for animation with an understanding of the Spine workflow
  • Use AI tools to support faster turnaround times

  • Communicate with teammates through internal channels and actively give and receive feedback

  • Have extensive knowledge of 2D design tools, primarily Adobe Photoshop and relevant plugins
  • Have experience using graphic AI tools
  • Have strong control of visual styles, effects and current trends in the gaming industry
  • Have an upper-intermediate, conversational level of English
  • Work well within a team and communicate clearly and effectively
  • Can manage multiple tasks and thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Have strong problem-solving skills and a positive, collaborative approach


You'll get extra points for...

  • Good knowledge of Spine and animation workflows


Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A fun, positive and supportive team environment
  • Professional growth and opportunities to develop within the company
  • Collaboration, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
  • Employee wellbeing, stability and work-life balance
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is equally valued


HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please include a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant game art and slot game projects. You can add it in the comment section at the end of the application page, under “your message to the hiring manager”.

Innovation thrives here, with the team constantly pushing boundaries and delivering exceptional quality. The studio is responsible for some of Playtech's most popular interactive experiences and content collections. With a diverse group of expert designers located across various parts of the world, Playtech Origins Studio brings innovative and engaging digital experiences to users. The team environment is fun and positive, promoting a professional, helpful, and supportive atmosphere that encourages growth. A strong sense of belonging among team members creates an excellent place to build a career. The team also offers ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, ensuring employees can reach their full potential.


Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

a219fc2b63fe7fdb.title: Викладач з основ 3d-моделювання
a219fc2b63fe7fdb.description:
Львівська Академія СТАРТ_ІТ надає міжнародну ІТ-підготовку школярам 8 – 17 років за американськими стандартами – цьому не вчать у школі.

У нас є діти, які хочуть навчитись тому, що допоможе їм працювати. Для цього необхідні нові викладачі. Зараз у тебе є можливість вплинути на майбутнє галузі, витрачаючи на це кілька годин на тиждень.


Якщо ви професіонал і хотіли б спробувати себе в ролі ментора – вам до нашої команди вільнодумних практиків! Ми вчимо підлітків у багатьох напрямках: веб-розробка; цифровий дизайн; мобільні застосунки, інтернет речей, робототехніка, розробка ігор.


Шукаємо викладачів для проведення занять групах з основ 3d-моделювання (Blender)  - це складова 2-річних навчальних програм для учнів 6-10 класів.


Очно в офісі на локації: м.Львів, вул.Федьковича, 60А, Бізнес-центр «Технопарк».

Викладання в Академії реально суміщати з основною діяльністю, тому що заняття проводяться у суботу або неділю.


Обовʼязки

  Проводити заняття в групах 10-14 осіб згідно графіку та навчального плану.

  Видавати навчальні матеріалів та домашні завдання в електронному вигляді.

  Оцінювати досягнення учнів під час кожного заняття, надавати щомісячні відгуки про  учнів.

  Своєчасно перевіряти домашні завдання.

  Консультувати учнів – відповідати на запитання учнів дистанційно та офлайн до/після занять.


Кваліфікації

•вища або базова освіта (бажано ІТ, дизайн)

•спеціалізація Блендер. Комплексна: робота з матеріалами, освітленням, режимами моделювання, технічного плану моделювання (роботи, будинки, меблі, неорганічне). Органіка: персонажі в стилі cartoon.

•чистий меш (сітка)

•досвід роботи (комерційної розробки) - від 2-х років

49206602fdcf59b3.title: Contra: Senior 3D Designer
49206602fdcf59b3.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA
URL: http://bit.ly/3kLhMdk

About Contra Labs

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works

This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

  • Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

  • Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

  • Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

  • Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality

  • Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

  • Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

  • Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

  • Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

  • Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences

What We're Looking For

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences

  • Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence

  • Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

  • Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/contra-senior-3d-designer

9afce733d6b91115.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
9afce733d6b91115.description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

The Strategic Customer Success Account Manager at Spring Health builds and manages relationships with the company’s largest customers to ensure satisfaction, retention, and growth. This role oversees the full customer lifecycle, aligning Spring’s solutions with customer goals to drive engagement and revenue. Success is measured by accurate forecasting, achieving revenue targets, and fostering strong relationships across all levels of the customer organization. This is a remote, full time position on our team reporting to the Director of Strategic Customer Success. Occasional travel (10%) may be required for in-person events or meetings. 

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a product expert and advocate for mental health, supporting a portfolio of Spring Health’s largest and most impactful partners.

  • Own forecasting projections for revenue, renewals, and upsell opportunities across your portfolio, ensuring the delivery of accurate forecasts.

  • Identify and position upsell opportunities proactively, driving revenue growth by aligning solutions with customer goals.

  • Develop and manage positive relationships with multiple customers, consultants, and key stakeholders to build trust and ensure satisfaction.

  • Manage the entire customer lifecycle, including implementations, engagement strategies, renewals, and upsells by:

    • Developing timely, actionable account plans

    • Managing census files efficiently

    • Designing and executing member engagement communications

    • Preparing and presenting business reviews to senior HR executives

    • Delivering insightful, data-driven recommendations aligned with customer success metrics

    • Developing renewals strategy and delivering proposals/contracts

    • Managing the end-to-end deal cycle (procurement process)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to collect customer feedback and recommend process improvements across internal teams.

  • Support sales efforts by partnering on retention, upsell initiatives, and expansion opportunities as well as supporting net new business acquisition through efforts like attending finalist meetings.

  • Leverage data to drive results, using member engagement metrics and portfolio insights to adjust strategies.

What success looks like:

  • Customer Renewal and Expansion

  • Relationship with Executive Buyers

  • Gross Retention Rate (GRR)

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Net CACV Retention (NCR)

  • Product utilization and engagement

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)

  • Customer Health Score

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or healthcare management, ideally in B2B2C environments and at early-stage companies.

  • Previous experience driving forecasting, renewals, and upsell revenue.

  • Previous experience managing Fortune 100 clients and overseeing a portfolio valued at $25M or more.

  • Strong understanding of sales motions similar to farmer sales roles, emphasizing relationship building and portfolio expansion.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build trusted relationships.

  • Experience creating growth through portfolio management, upsells, and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Organized, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.

  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to thrive in fast-paced environments.

  • Ability to probe, challenge, and consult customers to align solutions with their ultimate needs.

  • High integrity and professionalism, with a passion for transforming mental healthcare.

Benefits provided by Spring Health:

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.

  • Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning

  • A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.

  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.

  • At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.

  • Access to Noom, a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. 

  • Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.

  • Access to Wellhub,  which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription

  • Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care

  • Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year.

  • $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes.

Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Our privacy policy: https://springhealth.com/privacy-policy/

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

5d560486c3f59697.title: Partnerships Associate Manager - GER
5d560486c3f59697.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in Germany. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting cosmmercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential).

  • Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest. First 6 months: ~80% outbound/cold calling to build your own pipeline; shifts toward strategic partner management as you progress.

  • Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams.

  • Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

  • First experience (1-2 years of full-time work) in business development, partnerships, finance, accounting, or Fintech

  • Academic background in business, finance, economics, or similar fields

  • Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Curious & Analytical: You’re structured in your research and bring insights into conversations.

  • Relationship— Oriented: You enjoy speaking to people, understand how to build rapport, and communicate with clarity.

  • Self-Starter: You take initiative, manage your own pipeline, and are eager to learn from every interaction.

  • Team Player: You collaborate closely with teammates and internal stakeholders to deliver joint results.

  • Growth-Driven: You’re looking to grow into a Partner Manager role over time and want to learn how to build high-impact commercial partnerships.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

fdb61ddcd2a83eb2.title: (Senior) Brand Media Manager (f/m/d)
fdb61ddcd2a83eb2.description:
ZEAL Network SE is an international group shaping the future of digital lotteries and dream-driven experiences. As Germany’s leading online lottery provider through LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a partner of Spain’s ONCE, ZEAL combines innovation, technology, and entertainment to inspire millions of customers. With ventures such as Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung and ZEAL Ventures, the company also invests in new business models and emerging e-commerce brands. Driven by a diverse team of 350+ professionals, ZEAL fosters a collaborative, ambitious culture focused on turning dreams into reality.

 

We are looking for a (Senior) Brand Media Manager (f/m/d) to drive the strategic planning and operational execution of brand media campaigns across our portfolio of brands, leveraging key channels such as TV, Connected TV (CTV), and YouTube to strengthen brand awareness, maximise reach, and support overall business growth.

 

Your tasks:

  • Planning, execution, and optimization of integrated media campaigns across various brand media channels, with a focus on digital brand media (CTV, OLV and YouTube).

  • Continuous analysis and reporting of media campaign performance, including KPIs.

  • Building and maintaining relationships with media agencies, sales houses, and other partners to optimize media buying and collaborations.

  • Identifying and evaluating new media channels and opportunities to expand reach and audience targeting.

  • Close collaboration with the creative team to ensure all media content authentically reflects the brand message and values.

  • Budget management and ensuring efficient use of funds for maximum results.

  • Conducting market and competitor analyses to stay informed about current trends and developments and to derive strategic recommendations.

  • Close collaboration with other departments such as product management, data analytics, and business functions to ensure the media strategy supports the entire customer journey.

 

What you offer us:

  • 4–5 years of relevant professional experience in brand media management, ideally with a focus on operational management of CTV and YouTube.

  • Experience in operational steering of campaigns in the Google Ads Manager and on DSPs (Trade Desk, Amazon Ads Agent)

  • Solid understanding of the German media landscape and its trends, especially in the traditional media sector.

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating campaign performance and deriving insights.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills in German and English.

  • Experience and knowledge of the media landscape in other European countries is an advantage.

  • Experience in offline media buying is an advantage.

  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment and manage several projects simultaneously.

  • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Nice-to-Haves:

    • Experienced with both Corporate and Start-up surroundings

    • Media agency background

    • Understanding of marketing channel synergies (ATL + BTL)

 

What we offer you:

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

13683ad80742385c.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

196f82cb8b0f98dd.title: Mobile Application Developer - AI Finance Agent
196f82cb8b0f98dd.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
