4e48fdca3e503448.title: Strategic Account Executive, DACH
4e48fdca3e503448.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are seeking an Strategic Account Executive to lead commercial growth across the DACH region. This role is responsible for identifying opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and building long-term relationships within the legal and professional services sector.

This position will play a key role in expanding Harvey’s presence in the DACH region, working cross-functionally to deliver tailored solutions to clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver against sales targets with a focus on sustainable growth and performance excellence.

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named accounts across DACH, driving full-funnel sales activity from prospecting through to commercial negotiation and onboarding.

  • Understand client pain points, organisational structure, and buying processes; tailor solutions that align with strategic outcomes.

  • Lead high-impact product demos and client meetings that clearly articulate Harvey’s business value and technical capabilities.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, engineering, and GTM to inform roadmap and surface client needs.

  • Develop deep, long-term relationships with legal, innovation, and executive stakeholders across the region.

  • Document learnings, iterate on messaging, and help build scalable processes to accelerate regional growth.

What You Have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, preferably with exposure to AI, legaltech, or vertical software

  • Track record of success managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical products to non-technical audiences

  • Interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology

  • Familiarity with enterprise sales practices in the DACH region

  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a collaborative approach to working cross-functionally

Additional Information for Postings

  • Location: Munich

  • Work eligibility: Must have valid German work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role

What We Offer

  • Be part of building something special as a founding member of our DACH team

  • Opportunities to work on cross-functional go-to-market initiatives, with a focus on scaling sales strategy and driving revenue growth

be9365f7f527ee93.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
be9365f7f527ee93.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.


Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? Come join us!

d2ee7d972b7093a8.title: AI Solution Engineer
d2ee7d972b7093a8.description:
Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen.

Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.

Mit wem du arbeitest

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply Enterprise Consulting. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah.

Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb.
  • Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden.
  • Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles.
  • Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures.

Was du mitbringst

  • AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war.
  • Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware.
  • Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden.
  • Du hast Berufserfahrung. Ob 1 Jahr oder 8: Mindset und Fundament zählen mehr als Jahre.
  • Erfahrung mit Google Cloud ist ein Plus.
  • Du willst jeden Tag dazulernen und kannst mit Feedback umgehen.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Keine Limits beim Werkzeug. Tokens, Hardware, Software: Du bekommst, was du für sehr gute Arbeit brauchst. Wir sehen das als Arbeitsmittel und diskutieren nicht über Budgets.
  • Kunden mit Anspruch. Konzerne und große Mittelständler, die wirklich umbauen wollen, Private-Equity-Portfolios und Startups. Strategie für Builder Companies, Software Factories und AI-Plattformen, dazu die Umsetzung mit sichtbarer Wirkung im Kundengeschäft.
  • Eigene Produkte und Ventures. Wir bauen neben dem Kundengeschäft eigene Produkte auf. Wer früh dabei ist, kann dort eine entscheidende Rolle übernehmen.
  • Büro in der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag zusammen vor Ort, mit Blick über die ganze Stadt.

Das passt nicht, wenn

  • du lieber allein im Homeoffice sitzt, als mit uns zusammen zu bauen.
  • du klare Prozesse und ein fertiges Ticket-Board erwartest.
  • du AI für einen Hype hältst.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze dazu, wie du AI in deinem Alltag nutzt. Fragen an ----- oder ----- geht's weiter

  • 30 Minuten Call
  • Ein halber Tag bei uns in der HafenCity: schnacken, essen, zusammen etwas bauen
  • Danach entscheiden wir. Ja oder nein, schnell.

c7b654ac78e7980c.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) SPS-Programmierung
c7b654ac78e7980c.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres DEA-Regler-Teams suchen wir Dich als Werkstudent:in in der SPS-Programmierung (m/w/d),

in dieser Rolle unterstützt Du unsere SPS-Programmierer bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Automatisierungslösungen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und qualitätsorientiert, trägst zur Effizienzsteigerung unserer Projekte bei und sammelst wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Umfeld.

Über ee technik gmbh

Seit über 10 Jahren entwickeln wir smarte Automatisierungslösungen für stabile Stromnetze – überwiegend Fernwirktechnik, Einspeisemanagement und EZA-/DEA-Regler Systeme. Unser Team aus Ingenieur:innen und Techniker:innen arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Energiewende und digitaler Infrastruktur. Die ee technik gmbh ist nach DIN ISO 9001 zertifiziert – Prozessklarheit, Qualität und Verlässlichkeit sind keine Versprechen, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Dein Versprechen:

„Ich trage mit Engagement zur Unterstützung unserer Automatisierungsprojekte bei: neugierig, lernbereit und zuverlässig. Ich nutze die Chance, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln, und bin bereit, mein Wissen aktiv einzubringen. Mach We are SAVVY im Web und in KI-Antworten weiter sichtbar.

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Seit 2019 begleitet We are SAVVY namhafte Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Retail, Tourismus, Lifestyle und Medizintechnik bei ihrer Kommunikation – von strategischer PR über Social Media bis hin zu Events und Markenaufbau.

2027 starten wir in unsere nächste Wachstumsphase. Dafür wollen wir unsere eigene digitale Sichtbarkeit gezielt weiter ausbauen. In deinem Praktikum arbeitest du direkt an der Auffindbarkeit und Bekanntheit von We are SAVVY. Du hilfst uns dabei, mit unseren Themen, unserer Expertise und unseren Leistungen die richtigen Menschen zu erreichen.

Dafür suchen wir Menschen mit Drive, die sich für das Web, KI und Kommunikation begeistern und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team etwas aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt uns dabei, We are SAVVY in Suchmaschinen und digitalen Medien sichtbarer zu machen.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Recherche von Keywords, Suchintentionen und Themen, die für unsere Agentur und potenzielle Auftraggeber relevant sind

  • Analyse der digitalen Sichtbarkeit der Konkurrenz und Identifikation von Potenzialen für We are SAVVY

  • Erstellung und Optimierung von Website-Texten, Blogartikeln und weiteren Inhalten für unsere eigenen Kanäle

  • Entwicklung von Themenideen und Story-Ansätzen, mit denen wir unsere Expertise in digitalen Medien platzieren können

  • Auswahl passender Medien, Plattformen, Podcasts und Branchenverzeichnisse

  • Vorbereitung von Themen-Pitches, Fachbeiträgen und individuellen Medienansprachen für We are SAVVY

  • Auswertung von Rankings, Website-Zugriffen, Veröffentlichungen und weiteren Kennzahlen

  • Ableitung konkreter Verbesserungsvorschläge und Dokumentation deiner Ergebnisse

Das bringst du mit

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen deines Studiums oder ein Jahrespraktikum zum Erwerb der (Fach-)Hochschulreife.

  • Du hast echtes Interesse an SEO, KI und der Frage, wie Inhalte und Marken online gefunden werden.

  • Du zeigst Eigeninitiative: Wenn dir etwas auffällt oder du eine Idee hast, sprichst du es an.

  • Du bist offen für direktes Feedback und setzt es in deiner Arbeit um.

Erste Erfahrungen mit Websites, Blogs, SEO, Content oder KI-Tools sind ein Plus. Du musst noch kein Profi sein. Wir erwarten aber, dass du dich aktiv einarbeitest, Fragen stellst und das Gelernte anwendest.

Das erwartet dich

  • Die Möglichkeit, die digitale Sichtbarkeit und Positionierung von We are SAVVY direkt mitzugestalten

  • Praktische Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von SEO, GEO und Digital PR

  • Die Chance, eigene Ideen umzusetzen und ihre Wirkung anhand konkreter Ergebnisse zu verfolgen

  • Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, direkte Ansprechpartner und regelmäßiges Feedback

  • Eigene Aufgaben und wachsender Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Ein kleines Team mit direktem Austausch, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und flachen Hierarchien

  • Ein modernes Büro im Herzen von Frankfurt

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach Absprache, abgestimmt auf die Vorgaben deiner Schule oder Hochschule

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools und Methoden kennenzulernen und direkt einzusetzen

  • Die Chance, die nächste Wachstumsphase von We are SAVVY aktiv mitzugestalten

So arbeiten wir

Wir sind ein kleines Team. Jede Person trägt dazu bei, dass wir vorankommen – auch im Praktikum.

Bei uns zählt, dass du mitdenkst, Initiative zeigst und Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben übernimmst. Dazu gehört auch, rechtzeitig Bescheid zu geben, wenn du Unterstützung brauchst, und bei offenen Fragen aktiv nachzuhaken.

Wir geben dir Orientierung, Feedback und den Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln. Dafür erwarten wir Motivation, Verlässlichkeit und den Anspruch, gute Arbeit abzuliefern.

Wenn du dich für digitale Sichtbarkeit begeisterst und Lust hast, dich in neue Themen reinzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Bitte sende uns:

  • die Information, ob du ein Pflichtpraktikum im Studium oder ein Jahrespraktikum suchst

About IndieKidz

IndieKidz GmbH is a Berlin-based startup building Occibo, an AI-powered platform that helps authors, illustrators, parents, and teachers create, design, and publish children's books. We are a small, international team, and we are looking for someone who can show the world what Occibo does and why it matters.

Tasks

About the role

This is an unpaid internship as a Growth marketr and markting intern. You will be the face and voice of Occibo on social media. You will plan, film, and edit short videos about the product, explain features in a way that makes people want to try them, and keep all our content channels active and consistent. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. Your ideas will go live.

What you will do

  • Plan, film, and edit short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts
  • Present Occibo on camera through product demos, tutorials, feature explainers, and behind-the-scenes content
  • Turn product features into simple, engaging stories for our audience of authors, parents, teachers, and illustrators
  • Create and schedule posts, Reels, and Stories according to a content calendar
  • Write captions, short texts, and copy for social media, newsletters, and the website
  • Maintain and organise all our content across channels so the brand stays consistent
  • Follow trends in social media and children's publishing and adapt them for Occibo
  • Track content performance and use the results to improve what we post
  • Engage with our online community and respond to comments and messages

Requirements

What you bring

  • Student or recent graduate looking for a mandatory or voluntary internship
  • Comfortable and confident speaking on camera
  • Basic video shooting and editing skills (a smartphone is enough) and familiarity with tools like CapCut, Canva, or Adobe Premiere
  • A good sense for what works on social media and for visual storytelling
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Proactive, creative, and able to work independently in a remote team
  • A portfolio, social media account, or a few sample videos you have made (personal projects count)

Benefits

What we offer

  • Real responsibility for a growing product's social media presence
  • Direct collaboration with the Founder and the team
  • A portfolio of published work you can show future employers
  • Flexible, remote working
  • Experience in a fast-moving AI startup in the creative and education space

Sound like you? Apply through this page with your CV and a link to your portfolio or a few examples of content you've made (personal projects count)

We look forward to seeing what you create!

b457e2358d6d8e8f.title: Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d)
b457e2358d6d8e8f.description:
About BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

The BMZ Group specialises in innovative, bespoke battery systems and energy storage solutions. Drawing on our technological expertise, international collaboration and a clear focus on our customers, we develop high-performance, cost-effective and sustainable solutions for the energy supply of tomorrow.

What sets us apart? We take responsibility, think entrepreneurially and are constantly evolving.

As Customer & Product Manager (CPM) (m/f/d), you will be the key internal liaison between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality and Production. You will coordinate our products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle, reconcile technical and commercial requirements, and ensure that customer requirements are translated into successful solutions through collaborative effort.

Your responsibilities

  • Centralised internal coordination of bespoke products and projects throughout the entire product life cycle – from requirements definition through development and industrialisation to series production support

  • Coordination and management of internal interfaces between Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Production and other relevant departments

  • Ensuring the cross-departmental implementation of customer requirements, taking into account technical feasibility, cost-effectiveness, quality and adherence to deadlines

  • Supporting development processes, product changes, industrialisation and the start of series production, as well as tracking agreed measures

  • Early identification and assessment of technical, economic and organisational risks, and coordination of appropriate countermeasures

  • Transparent presentation of project and product status, decision-making requirements and relevant information for Sales, segment management and the relevant specialist departments

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • A degree in engineering or industrial engineering, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years’ experience in technical project management, product management or a comparable cross-functional coordination role

  • A broad technical understanding of industrial products, ideally battery systems, including development, electronics, quality and manufacturing processes

  • In-depth knowledge of industrial product life cycles, as well as the technical and economic interrelationships between development, industrialisation and series production

Personality & Methodological Skills

  • Customer Focus: The ability to understand customer requirements conveyed by the sales team and to consistently align their internal implementation with the best possible customer solution

  • Ownership & Responsibility: A strong sense of responsibility, an entrepreneurial mindset and consistent follow-up on cross-functional tasks and results

  • Trust & Teamwork: Strong communication, facilitation and coordination skills to bring different specialist departments together constructively

  • Performance & Execution: A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach to work, with strong implementation skills and the ability to confidently manage complex technical and organisational interfaces

Your benefits

You will have access to career training, mentoring sessions, and flexible working hours. We provide a company pension plan, private pension options, a company car, a company cellphone, and a company laptop. Additional perks include employee discounts, free parking, and the option to bring pets to the workplace, along with 28 vacation days per year.

Your first months at BMZ Battery Solutions GmbH

From day one, you will coordinate internal teams to turn customer requirements into successful battery solutions. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality and Production, you will ensure smooth collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. If you combine technical understanding, ownership and a strong customer focus, we encourage you to apply.

f5ce055b18b1d517.title: Customer Operations Manager Kontoeröffnung (m/w/d)
f5ce055b18b1d517.description:
Eine Hausverwaltung sagt Ja zu Getmomo. Ab da bist du dran: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus der Zusage ein laufendes Konto wird. Du sammelst die nötigen Unterlagen, bereitest sie für unsere Partnerbanken auf, hältst den Kontakt zu allen Beteiligten und bleibst dran, bis alles startklar ist. Und weil du diesen Weg jeden Tag gehst, siehst du zuerst, wo er schneller werden kann.

Auf einen Blick

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • 42.000 bis 48.000 € brutto im Jahr

  • Hybrid: 4 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • Start: ab sofort

Das machst du bei uns

  • Kontoeröffnungen bis zum Ende bringen: Du übernimmst Hausverwaltungen nach der Zusage und begleitest jede Kontoeröffnung, bis alles startklar ist.

  • Unterlagen zusammenstellen: Du sammelst die Unterlagen, die unsere Partnerbanken für eine Kontoeröffnung brauchen, prüfst sie auf Vollständigkeit und leitest sie an die Bank weiter. Fehlt etwas, holst du es beim Kunden ein.

  • Eng mit unseren Partnerbanken zusammenarbeiten: Du bist die tägliche Ansprechperson für unsere Partnerbanken, reichst Fälle ein, klärst Rückfragen gemeinsam und behältst im Blick, dass jeder Fall zügig weiterläuft.

  • Hausverwaltungen durch den Prozess führen: Du erklärst, was als Nächstes kommt, bleibst freundlich und hartnäckig dran, auch wenn bei der Verwaltung gerade anderes brennt, und achtest darauf, dass alle den vereinbarten Weg gehen.

  • Anliegen im Bestand: Auch wenn sich bei bestehenden Kunden etwas ändert, das die Bank betrifft, etwa neue Verfügungsberechtigte, läuft das über dich.

  • Den Prozess besser machen: Jede Rückfrage ist ein Hinweis, was wir beim nächsten Mal vorher klären können. Du baust daraus mit dem Team Prüfregeln, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen, mit Salesforce, einem eigenen AI-nativen ERP, Slack und KI-Assistenten, die bei uns zum Alltag gehören.

Woran du deinen Erfolg merkst

  • Aus Zusagen werden schneller startklare Kunden.

  • Rückfragen werden seltener, weil Unterlagen beim ersten Mal vollständig sind.

  • Kein Fall geht unter, weder bei uns, noch beim Kunden, noch bei der Bank.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in BWL, Wirtschaftsrecht, bei einer Bank oder in der Immobilienwirtschaft. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung mit Kunden, egal ob aus Bank, Hausverwaltung, Kundenservice, Vertrieb oder Operations. Bankprodukte und die Abläufe einer Kontoeröffnung bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du bleibst dran: Auch beim dritten Nachfassen bist du freundlich, klar und verbindlich.

  • Du arbeitest genau. Ein fehlendes Dokument fällt dir auf, bevor es jemand anderes merkt.

  • Du behältst bei vielen offenen Fällen gleichzeitig den Überblick und weißt bei jedem, wer gerade am Zug ist.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und schaffst wiederkehrende Handarbeit mit KI und Automatisierung ab.

  • Perfektes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wie du arbeitest, ist uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Das bekommst du bei uns

  • Einen echten Einblick, wie Banking von innen funktioniert: Kontoeröffnung, Zahlungsverkehr, Zusammenarbeit mit Banken.

  • Eigene Fälle und eigene Verbesserungsprojekte ab dem ersten Monat.

  • Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch das Kontoeröffnungsteam, Mentoring und regelmäßiges Feedback.

  • Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Büro an der Oranienstraße in Kreuzberg, hybrides Arbeiten, Firmenlaptop, kostenlose Getränke und Team-Events.

Das klingt nach dir?
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bewirb dich ganz einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite.

26692921e0b5d78b.title: AML & KYC Solutions Manager - EMEA
26692921e0b5d78b.description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We’re heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

We’re looking for a motivated, self-starting and creative professional to join our Financial Crime team as a Solutions Manager for Quantexa’s Financial Services and Government solutions in EMEA.

You’ll help grow and develop our Financial Crime propositions, working across Go-To-Market, Delivery, Research and Development, and the wider Platform Product Marketing team.

The role combines close collaboration with internal stakeholders with substantial, in-depth engagement with clients and prospects.

What you'll be doing.

  • Shape FinCrime Strategy & Solutions: Leverage your deep domain knowledge to guide the development and overall strategy for Quantexa’s AML and broader financial crime solutions, ensuring they remain highly relevant and well-articulated across multiple lines of business, products, and global markets.

  • Drive Product Roadmap Collaboration: Work closely with cross-departmental teams to help define and prioritize specific product roadmap features that directly enhance the core solution.

  • Champion Thought Leadership & Demos: Build and deliver compelling product demonstrations to senior stakeholders and at industry events; author high-impact thought leadership content, including blogs, whitepapers, and webinars.

  • Support Commercial & Sales Enablement: Partner with commercial teams from initial sales through to customer value realization, leading client workshops to demonstrate solution value and building robust SME knowledge across the business.

  • Develop Collateral with Marketing: Collaborate with marketing teams to create enablement materials, artifacts, and key collateral highlighting Quantexa's unique solution capabilities and market differentiators.

  • Cultivate Stakeholder Relationships: Build, maintain, and deepen key relationships with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Engage Globally: Travel internationally as needed to support and collaborate with our global network of customers and partners.

What you’ll bring.

  • Financial Crime Prevention Expertise: Extensive experience in financial crime prevention within an AML-related domain, preferably with experience in Retail and Corporate Banking AML/CFT and PSP/MSBs (transaction monitoring technology, alert management, investigations across multiple lines of business, etc.). Ideally, the candidate will have prior experience working with Quantexa FinCrime technologies in the stated domains.

  • Demonstrable, extensive experience in deploying, managing, and running Retail Banking AML Transaction Monitoring systems.

  • A proven track record of leading complex system deployments and managing day-to-day operations.

  • Product and solution leadership: A proven track record of leading and executing product strategy, owning solutions and/or developing software, either in-house at a large financial services institution or within an enterprise software vendor. A deep understanding of how AI is shaping financial crime solutions is essential.

  • Executive engagement: Strong executive presence and a proven ability to influence, engage and build trust with C-suite stakeholders at major global banks, insurers and government agencies.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Experience working in a fast-paced, matrixed software product environment, collaborating across sales, alliances, marketing, and Research and Development.

  • Technical understanding: Deep curiosity about, and technical comprehension of, data-driven analytical solutions, including Entity Resolution, Graph/Network Analytics, AI/ML models and Big Data platforms.

  • International travel: Willingness to travel to support strategic customer engagements and partner enablement.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

1e5f94f41223957e.title: Complaints Handler
1e5f94f41223957e.description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Complaints are where things get real - the customer is already frustrated or in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

As a Complaints Handler, you'll own a caseload of customer complaints from acknowledgement through to final response. You'll investigate thoroughly, reach fair outcomes, and explain them clearly, all in line with DISP and Consumer Duty - and you'll take pride in getting it right for the customer first time.

You'll report to the Complaints Team Leader and work closely with teams across Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to get to the right answer and fix the root cause.

Case Handling

  • Own and resolve a caseload of customer complaints following initial acknowledgement

  • Investigate each complaint thoroughly, analysing all the facts and related documentation

  • Gather the information you need from internal teams and external partners

  • Draft Final Response Letters that are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

  • Keep customers informed throughout and manage expectations along the way

  • Stay in control of your workload by actively monitoring and updating case management systems

Quality & Compliance

  • Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

  • Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across every case

  • Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to your Team Leader promptly

  • Support complaints reporting to management, senior leaders, QA assessors, and Compliance

Collaboration

  • Work with Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to resolve complaints and address root causes

  • Contribute to feedback sessions, process improvement discussions, and complaint trend insight

What you will need to be successful

Essential

  • Proven experience handling complaints end to end within an FCA-regulated environment, ideally motor insurance.

  • Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling.

  • Clear, concise written communication, and the emotional intelligence to handle difficult conversations well.

  • An analytical, organised approach - you can balance multiple priorities and deliver within SLAs.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

Desirable

  • Experience of ShareDo or equivalent case management systems.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

701ba5dfa8029a7c.title: Security Engineer
701ba5dfa8029a7c.description:
Who we are

At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.

We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.

More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets.

Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it.

The opportunity

You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it.

The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need.

You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need.

What you’ll do

  • Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them.

  • Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us.

  • Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

  • Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it.

  • Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround.

  • Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember.

  • Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate.

What you bring

  • Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like.

  • A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines.

  • Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP.

  • Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate.

  • An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output.

  • Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists.

  • Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment.

  • Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform.

  • Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products.

  • Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer.

  • Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access.

  • Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme.

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls.

  • You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action.

  • You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default.

  • You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it.

  • You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.

Why join

  • Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors.

  • Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally.

  • Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.

  • Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

Diversity & inclusion at GetGround: We encourage applications from all sections of society and we believe in the criticality of an inclusive culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

eed8aa824e3e3a17.description:
Personal Assistant to the CEO & COO (Up to £55,000 + early stage equity)

Location: London (3 days per week in London office)

About GetGround

GetGround is the UK’s all-in-one property investment platform, helping investors find, finance and structure their UK property investments, all in one place. We’re a fast-growing fintech with a global investor base and a network of partners across lending, mortgage broking, tax, accounting and property management. We’re a team with big ambitions, and we’re looking for someone exceptional to help our CEO & COO make the most of every day.

This role supports both GetGround and the CEO’s wider diary including some family office duties. You’ll be a trusted presence, so discretion and judgement are central to the role.

The role

This is a high-impact, high-trust position at the centre of GetGround. You’ll be the CEO’s right hand, keeping their time, priorities and communications running smoothly so they can focus on leading the company. You’ll work closely with the leadership team as well as a broad range of stakeholders internally and externally. This is much more than diary management: you’ll be a trusted partner, a problem-solver and a gatekeeper.

What you’ll do

  • Manage the CEO’s diary across GetGround and family office commitments, anticipating clashes and protecting time for what matters most

  • Arrange domestic and international travel, including itineraries, bookings and logistics

  • Take minutes and track actions, following up with owners to make sure things get done (where needed)

  • Act as the first point of contact on diary issues for investors, partners, lenders and other senior external contacts

  • Support the administration of family office matters, including coordinating travel/accommodation/miscellaneous items

  • Coordinate leadership team meetings, offsites and company events

  • Handle expenses, invoices and ad hoc projects

  • Manage confidential, personal and commercially sensitive information with complete discretion

About you

Essential

  • Proven experience as a PA, EA or similar at senior or executive level

  • Outstanding organisation and an instinct for prioritising competing demands

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent the CEO externally

  • Absolute discretion and sound judgement with confidential and personal information

  • Proactive and resourceful: you spot problems before they land and solve them quietly

  • Comfortable moving between business and personal or family matters with equal professionalism

  • Confident with Google Workspace and quick to pick up new tools

Desirable

  • Experience in a fast-growing fintech, proptech or financial services business

  • Familiarity with a regulated environment (some GetGround services are FCA-regulated)

  • Experience supporting board or investor relations

  • Comfort with project coordination and basic reporting

e75ce054e43c0c8f.title: Technical Product Manager
e75ce054e43c0c8f.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The role

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

  • Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

  • Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

  • Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought

  • Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team

  • Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation.

  • Scar tissue: 6+ years of Product Management experience in an early-stage environment, where you’ve learned the hard way what works and what doesn’t, and built complex products and features along the way

  • Evals: Comfortable with evals for agents and driving quality improvements via evals and recursive self-improvement

  • Technical IQ: Comfortable with API, data pipelines, SQL, and so on. A background in product engineering is a strong plus.

  • Extreme ownership: You own your area, cradle-to-grave; this is not a relay race where you only do one part and then hand off the next bit of product work to someone else

  • Clever use of AI: You’re an aggressive and proficient user of AI, but you never switch off the local LLM that you were born with :)

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you

  • Want to work remotely. This role is in our London office at least four days a week; most of the team does five.

  • Don't enjoy the pace and intensity of an early-stage startup

  • Have side projects or want to manage a team immediately

  • Need perfect clarity before starting.

  • Prefer long cycles and big “reveals.”

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110K - £145K base + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 - Screening Call with Hiring Manager

Stage 2 - Case study (onsite)

Stage 3 - Founders' values interview

Compensation: £110K – £145K • Offers Equity

  • • Base Salary £110K – £145K • Offers Equity

4b138bc1bf761cf2.title: Lab Technician
4b138bc1bf761cf2.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company.


Key responsibilities

  • Run routine tests and measurements across both Bristol labs, following established procedures

  • Set up, maintain, calibrate and troubleshoot lab equipment

  • Carry out basic soldering and small rework tasks as needed

  • Record results accurately and keep clear, traceable logs

  • Uphold health and safety procedures, including housekeeping, equipment safety checks and proactively reporting risks

  • Support audits, risk assessments and safe working practices, including for lone working

  • Help improve lab processes and SOPs

  • Keep both labs organised and stocked, and hand over clearly on the days you’re not in

Requirements

  • Experience in an electronics, hardware or lab environment

  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to documentation

  • Solid understanding of workplace health and safety, with a proactive approach to it

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team across two labs

  • Right to work in the UK

Desirable

  • Experience in or around data centres

  • Basic soldering and rework skills (IPC or similar training is a plus)

  • Knowledge of liquid cooling systems

  • A health and safety qualification (e.g. IOSH or NEBOSH)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

4f0162ca78b41268.title: Agent Strategist
4f0162ca78b41268.description:
Pace is the AI operations partner for the world’s leading insurers. We combine AI agents with expert review from our insurance operations team to automate insurance tasks. Almost $400 billion is spent on outsourcing in financial services every year. We’re here to change that, working alongside some of the largest companies in the world.

The role

We’re looking for someone to own the success of Pace’s agents inside our largest insurance customers.

You’ll take an insurer’s operational problem, determine how our agents and insurance operations team should solve it, and see it through to launch and measurable results. The role blends advisory work with building: part operations strategist, part product owner.

In practice, you’ll:

  • Find where agents create the most value. Understand a customer’s operations, including volumes, exceptions, handoffs, and costs. Identify the workflows where Pace can have the greatest impact and align with customer leadership on what success looks like.

  • Get agents live and improve them every week. Work with our engineers and insurance experts to configure, test, and launch agents into real workflows. Use production data and feedback from customer teams to improve accuracy and throughput.

  • Turn results into expansion. Quantify the impact, communicate it to executives, and build the case for extending Pace into new workflows, lines of business, and regions.

  • Make every deployment improve the product. Be the voice of the customer inside Pace. Identify patterns across accounts, from recurring gaps and workarounds to capabilities customers keep requesting. Partner with Product and Engineering to turn those insights into platform features that make future deployments faster and better.

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Have experience in strategy, operations, or technology consulting, or another advisory role where you led customer engagements with senior stakeholders.

  • Enjoy turning ambiguous problems into clear plans that people can execute.

  • Write and present clearly, adapting your approach for a CFO, a claims handler, or an engineer.

  • Are curious about how technology works and comfortable getting into the details of systems, data, and integrations.

  • Take ownership of outcomes and stay involved until the work delivers results.

Insurance or financial services experience, hands-on work with AI agents, and founder or startup experience are all a plus.

Our team

Two characteristics define the Pace team:

  1. Integrity. We want to work with good people who care deeply about the impact of their work. Our team is committed to doing the best work of their careers and understands that building something lasting takes years of focus.

  2. Ambition. Our ambition extends beyond building a successful vertical AI company. We’re pursuing a $100 billion-plus outcome across vertical services and looking for people who want to help build at that scale. That might mean becoming the best at their craft, leading teams as we grow, or preparing to start a company of their own.

We’re building a team of exceptional people who grow into leaders. Whether your path is becoming a world-class individual contributor, owning a line of business, or leading a team, we want Pace to be a place where you can learn, make an impact, and grow over the long term.

We’re a team of under 40, working in person across New York and London. With leading customers and top investors, we’re positioned to make a lasting impact on one of the world’s largest industries.

47251fb2b25ada64.title: Senior Software Engineer
47251fb2b25ada64.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary: Snyk's Core R&D organization builds the infrastructure, platform, and shared systems that every product team at Snyk depends on. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll take on complex, ambiguous problems end to end: designing the solution, building it, and owning it in production. This is a role for someone who wants real technical ownership and a direct hand in mentoring the engineers around them, at a company where AI agents are rewriting how software gets built and security has to keep pace.

About the Team: You'll join one of Snyk's Core R&D engineering teams, the group responsible for the shared infrastructure and platform capabilities that power Snyk's products. The team partners closely with product engineering across the company, and reports up through R&D engineering leadership.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead key efforts from idea to execution, demonstrating end to end ownership of complex technical problems.

  • Analyze, design, and implement high-quality, well-tested solutions to problems with real ambiguity.

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, helping grow the next generation of engineering talent at Snyk.

  • Build systems with a long-term mindset: strong design, robust testing, and scalability from day one.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure the infrastructure you build is adopted broadly and used consistently.

  • Resolve critical bugs and customer support escalations to protect a high-quality user experience.

What you'll bring:

  • At least 7 years of commercial experience as a Software Engineer.

  • Expertise in large-scale software systems design and a solid grounding in fundamental computer science concepts.

  • Proficiency in at least one of Snyk's core languages: Go, TypeScript, or Python.

  • Experience building highly reliable, scalable systems, whether microservice back-ends, web UIs, or platform automation tools.

  • A strong commitment to code quality and to giving and receiving direct feedback.

  • Clear, effective communication and comfort working through ambiguity.

  • Nice to have: experience on early-stage products and direct customer problem-solving, comfort with a hybrid, in-person team schedule, and a sense of humor about a mission you still take seriously.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

89b690d3c646b7ed.title: Head of Compliance (12 month FTC)
89b690d3c646b7ed.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 300 territories globally.

The Role:

As Compliance & Risk Lead, you are a key member of Paddle’s compliance team, reporting to our VP, Compliance. You work closely with legal, product, and operational teams to ensure Paddle remains compliant with global payments and fintech regulations as we scale rapidly.

The Paddle compliance function is critical to our operations and growth, enabling innovation while maintaining trust with customers and regulators. You lead the compliance team and collaborate across teams, bringing expertise in payments compliance, risk management, and reporting. You are instrumental in building robust systems to track, analyze, and report on compliance, ensuring Paddle stays ahead in a dynamic regulatory landscape.

The role is based in the UK but global in scope, reflecting Paddle’s international reach.

What you'll do:

You will partner with our Compliance, legal and other teams across Paddle to integrate compliance into our operations, with a heightened focus on building scalable monitoring and reporting:

  • Team leadership: Hire, onboard, and manage compliance professionals, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team to support Paddle’s global compliance needs.

  • Payments compliance: Develop and refine compliance policies and procedures to ensure adherence to global card scheme rules, consumer protection laws and payments regulation (as applicable).

  • Compliance monitoring: Design and oversee simple tech-enabled monitoring programs to track compliance with internal policies and external regulations, using data-driven tools to identify trends and potential risks proactively.

  • Reporting: Deliver compliance reporting for internal stakeholders at all levels (e.g. senior leadership, the Board, product teams) and external regulators, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity to demonstrate Paddle’s regulatory adherence.

  • Risk management: Develop and manage Paddle’s enterprise risk management program, collaborating with teams across the business to identify risks, embed controls and report on their effectiveness.

  • Regulatory research: Work with the legal team to stay ahead of evolving payments, consumer and fintech regulations, advising on their impact and integrating findings into monitoring and reporting frameworks.

  • Incident response: Lead investigations into high-risk complaints and/or compliance breaches, coordinating with legal and operational teams to resolve issues, and produce detailed incident reports for internal review and regulatory submission as needed.

We'd love to hear from you:

  • You have 6-8 years of compliance experience, ideally in payments and/or in fast-growing businesses, with a proven ability to implement and manage scalable monitoring and reporting systems.

  • You have deep expertise in data protection, card scheme rules and payments regulation (e.g., PSD2, AML/KYC) and hands-on experience in fintech or SaaS environments.

  • You’ve worked in a high-growth scale-up, building compliance frameworks that emphasize real-time monitoring and detailed reporting to support rapid expansion.

  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to distill compliance data into concise, actionable insights for diverse audiences—from engineers to regulators.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing proactive monitoring with the ability to respond swiftly to competing demands.

  • You’re detail-oriented, with a passion for ensuring compliance is not just met but demonstrably provable.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and enhanced parental leave. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

e97ba9024613cc68.title: Human Data Collection Associate
e97ba9024613cc68.description:
Type: Full-time ·

Location: London, UK · On-site

Compensation: £50,000–£65,000/year, in accordance with experience ·

The Role

We're building a foundation model of the brain and behaviour across species, and the data that powers it is produced in-house by a small, high-trust team. This role sits at the centre of that effort. As a Human Data Collection Associate, you run data collection sessions on assigned rigs, preparing and calibrating the setup, running the session, and making sure the data you hand off is clean and complete.

It is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll report to the Human Data Collection Lead and work alongside the Hardware Systems team who build and maintain the rigs. You'll also take part in sessions as a contributor of your own data, so comfort being recorded during collection is part of the role.

Responsibilities

Running data collection

  • Prepare, calibrate, and run recording sessions from start to finish, following defined protocols precisely

  • Fit sensors, verify signal quality in real time, and resolve issues before they affect a session

  • Contribute your own data as a session participant where the protocol calls for it

Data quality and integrity

  • Own the quality bar for everything you collect. Review, label, and validate recordings so that only clean, well-documented data moves downstream

  • Keep accurate consent, provenance, and session-metadata records for every dataset, following the standards the Lead sets and our obligations under UK GDPR

  • Identify and document anomalies, and help refine protocols as we learn what works

Operations and equipment

  • Keep your recording setup maintained, charged, and ready, and track its condition over time

  • Support session scheduling and keep collection running smoothly day to day

  • Help onboard and coordinate short-term participants as we scale collection

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • Meticulous attention to detail and real care for data quality

  • Able to follow structured, repeatable protocols precisely and consistently

  • Confident with hands-on technical setups and quick to troubleshoot when something is not working

  • Reliable and organised, able to own a process from end to end with minimal oversight

  • Comfortable taking part in data collection sessions as a contributor, including being recorded

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a knack for putting participants at ease

  • Right to work in the UK

Valued

  • Experience in a research, lab, clinical, or data collection setting

  • Familiarity with physiological or behavioural recording equipment

  • Exposure to biosignal or time-series data, and basic comfort with data tools such as spreadsheets or light scripting

  • Genuine interest in neuroscience, AI, or the science of human and animal behaviour

  • Experience maintaining quality standards and documentation in a high-rigour environment

32f86439ad9c0b4c.title: Hardware Technician - Preclinical Research
32f86439ad9c0b4c.description:
Type: Full-time

Location: London and Brighton On-site

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection.

We need a reliable, hands-on assistant to support day-to-day operations at the London capture site. Working under the Hardware Systems Engineer, you'll prep and run sessions, keep the rigs and data in order, and make sure every capture follows the established protocols. This is an execution role: you'll run the standards someone else has set, and do it consistently.

 

Responsibilities

Session Support

  • Prepare rigs and equipment ahead of recording sessions

  • Run recording sessions following established SOPs

  • Handle participant setup and guide subjects through capture

  • Log sessions accurately and flag anything anomalous

Hardware & Data

3185cfe97e4756a1.title: Human Data Collection Lead
3185cfe97e4756a1.description:
Type: Full-time Location: London, UK · On-site Compensation: £60,000–£95,000/year, in accordance with experience Travel: Potential occasional international travel as we stand up collection sites in other locations

About Netholabs

Netholabs is a frontier neuroscience and AI research company working at the intersection of deep learning, ethology, and physical engineering. We are on a mission to defend and enhance human agency in the age of superhuman artificial intelligence.

Instead of training AI solely on internet text, we build biological foundation models grounded in evolutionary intelligence. We design custom hardware, ultra-high-density neural recording systems, and complex tracking environments to capture petabyte-scale neurobehavioral datasets. By mapping these biological dynamics to digital organisms, we are building Whole Brain Emulations (WBE) to unlock structurally safe, human-compatible artificial general intelligence.

At Netholabs, you will work alongside world-class neuroscientists, machine learning researchers, and engineers to build the data infrastructure and neural models that will define the future of safe AGI. We have offices in London and San Francisco.

The Role

We're looking for a Human Data Collection Lead to own the quality and integrity of everything we record. We capture people performing real-world tasks, from physical manipulation to computer use, across many precisely synchronised modalities at once: motion tracking, eye tracking, multi-camera video, and neural signals such as EEG.

Right now this is a hands-on technical role. You'll set up and operate the recording rigs, get every device aligned in time and space, and apply the craft that makes neural data clean and trustworthy. Once the data is proven and collection volume grows, the role expands to building and managing the participant pipeline.

Responsibilities

Now: rigs, sessions, and data quality

  • Set up, calibrate, and operate multimodal recording rigs: motion tracking, eye tracking, camera arrays, and neural and physiological sensors

  • Own temporal synchronisation and spatial calibration across every device, so all data streams line up

  • Run recording sessions spanning manipulation tasks and computer use, with neural data recorded throughout

  • Apply neuroimaging best practices: careful sensor placement, signal and impedance checks, artefact and noise reduction

  • Verify each session is complete, correctly logged, and meets quality standards before it reaches the research team

  • Obtain informed consent and handle participant data under UK GDPR; keep clear, versioned SOPs as protocols evolve

As we scale: participants and team

  • Build and manage the participant panel, recruitment, screening, and scheduling; structure repeat sessions and drive retention

  • Help stand up new collection sites internationally and keep protocols, consent, and data handling consistent across them

Requirements

You don't need to tick every box; please lean towards applying if the role seems interesting to you.

  • Background in neuroscience or a related field, with hands-on experience collecting neurophysiological data (EEG or other modalities) and keeping it clean

  • Comfortable setting up, calibrating, and troubleshooting recording hardware

  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail; systematic, documents everything, lets nothing slip

  • Strong interpersonal skills; participants trust you and colleagues want to work with you

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where you define the process

  • Right to work in the UK, and willing and able to travel internationally on occasion

Valued

  • Experience with multimodal or time-synchronised recording setups (motion capture, eye tracking, multi-camera video)

  • Experience running human-subjects research operations (lab manager, clinical research coordinator, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of informed consent, UK research ethics, and UK GDPR

  • Prior startup experience
