f1547d324a825fa6.title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
f1547d324a825fa6.description:
Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

  • Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

  • Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap

     

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture

  • Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

  • Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

  • Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

  • Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

  • Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

  • Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

  • Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

  • Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

What we offer

  • Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

  • Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

  • A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

  • Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

a10ec678d9d1e5d0.description:
Type: Full-time
Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site

The Role

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording

  • Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

  • Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

  • Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

Neuroscience → AI Translation

  • Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

  • Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience.

  • Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments

  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

  • Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

  • Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

Valued (or willing to learn)

  • Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets

  • Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training

466e55723e8b8557.title: Technical Quality Assurance Manager
466e55723e8b8557.description:
The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

The role defines and maintains the overarching test strategy and ensures that quality engineering practices are practical, risk-based and integrated throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

The Technical QA Manager provides direct technical leadership and support to QA Champions and Test Automation Engineers. The role ensures that team testing strategies, automation approaches, quality standards and release evidence are aligned, measurable and consistently applied.

The purpose of the Technical QA Manager role is to:

· Define, communicate and maintain the organisational test strategy and supporting quality engineering standards.

· Enable QA Champions to define and operate effective team and product-area testing strategies.

· Provide technical direction to Test Automation Engineers on automation strategy, framework design, coding standards, CI/CD integration, reusable components, maintainability, diagnostics, test data and execution reliability.

· Ensure automated test execution is embedded into delivery pipelines and provides fast, reliable and actionable feedback.

· Align functional, integration, regression, non-functional and release validation with product, technical and delivery risk.

· Strengthen developer ownership of testing while providing appropriate governance, coaching and assurance.

· Ensure AI-generated testing assets and automation code are reviewed critically before use.

· Defining expectations for pipeline triggers, test execution, quality controls, test-result publication, diagnostic information and failure feedback.

· Ensuring pipeline automation is reliable, maintainable and proportionate to product and release risk.

· Improve release confidence through clear, evidence-based quality and automation reporting.

· Reduce avoidable rework, escaped defects, flaky tests and dependency on manual regression testing.

The Technical QA Manager should be able to:

· Define and implement comprehensive, risk-based test strategies across multiple delivery areas.

· Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.

· Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

· Define effective pipeline execution, result visibility and failure-feedback approaches.

· Provide credible technical leadership on modern test automation frameworks.

· Work effectively with Playwright or equivalent test automation technology.

· Review and guide maintainable automation code.

· Understand automation developed using C#, Java or an equivalent object-oriented language.

· Understand functional, integration, regression, API, user-interface and relevant non-functional testing approaches.

· Assess the suitability of automation at different levels of a system.

· Review automation framework design, test architecture and reusable components.

· Evaluate automation maintainability, test data, environment dependencies and execution reliability.

· Identify flaky, duplicated, low-value or overly expensive automated tests.

· Analyse quality and automation evidence to identify systemic risks and improvement priorities.

· Understand risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

· Coach and influence QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers, developers and delivery stakeholders.

· Communicate technical quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Challenge weak requirements, ineffective controls and poor automation practices constructively.

· Use AI-assisted testing capabilities critically, with appropriate review, traceability and governance.

The successful candidate should have:

·         Strong experience in software quality assurance, test automation and quality engineering.

·         Experience providing technical leadership across complex software delivery environments using kaban methodology.

·         Demonstrable experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

·         Demonstrable experience improving the reliability and feedback value of pipeline-based automated testing.

·         Proven ability to define, implement and govern testing strategies.

·         Experience supporting other quality roles in applying testing strategies within delivery teams.

·         Practical experience with a modern automation framework.

·         Preferable experience with Playwright and Selenium.

·         Practical coding capability in an object-oriented programming language.

·         Experience designing, building or significantly improving maintainable test automation frameworks.

·         Experience reviewing automation architecture and test-code quality.

·         A good understanding of functional, integration, regression and release testing.

·         A good understanding of software delivery lifecycle and release governance.

·         A good understanding of risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

·         A proactive and improvement-focused approach.

·         The confidence to challenge poor quality or automation practices constructively.

Desirable experience includes:

·         Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines.

·         Experience configuring automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.

·         Experience publishing and interpreting automated test results within CI/CD tooling.

·         Experience implementing pipeline quality controls.

The Technical QA Manager should be measured on:

·         Adoption and effectiveness of organisational testing strategy.

·         Quality and consistency of team and product-area testing strategies.

·         Effectiveness of support provided to QA Champions.

·         Effectiveness of technical direction provided to Test Automation Engineers.

·         Reliable automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines.

·         Faster, clearer and more actionable quality feedback to delivery teams.

·         Increased useful automated coverage in areas of meaningful product risk.

·         Reduced flaky, duplicated and low-value automated tests.

·         Improved maintainability of automation frameworks and test code.

·         Reduced dependency on repeatable manual regression testing.

·         Reduced escaped defects and avoidable rework.

·         Improved developer ownership of testing and quality.

·         Improved compliance with agreed Definition of Done expectations and release control processes.

·         Clear and evidence-based release-readiness reporting.

·         Timely escalation of significant quality and automation risks.

·         Improved collaboration between QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers and developers.

·         Demonstrable improvement in release confidence and testing effectiveness.

·         Success should not be measured only by the volume of tests automated. Measures consider automation value, reliability, risk coverage, feedback speed, maintainability and model.

7b04a184dce5e21d.location: Windsor, Windsor and Maidenhead, United Kingdom
7b04a184dce5e21d.description:
Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

8857264f1496b768.title: UKCSC Chartered or Principal Enterprise Advisor - Security Architecture
8857264f1496b768.description:
Intelance is an independent UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME Certification Body for Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus and IASME Cyber Assurance. We work with mid-market, enterprise and regulated organisations across cyber assurance, security architecture, governance and technology risk.

We are appointing professionals who already hold formal UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) registration in Security Architecture at Principal or Chartered level, to join our associate panel and support the assessment and advisory of large, complex organisations.

This is not permanent employment. Work is offered on a project-by-project basis according to client demand, suitability and availability.

Please note: current UKCSC registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level is an essential requirement for this role. Applications without it will not be progressed.

Tasks

You may be asked to:

  • Lead independent security architecture reviews and assurance for large, complex and regulated organisations.
  • Assess cloud, hybrid and on-premises architectures across identity, networks, applications, platforms and data.
  • Carry out threat modelling and identify credible attack paths, design weaknesses and control gaps.
  • Judge whether proposed or alternative controls provide equivalent, proportionate protection.
  • Review high-level and detailed designs and challenge unsupported assumptions.
  • Advise boards, executives and technical teams on secure-by-design decisions and trade-offs.
  • Produce clear, defensible, client-ready architecture findings and assurance reports.
  • Complete scheme-specific training and participate in internal quality reviews where required.

Requirements

You must hold:

  • Current UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) professional registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level. This is mandatory and will be verified.

You should also have:

  • Substantial experience as a practising security architect in large, complex or regulated organisations.
  • Strong command of secure-by-design principles, threat modelling and architecture assurance.
  • Practical experience across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networks, applications and data security.
  • Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical decision-makers.

SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CCSP and cloud certifications are welcome but do not replace the UKCSC registration requirement.

You must be based in the UK, able to attend UK client sites when agreed, and able to contract through a limited company or another compliant arrangement.

Benefits

  • Senior, independent security architecture and assurance assignments.
  • Flexible associate working based on your availability.
  • Direct access to Intelance leadership.
  • Work alongside experienced architects, governance and risk advisors and technical assessors.
  • Clear scopes, templates and quality-review arrangements.
  • Potential inclusion in Intelance proposals and associate credentials, subject to agreement.

Please provide:

  • Your CV and LinkedIn profile.
  • Your UK Cyber Security Council registration: specialism, level (Principal or Chartered) and your registration number or public UKCSC profile link.
  • Your location, availability and expected day rate.
  • One example of a complex enterprise security architecture you personally designed or assured.
  • Details of any relevant scheme, architecture or cyber-assurance qualifications.

ad4c165585ba9af5.title: Global Head of Manufacturing
ad4c165585ba9af5.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Global Head of Manufacturing to build and lead UFORCE’s manufacturing capability as we turn battle-proven autonomous systems into high-quality products delivered reliably at scale.

You’ll bring together teams across Portugal, Poole and our expanding US manufacturing footprint behind one practical production strategy. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Global Demand & Delivery to turn customer commitments into accepted hardware, while keeping the rapid engineering and field feedback that make UFORCE effective.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll establish the operating discipline, capacity and leadership needed for sustained growth while staying close to the factory floor and the problems that affect delivery today. The role reports initially to Global CEO, with reporting expected to transition to the EU CEO or Global COO once the relevant leader is hired.

What You Will Do

  • Own manufacturing delivery across contracted programs. Establish achievable production and recovery plans, identify material and capacity constraints, and address risks before customer commitments are missed.

  • Build a resource-constrained global production plan across Portugal, Poole and planned US sites, balancing near-term execution with longer-term capacity, staffing, equipment, supplier and test needs.

  • Work with Global Demand & Delivery through the S&OP process to align site capacity and production commitments with the consolidated demand forecast.

  • Shape the manufacturing footprint and investment roadmap. Evaluate expansion, production transfers, make-versus-buy decisions and automation with Finance and cross-functional leaders, using demand scenarios, delivered cost and capital requirements.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product and Quality to prepare new products and major changes for production, improve manufacturability and bring field feedback into controlled, rapid changes.

  • Establish consistent production controls for bills of materials, work instructions, configuration, inspection, testing and traceability. Work with Quality and site leaders to resolve critical defects and safety or readiness gaps.

  • Use production data and time on the factory floor to improve yield, cycle time, labor productivity and unit cost. Address bottlenecks, shortages, rework and downtime with the teams closest to the work.

  • Partner with Supply Chain on critical material availability, supplier recovery and alternate sources, and escalate competing priorities with clear options and recommendations.

  • Build and develop site and functional leaders, clarify decision rights, strengthen technician skills and establish a consistent operating rhythm across the manufacturing network.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of taking complex hardware from early builds into sustained production, with direct ownership of delivery, output and quality through a ramp.

  • Experience leading manufacturing across multiple sites or countries through site managers, including building teams, developing leaders and establishing common standards while retaining local expertise.

  • Strong manufacturing engineering and industrialization judgment, including design for manufacture, assembly methods, tooling, test, configuration control and engineering change.

  • Demonstrated results improving production flow, first-pass yield, cycle time or cost through practical problem solving, continuous improvement and direct engagement on the factory floor.

  • Experience building quality and safety into production, including traceability, acceptance testing, root-cause actions and relevant aerospace, defense or comparable quality systems.

  • Sound commercial and financial judgment, with experience evaluating capacity, inventory, capital investment, automation, outsourcing and supplier capability against delivery and unit economics.

  • Ability to align Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance and commercial teams around achievable commitments, communicate risks early and resolve difficult trade-offs.

  • A hands-on, accountable leadership style and the ability to build useful structure in a fast-changing organization without slowing down execution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience manufacturing uncrewed systems, robotics, maritime or aerospace products, or other complex defense hardware.

  • Experience integrating acquired manufacturing operations or transferring production between sites while maintaining delivery.

  • Experience scaling manufacturing across Europe and the United States.

  • Experience translating field or customer feedback into production improvements in a fast-moving hardware environment.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

abf08e21653537aa.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
abf08e21653537aa.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to make UFORCE systems work reliably in the field. You’ll work alongside engineers, operators and customers during trials, demonstrations, training and deployments, resolving issues and turning field experience into practical improvements.

Software is your primary discipline, but this is not a desk-based software role. It’s a hands-on, deployed position where you’ll work across the wider system, from networking and communications to equipment setup and operator workflows.

You don’t need deep mechanical, marine or electronics expertise. We’re looking for strong software skills, practical operational experience and the ability to learn quickly.

The role is a remote based role, with regular travel to field sites and customer locations locally and internationally.

What You Will Do

  • Own technical execution in the field: deploying, configuring, and supporting our systems during trials, demonstrations, training, and customer activity, often with limited backup.

  • Manage the software side of deployments, including baselines, versions, configuration control, release notes, validation checks, and rollback and recovery procedures.

  • Diagnose faults across the whole deployed system using structured fault isolation, separating software, hardware, network, comms, power, sensor, configuration, operator, and environmental causes.

  • Read logs, reproduce issues, test hypotheses, and capture clear evidence, then hand issues back to Engineering with enough context to act on them quickly.

  • Write scripts and small tools that automate checks, validate configuration, parse logs, and reduce manual work in the field.

  • Prepare for field activity by checking equipment, cabling, compute setup, spares, tools, checklists, and documentation. Support practical tasks beyond software, such as system setup and compute swaps, and improve preparation so deployments become faster and more repeatable.

  • Turn field observations into clear feedback for Software, Product, Operations, and Engineering, closing the gap between what is built, what is deployed, and what the customer expects.

  • Support operators and customers during demonstrations and training, explain technical issues clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences, and help customers become more self-sufficient after handover.

  • Improve software readiness over time, including observability, release discipline, documentation, and knowledge transfer, so the field depends less on engineering reach-back.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering ability as your primary discipline, with skills in Python and/or C++ for debugging, log analysis, and system maintenance.

  • You can read, write, and debug code and scripts and are comfortable with version control, APIs, services, and logs.

  • Systems-minded judgment. You can explain interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs across software, compute, networking, comms, sensors, hardware, and field operations, and you avoid assuming that every problem is a software problem.

  • Experience deploying and configuring Linux-based software systems, including package management, services, containers, updates, rollbacks, and repeatable deployment methods.

  • Practical field troubleshooting experience in deployed or operational settings, such as military or global operations, motorsport, field engineering, remote production, customer sites, maritime, robotics, aerospace, or automotive environments.

  • Working knowledge of networking and integration, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and how to tell a software failure from a connectivity, sensor, or data-link problem.

  • Operational discipline: you prepare thoroughly, use checklists, manage risk, escalate sensibly, and stay calm under pressure.

  • Clear technical communication, including structured, unambiguous reporting that Engineering can act on and operators can understand.

  • A team-first, high-ownership approach. You work well with a small, multidisciplinary team, including during extended deployments, and are willing to travel regularly and support field activity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, uncrewed systems, autonomy or mission software, sensors, telemetry, operator interfaces, or defence trials.

  • Experience deploying software to edge compute or in disconnected environments, including containers and orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and controlled updates.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible, or Terraform.

  • Experience representing a technical team in customer demonstrations, trials, training, or deployments.

  • Experience working in security-sensitive or controlled environments.

9457f99156588567.title: New Business Sales Executive
9457f99156588567.description:
About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a New Business Sales Executive to help bring new clients to Hozah. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and help grow the account from there.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone early in their sales career who wants to build it properly. You'll learn the full B2B sales cycle, from first cold call to signed contract, alongside an experienced commercial team, with uncapped commission from day one. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys the hunt and wants to get better at it every week.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on prospecting, selling and learning.

Key responsibilities

  • Work a named list of target organisations and turn them into Hozah clients, from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Run a disciplined outbound routine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks.

  • Book and run discovery calls and site visits, and build proposals with support from the wider team.

  • Hit your activity and sales targets, with commission on every deal you win.

  • Keep your activity, pipeline and forecast accurate and up to date in the CRM.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down.

  • Look for the next site within the accounts you win, and learn how to grow a client's estate over time.

  • Share what you hear from prospects with the team, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

  • Some experience in a target-driven sales role, such as SDR, BDR, business development, telesales or field sales, and the numbers to show how you performed against target.

  • Comfort with cold calling as a daily habit, and the resilience to keep going through a run of rejections.

  • Curiosity: you ask good questions and listen properly to the answers.

  • Coachability: you seek out feedback, act on it, and can show how you've improved as a result.

  • Organisation and discipline: a routine for managing your day, your activity and your follow-ups.

  • Clear, confident communication on the phone, in writing and face to face.

  • The ambition to build a career in B2B sales and grow into larger deals and accounts.

  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and clients in person across the UK.

  • Useful but not essential: experience selling to landowners, managing agents, hotels, retail or leisure operators, or in parking, property services, facilities management or another multi-site B2B service.

What you get in return

We ask a lot of this role, and we give a lot back.

  • Real room to develop your career. We hold only a small percentage of the market, and as the commercial team grows there's a clear opportunity to progress into larger deals and key account roles.

  • The chance to learn from an experienced commercial team, with regular coaching on your calls, meetings and deals.

  • A generous, uncapped commission structure, in a commercial team that already has people earning well above OTE.

  • The pace and energy of a fast-growth tech start-up, where your work is visible and your results directly shape the business.

  • Close exposure to the CEO and senior team, so you see how commercial decisions on pricing, proposition and territory get made.

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. About the Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Manager to join Volta’s tax function and lead delivery across corporate and international tax. This role would suit someone looking to move in-house at a fast-scaling, capital-intensive platform.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, this is a hands-on delivery role. The Senior Manager will own the group’s corporate tax compliance and reporting workstreams, implement international tax policies, and monitor governance to ensure tax structures are operating as intended, with genuine scope for the remit to grow as the function and business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Lead the day-to-day management of corporate tax compliance across the group, coordinating local Finance teams and external advisers to ensure accurate and timely filings.

  • Review corporate tax computations, returns and supporting schedules, escalating material positions and judgement calls to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain oversight of tax payments, instalments, filing obligations and elections across jurisdictions.

  • Own the preparation and coordination of current and deferred tax calculations, tax disclosures and supporting documentation for financial reporting and audit.

  • Build and maintain group cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, explaining key movements, risks and opportunities.

  • Track tax losses, capital allowances, interest restrictions and other tax attributes, ensuring they are reflected consistently in returns, reporting and forecasts.

International Tax

  • Execute the technical analysis and implementation of international tax policies and structures agreed with the VP of Tax.

  • Monitor the group’s permanent-establishment, tax-residence and substance positions as the business expands into new markets.

  • Manage withholding-tax and repatriation workstreams, including treaty relief, supporting documentation and coordination with local advisers.

  • Assess the corporate and international tax implications of new entities, cross-border activities and intercompany arrangements.

  • Support tax planning for intangible assets and intellectual property (IP), including ownership, development, licensing and cross-border transfers, working with the VP of Tax, Legal and external advisers to align arrangements with commercial objectives, substance and transfer-pricing requirements.

  • Monitor the group’s obligations under Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and other international tax reporting regimes, coordinating implementation and filings where applicable.

  • Bring forward clear recommendations on technical questions, with the commercial and risk trade-offs spelled out.

  • Flag material tax developments and translate them into practical actions for the group.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany Arrangements

  • Lead the day-to-day implementation of the group’s transfer-pricing policies, working with Finance, Legal and external advisers.

  • Coordinate transfer-pricing documentation, benchmarking and local reporting requirements across jurisdictions.

  • Monitor intercompany charges and financing arrangements to ensure they reflect agreed policies, contractual terms and the activities performed.

  • Work with Finance to implement intercompany calculations, invoicing and year-end adjustments.

  • Maintain supporting documentation for intercompany services, financing, intellectual property and other material cross-border arrangements.

  • Identify changes in functions, assets or risks that may require updates to the group’s transfer-pricing approach.

Governance & Risk

  • Help operate Volta’s tax governance framework and controls on a day-to-day basis and keep the tax risk register current.

  • Build and maintain supporting documentation for material tax positions, elections and arrangements.

  • Monitor whether group structures are operating as intended, including governance, substance and intercompany arrangements.

  • Manage the working relationship with Big Four and legal advisers on corporate and international tax matters, escalating scope, cost or quality issues.

  • Coordinate responses to tax authority enquiries, audits and information requests, escalating significant matters to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain clear ownership, deadlines and evidence of review across tax compliance and reporting processes.

Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day corporate and international tax contact for Finance, Legal, People and other internal teams.

  • Give practical, timely tax input on new markets, operating arrangements and business initiatives.

  • Support Capital Markets and Corporate Development on transactions, drawing on the group’s tax positions, attributes and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinate with colleagues and advisers responsible for VAT/GST, employment taxes and other specialist areas where issues overlap.

  • Prepare materials and analysis for the VP of Tax ahead of CFO, leadership, investor and auditor conversations.

  • Take ownership of agreed workstreams end-to-end, escalating judgement calls and anything strategically significant to the VP of Tax.

Process & Team Support

  • Help the VP of Tax roll out new processes, controls and systems as the function scales.

  • Improve the quality and availability of tax data, working closely with Finance on reporting and reconciliation processes.

  • Identify opportunities for automation and standardisation in tax compliance, reporting and intercompany processes.

  • Manage or mentor junior tax analysts and associates as the team grows.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

  • Strong relevant tax experience, typically Big Four Senior Manager to Associate Director level, or the in-house equivalent – someone used to taking ownership of corporate and international tax delivery across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Professional qualification: CTA, ACA, CA or equivalent.

  • Solid technical grounding in corporate and international tax, including transfer pricing, withholding taxes, permanent establishments, tax residence and treaty matters.

  • Hands-on experience managing corporate tax compliance and external advisers across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Proven experience with tax accounting, current and deferred tax provisions, and financial statement disclosures.

  • Comfortable building and reviewing cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, and explaining the commercial implications.

  • Experience implementing tax policies and intercompany arrangements, with an understanding of the documentation and processes needed to make them work in practice.

Skills & Attributes

  • Execution-focused and detail-oriented, with good judgement about what to escalate and when.

  • Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end while operating within a strategy set by someone else.

  • Strong project-management skills, coordinating multiple jurisdictions, deadlines and internal and external stakeholders at once.

  • A clear communicator, able to explain complex tax positions to non-tax audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative, energised by building good process in a fast-moving environment.

  • Able to connect technical tax requirements with the group’s commercial activities, financial reporting and cash flow.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in private equity, infrastructure funds, real assets, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Time in a start-up or rapidly scaling international organisation.

  • Exposure to data centres or other capital-intensive infrastructure businesses.

  • Familiarity with UK, European and US tax environments.

  • Experience with Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and international tax transparency requirements.

  • Exposure to cross-border financing, restructurings or acquisitions.

027fdc1e660f7d27.description:
Location: London – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior


About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

Your Role

We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. The UK is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, DACH, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In the UK we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years.

If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in the UK and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. You will report directly to the Co-founder, have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and a channel person alongside you to build the partner ecosystem. Your job is to generate pipeline, navigate deals, and close.

No VP of Sales between you and the decision maker. No committee to approve your approach. Just a big market, a working product, and room to run.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate pipeline fast - primarily through your existing network. There is no inbound engine, no SDR handing you leads. You eat what you kill.

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close

  • Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement

  • Be the face of Nebuly in the UK - at events, in conversations, in the market

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience in the UK

  • Proven track record of closing multiple 6-figure enterprise contracts

  • Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the the UK enterprise space

  • Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads)

  • You know how to win deals without inbound or SDRs - you drive your own pipeline

  • Experience working alongside system integrators and advisory firms - you know how to bring them into a deal, co-sell with them, and build the relationship that eventually generates referrals.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, a lean process, and building as you go

  • Fluent in English

You do not need to have sold AI observability or conversational analytics before. You need to know the buyers and know how to sell.

Bonus Points

  • Experience as a first sales hire or market launcher

  • Background in data, analytics, ML infrastructure, or developer tools

What We Offer

A product with proof. You have a working product, enterprise logos, and a category narrative that resonates with exactly the buyers you will be calling.

Real earning potential. Compensation is flexible based on experience and fit.

Equity. You are early. That means something.

No bureaucracy. You will report directly to the Co-founder and have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and field marketing support to help with events. You will start by selling directly - but as you build the first logos in the UK, activating the first partner relationships is part of the job too. A dedicated Partnerships Manager joins once the market has validated. Until then, the partner motion is yours.


Sound like you? Apply now. We'd love to meet you.

57d557eea2583392.description:
Director, Solution Consulting/FDE (AI & Enterprise Workflow Solutions)

 

➡️ Have you led and developed high-performing Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI?

➡️ Do you have the technical depth to go beyond traditional pre-sales, with hands-on experience in AI, APIs, integrations and workflow automation?

➡️ Want to lead a global function at the forefront of AI-powered innovation, helping some of the world's leading organisations transform how they approach R&D, Intellectual Property and technology development?

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

Patsnap is seeking a commercially minded, technically capable leader to manage and develop our global Solutions Consulting team, supporting all products supporting Patsnap's portfolio across Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, Materials Science and Engineering.

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

You'll lead an established global team of Solutions Consultants, strengthening its technical capabilities and expanding the function through the introduction of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). This includes defining how the team approaches technical discovery, solution development and customer engagement, ensuring we're equipped to support increasingly complex enterprise requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.

We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. You'll be responsible for building a function that not only supports commercial growth, but plays an increasingly important role in how customers adopt and integrate Patsnap's technology into their operations.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position based in our Farringdon office, with a requirement to work on-site at least one day per week, on Wednesdays.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO technology company transforming how organisations use Intellectual Property and Research & Development intelligence to drive innovation.

Our AI-powered platform connects patent intelligence, scientific research, Life Sciences data and market insights, helping organisations make more informed decisions, accelerate R&D and bring new innovations to market.

Trusted by over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the world's leading innovators, we've raised $300 million in Series E funding, reaching a valuation of over $1 billion.

As we continue to evolve into an AI-native business, we're enabling customers to integrate our proprietary data, AI agents and intelligence directly into their existing technology and business processes.

With offices in Singapore, London, Toronto and Shanghai, alongside remote teams across the US, we're an international business with ambitious plans for continued growth. Our culture is high-performing but low ego, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, ownership and developing people.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach and develop the global Solutions Consulting team, setting clear expectations for performance, customer impact and commercial contribution.

5a95a76058eedc09.title: General Counsel at amo
5a95a76058eedc09.description:
amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump and Sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

The role:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

How we think about legal:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write.

  • Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe.

  • Pragmatic on risk: you know which rules are non-negotiable, where there is room for judgement, and how much risk is worth taking for the business. You give a recommendation, not a list of risks.

  • Built for scale: you set up the contracts, policies and processes that enable our growth.

What you'll own:

You'll cover every legal question that comes with scaling a consumer app across markets, working with the right local counsel on each topic:

  • Corporate: general corporate, group structure as we expand internationally, BSPCE plans and employee liquidity operations.

  • Employment: French labour law across the employee lifecycle, from contracts, immigration and internal rules to terminations.

  • Trademarks and IP: our global trademark portfolio: filing strategy, oppositions, watch services and disputes. Patents and content licensing as they come.

  • Compliance and data protection: GDPR, protection of minors, DSA, app store policies, and more. Regulator and law enforcement requests.

  • Commercial contracts: vendors and SaaS, partnerships, creator and influencer agreements, advertising, data processing agreements. Templates and a self-serve process so teams can move autonomously.

  • Litigation: pre-litigation and litigation across jurisdictions, with outside counsel. Clear risk assessments and options for the cofounders.

  • M&A: acquisitions and strategic transactions when the time comes, including due diligence, structuring and integration.

What success looks like:

  • Teams ship features, sign deals and expand without waiting on legal.

  • The cofounders spend far less time on legal: topics get tracked, briefed and closed without one of them driving each one, and nothing is discovered late.

  • The right local counsel is in place for each topic and market, on a budget we control.

What we're looking for:

  • Startup and scaleup experience, at our stage and beyond. 7+ years of legal experience, including a senior in-house role (General Counsel, Deputy GC or Head of Legal) at a tech company. You've lived the stage we're at international expansion, fast growth.

  • Expert in French and EU law. French legal training, with deep knowledge of French corporate and employment law, GDPR and EU digital regulation. Admission to the bar (CAPA) is a plus.

  • Global outlook. You've handled matters in several jurisdictions and know how to find, brief and challenge the right local counsel for each topic and market.

  • A true generalist. You move from a vendor contract negotiation to a trademark opposition in the same day, and know when to go deep yourself and when to bring in a specialist.

  • Product and business first. You adapt the legal approach to what the product and the business need, and give clear recommendations in plain language. You help the team move fast without taking blind risks.

  • Hands-on. You draft and negotiate yourself and don't need a team to get things done.

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • Comfortable with little structure. You set your own priorities in a noisy environment and would rather be judged on what you enabled than on how busy you were.

  • Discretion. You handle sensitive matters, including disputes, with complete confidentiality.

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a consumer app, social or gaming company.

  • Hands-on work with GDPR, content moderation (DSA).

  • M&A transactions led or closed, buy side or sell side.

  • A few years at a top-tier law firm before going in-house.

  • Exposure to a crisis, whether regulatory, press or security.

Why join:

You'll build the function from the ground up, with a seat next to the cofounders on the decisions that shape the company and a direct impact on the trajectory of a company that serves users all over the globe.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

 

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

 

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

      We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

9a58c96ed4205395.title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
9a58c96ed4205395.description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
  • Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

9572a6d16031adeb.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Talent Acquisition Intern to help us hire the interns and apprentices shaping Qonto's next generation of talent. You'll screen and source across Tech, Product and Business, working closely with our 25+ Talent Acquisition Managers, under the guidance of Aurélien, our Head of Talent Acquisition.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Hire our interns and apprentices: Alongside the other TA intern, you'll own CV screening and sourcing for every intern and apprentice role, across all teams.

  • Support senior hiring: You'll analyse the labour market to find candidates for critical, senior roles when needed.

  • Sharpen our process: You'll spot friction points in our hiring process and help fix them.

  • Drive TA projects: You'll contribute to initiatives like campus management, salary and perks benchmarking, and tooling improvements.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Still studying, close to the finish line: You're pursuing a French Master's (or equivalent) in HR Management or a related field, and looking for your end-of-study internship.

  • Fluent in French and English: German, Spanish or Italian is a plus.

  • Hands-on and organised: You can juggle multiple priorities and keep a hiring process moving at pace.

  • A natural communicator: You'll represent Qonto to candidates, so you're comfortable presenting yourself and building rapport fast.

  • Open to working with AI: You're comfortable using AI tools to speed up screening, sourcing and admin work.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A truly international team: Recruiters across France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Austria and Belgium 🇫🇷🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇵🇹🇦🇹🇧🇪.

  • Real ownership from day one: You and the other TA intern will run intern & apprentice hiring end-to-end, not just support it.

  • Exposure beyond your scope: You'll get pulled into senior hiring and strategic TA projects most interns never touch.

  • A front-row seat on scaling TA: You'll see up close how a 20+ person team hires at Qonto's pace.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Aurélien, our Head of Talent Acquisition since July 2023, leading a team of 20+ recruiters hiring talent worldwide. Before Qonto, he spent years in executive search across France and Europe. He's hands-on and genuinely invested in making recruitment sharper and more effective for everyone involved.

Perks

  • Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

    Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

    Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

    Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

    Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

    Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

    Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

85765d57eef7b865.title: Senior AI Engineer
85765d57eef7b865.description:
Join us as an AI Engineer in our AI Products team to make sure the AI agents we ship are as reliable as they are fast to build. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers.

  • Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot.

  • Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk.

  • Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early.

  • Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading.

b4eb93b6bc44c116.title: GPU Engineer
b4eb93b6bc44c116.description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

H Company is seeking a Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to help our sales teams win and grow our largest customers. You will own the messaging, enablement and proof that make our enterprise offer easy to understand, easy to trust and easy to buy, in long sales cycles with engineers, business leaders and the C-suite around the table.
