c697efab60721d8f.title: Scientific Account Executive
c697efab60721d8f.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

b9f389cccabe0ec5.description:
Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

The Role

As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders.

  • National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint.

  • Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth.

  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams.

  • Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct.

  • Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance.

  • Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential.

  • Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains.

  • Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders.

  • Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision.

  • Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy.

AI in our hiring process

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

Â 

Our Approach to AI

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

c902fa42c82e8746.description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset.

About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

9c2d8e55197727f3.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

901e5dccad6e6b57.description:
General Summary
The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME).

We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.


Specific Duties and Responsibilities
â¢Independently lead and/or perform all data management activities within an assigned study (e.g., study startup, study conduct, study closeout, and reporting). *
â¢Serve as the data management SME on multidisciplinary project teams providing specific expertise on timeline development, identification of data management deliverables and resource requirements. *
â¢Participate in the creation, review, and maintenance of project timelines and monitor progress of data management activities. *
â¢Provide oversight for Data Management CRO and other vendors to ensure compliance with the protocol, external/internal standards, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, and other relevant guidelines.
â¢Ensure Data Management documentation is filed/archived according to applicable Penumbra and regulatory requirements. *
â¢Interact with data management, biostatistics, Clinical Affairs and Medical Affairs team to ensure integrity and quality of data. *
â¢Contribute ideas to the development of the department, identifying areas for improvement (e.g., SOPs, processes)
â¢Participates in audits and inspections. *
â¢Attend Investigator Meetings when requested to provide training on CRF data completion.
â¢Responsible for creation of training materials and training of the CRAs to ensure consistency of data entry at the sites. *
â¢Provide DM departmental training and to other teams, as needed.
â¢Utilizes reports to track study progress and ensure timeliness and quality expectations are met.
â¢Adhere to the Companyâs Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Understand relevant security, privacy and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company. *
â¢Ensure other members of the department follow the QMS, regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Perform other work-related duties as assigned.
*Indicates an essential function of the role


Required Qualifications
Minimum education and experience
â¢Bachelor's degree with 5+ years in a medical device, pharmaceutical company, or similar environment (e.g., CRO); or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred qualifications
â¢Masterâs degree with 3+ years of clinical research, pharmaceutical company preferred
â¢Thorough knowledge of effective clinical data management practices; CCDM certified professional a plus
â¢Must have strong experience with systems used for electronic capture of clinical trial data (e.g., iMedidata Rave, InForm, eClinicalOS, RedCap)
â¢This position must have experience working on regulatory trials within the medical device and/or pharmaceutical industry
â¢Position requires technical, organizational, analytical, and strong communication skills
â¢Knowledge of regulatory guidelines pertaining to data quality and data management
â¢Proven experience and in-depth understanding of all aspects of Data Management
â¢Ability to effectively manage change and multiple priorities
â¢Ability to operate independently and achieve results; ability to effectively deal with employees and business contacts and conveys a positive service-oriented attitude
â¢Knowledge of continuous improvement, project management, change management, and risk management
â¢Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated industry experience required
â¢Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

 

Working Conditions
â¢General office environment
â¢Willingness and ability to work on site.
â¢May have business travel from 0% - 5% to conferences and/or other Penumbra affiliated facilities.
â¢Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens
â¢Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds
â¢Must be able to move between buildings and floors.
â¢Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
â¢Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
â¢Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
â¢Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis. Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

 

Base Pay Range Per Hour: $50.00 - $80.00
Individual compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

\n


\n

What We Offer

â¢ A collaborative teamwork environment where learning is constant, and performance is rewarded.

â¢ The opportunity to be part of the team that is revolutionizing the treatment of some of the world's most devastating diseases.

â¢ A generous benefits package for eligible employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, short and long-term disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid parental leave, eleven paid company holidays per year, a minimum of fifteen days of accrued vacation per year, which increases with tenure, and paid sick time in compliance with applicable law(s).

 

Penumbra, Inc., headquartered in Alameda, California, is a global healthcare company focused on innovative therapies. Penumbra designs, develops, manufactures, and markets novel products and has a broad portfolio that addresses challenging medical conditions in markets with significant unmet need. Penumbra sells its products to hospitals and healthcare providers primarily through its direct sales organization in the United States, most of Europe, Canada, and Australia, and through distributors in select international markets. The Penumbra logo is a trademark of Penumbra, Inc.

If you reside in the State of California, please also refer to Penumbra's Privacy Notice for California Residents.

fab16a272315f8d7.title: Environment Artist
fab16a272315f8d7.description:
About Techtive Games

Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem, an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded.

We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.

In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights.

One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building.

We value creativity, ownership, and personal growth. Rather than working through rigid ticket pipelines, our team members are encouraged to actively shape systems, improve workflows, and grow together not only on Ardem, but on future projects as well.

If you love building worlds players want to get lost in — and you've survived a few of them yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

Tasks

On a day to day basis, you will:

  • Create high-poly and low-poly models for environmental objects — with a clear focus on architecture: modular building kits, structures, and props

  • Overhaul and optimize our existing asset kits: consolidate materials, reduce poly counts, and bring everything to a consistent, performant standard

  • Create assets for bespoke landmark locations — the kind of places players remember

  • Design with modularity and reusability in mind, so our world artists can build more with less

  • Rework existing vegetation and natural assets to a cleaner, more maintainable standard where needed

  • Work from photo reference and concept art to hit a believable, grounded look

  • Produce clean, efficient UVs and game-ready assets that respect the technical limitations of a large open world

  • Work closely with World Art, Level Design, and Tech Art to ensure requirements are met

  • Help troubleshoot and fix problems as they arise, from a visual, technical, and production perspective

Requirements

  • Previous experience on professional game projects

  • A portfolio with clear examples of your own asset production — not just set dressing or kit-bashed scenes. On team pieces, tell us exactly which parts you made yourself; we do check.

  • Solid experience building modular asset kits, and a real understanding of how worlds are constructed from them

  • Strong modeling skills and experience in a major 3D package (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max)

  • Sculpting experience with software like ZBrush

  • Good understanding of the PBR material pipeline

  • Solid grasp of baking and texturing using the Substance Suite and Photoshop

  • Basic knowledge of shader creation

  • Ability to resolve issues from a visual, technical, and production perspective

  • Strong communication skills — you can articulate ideas and questions across departments, and give and receive constructive feedback

  • We’d appreciate a link to your Steam profile, so we can get a feel for where your interests lie and where they overlap with ours

  • Fluent spoken and written English

Bonus Skills

  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine 5

  • Knowledge of foliage creation

  • Experience with procedural workflows (e.g. Houdini)

  • Experience working on open world games

  • Experience working in an indie or small team environment

Working Model

  • Fully remote

  • Freelance, with a full time option for candidates based in Germany

  • Flexible working hours with a strong focus on ownership and trust

  • Direct collaboration within a small, focused team

Benefits

  • Work on Ardem, a highly anticipated survival game — and help set a new benchmark for the genre you love

  • Small team with high impact, results-driven mindset and fast decision-making

  • High ownership and creative freedom — shape the world, don't just fill tickets

  • Flexible working hours (results > green dots)

How We Hire

  1. First interview — We talk about Techtive, Ardem, and the role, and get a high-level picture of your skills and how you work.

  2. Art test — If the first conversation goes well, you'll receive a small art test: a basic brief with a few guidelines and some inspirational screenshots from Ardem. Everything you build should work as part of a larger environment — we're not looking for isolated beauty shots that would fall apart in an actual game world. There's no fixed deadline, but we'll ask you to track roughly where your time went.

  3. Second interview — We go through your art test together: your decisions, your process, and where you spent your time.

  4. Culture fit — The final conversation is less about craft and more about people: how you like to work, what you expect from a team, and whether we actually fit each other. We're a small, fully remote crew — who you are matters as much as what you build. The practical side (contract, conditions, start date) gets sorted here too.

We know an art test is a real time investment, and not everyone can afford that easily — we don't take it for granted. It's the fairest way we've found to judge actual craft over a polished portfolio, and it's the basis for a much better conversation in round two.

Contact us

Contact us if you would like to know more! If you are motivated to work in a friendly start-up environment in the exciting field of machine learning and VR, do not hesitate to send us a full application (cover letter, contact details, CV, references, diplomas, relevant projects). Applications can be in English or German.

About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com


Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.


Ready to level up your career?

Playtech‘s Casino is looking for a Game Artist with with strong Photoshop and graphic design skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to create high-quality game art in a variety of visual styles.


Your influential mission. You will...

  • Create artwork for games and related products, including symbols, backgrounds, characters, logos and user interface elements, in styles ranging from realistic to cartoon.
  • Design marketing materials for games and products, such as icons, banners and posters.
  • Create and deliver high-quality 2D assets in line with platform specifications and technical requirements.
  • Create and manage the PSD structure of game packages, including the required game and product previews.
  • Contribute actively to the game creation process by collaborating with the Lead Artist and Game Producer.
  • Meet project deadlines and milestones in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work across multiple games or projects simultaneously, following priorities set by your manager.
  • Learn and use proprietary tools developed specifically for the team’s workflow.


Components for success. You...

  • Have advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and a strong portfolio demonstrating digital, traditional and graphic art techniques.
  • Bring graphic design skills or experience, including branding and logo design, typography, text layout, marketing banners and icons.
  • Understand game asset creation, export and optimization.
  • Show strong attention to detail and follow task specifications and requirements accurately.
  • Are self-motivated, proactive and well organized, with strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Have at least an intermediate level of spoken English.
  • Approach feedback positively, both when giving and receiving it during game production.
  • Can multitask and adapt quickly to changing priorities and fast-track projects.


You'll get extra points for...

  • Animation skills, particularly with Spine.
  • Familiarity with art styles and trends in the gaming industry.
  • Professional experience in the gaming industry or a similar field.
  • Experience using Jira.
  • An excellent instinct for finding the perfect GIF at the perfect time.


Thrive in a culture that values...

  • Professional growth and learning opportunities within the gaming industry.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • A warm, friendly environment where you can be yourself.
  • Collaboration, creativity, proactive communication and constructive feedback.


HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please include a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant game art and slot game projects. You can add it in the comment section at the end of the application page, under “your message to the hiring manager”.


PLAYTECH ORIGINS STUDIO

Playtech Origins Studio serves as the original powerhouse, crafting the company's most iconic digital experiences. Innovation thrives here, with the team constantly pushing boundaries and delivering exceptional quality. The studio is responsible for some of Playtech's most popular interactive experiences and content collections. With a diverse group of expert designers located across various parts of the world, Playtech Origins Studio brings innovative and engaging digital experiences to users. The team environment is fun and positive, promoting a professional, helpful, and supportive atmosphere that encourages growth. A strong sense of belonging among team members creates an excellent place to build a career. The team also offers ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, ensuring employees can reach their full potential.


Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

95739a5c19a06f7c.title: Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch), Schwerpunkt FinTech
95739a5c19a06f7c.description:
Wir suchen eine:n in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, im Frankfurter Raum oder mit hoher Reisebereitschaft einen Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch) mit Schwerpunkt FinTech, der:die den gesamten Prozess digitaler Produktentwicklung souverän beherrscht und Projekte in dynamischen Kontexten und Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich führen kann und sowohl strategisch als auch operativ auf Senior-Niveau agiert.

Taikonauten entwickelt digitale Produkte, Services und Plattformen für Organisationen aus Branchen wie Finance, FinTech, Mobility sowie Industrial & Manufacturing. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Angebote im Kontext von digitaler Transformation, Produktinnovation und Acceleration strategisch und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei arbeiten wir explorativ, konzeptionell tief und mit hohem gestalterischem Anspruch – immer mit starkem Fokus auf Nutzerzentrierung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten UX- und Product-Design-Prozess (Discovery bis Delivery)

  • Strukturierung unscharfer Problemstellungen (Problem Framing, Scope, Hypothesen)

  • Einbringung deiner fachlichen Perspektive und deines Beratungsstils in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen

  • Entwicklung tragfähiger UX-Konzepte für komplexe digitale Produkte

  • Erstellung von Informationsarchitekturen, User Journeys und End-to-End-Flows

  • Übersetzung von Anforderungen in testbare UX-Spezifikationen

  • Planung und Durchführung qualitativer Research-Formate (Interviews, Tests, Workshops)

  • Strukturierte Synthese von Insights und Ableitung belastbarer Empfehlungen

  • Konzeption und Ausarbeitung visuell hochwertiger UI-Designs und Design-Systeme

  • Moderation von Workshops zur Projektinitialisierung, Zielbilddefinition und Priorisierung

  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Development-Teams während der Umsetzung

  • Eigenständige Strukturierung komplexer Projektphasen

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung mit parallelen Projekten und wechselnden Kunden

  • Fundierte Expertise in fachlich-strategischer UX-Konzeption

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Erfahrung in digitaler Produktentwicklung

  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse

  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren

  • Sehr hoher Anspruch an visuelle Qualität (Layout, Typografie, Design-Systeme)

  • Strategisches Verständnis von Digital Strategy und Service Design

  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

Arbeitsweise & Haltung

  • Systemisches Denken und strukturierte Problemanalyse

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Projektumfeldern

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenständig zu setzen

  • Anspruch, Designqualität aktiv zu vertreten und zu verteidigen

  • Offenheit und Interesse an KI-Tools sowie KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über die reine Designrolle hinaus zu übernehmen

  • Reisebereitschaft über mehrere Tage mit Übernachtungen, auch spontan

Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen B2B- oder Enterprise-Plattformen

  • Data Analyse-Erfahrung (Analytics, Conversion-Optimierung)

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum, SAFe o.ä.)

  • Grundverständnis technischer Architektur (APIs, Frontend-Strukturen)

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder der Skalierung von Design-Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, sowie Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Prozessen und Workflows

  • Internationale Projekterfahrung

Benefits

Was wir für dich haben

  • Passionierte Kolleg:innen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie

  • Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert

  • Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen

  • Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet

Wie es weitergeht

Du hast Lust, große Schiffe für die digitale Zukunft fit zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Portfolio und Lebenslauf oder dem Link zu deiner Website und deine Wünsche für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.

Bitte verrate uns in deinem Anschreiben, wann du zur Verfügung stehen würdest, zu wievielen Wochenstunden und was dein gehaltswunsch ist.

Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden

Dann freuen wir uns auf viele Fragen von dir und ein gutes Kennenlernen.
Denn bei einem ersten positiven Eindruck sprichst du kurz mit Nancy. Im zweiten Gespräch lernst du die Teamleitung kennen. Das dritte Gespräch findet dann mit der Geschäftsführung statt.
Uns ist bewusst, dass das ein langer Weg sein kann, uns ist aber auch wichtig, dass es am Ende ein volles Ja von dir wird, nachdem du die Chance hattest, alle Ebenen deines zukünftigen Wirkens bei den Taikonauten kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)

  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse

  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren

  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

Arbeitsweise & Haltung

  • Systemisches Denken und strukturierte Problemanalyse

  • Fähigkeit, Unsicherheit produktiv zu strukturieren

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstorganisation

  • Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Projektumfeldern

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenständig zu setzen

Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss

  • Internationale Projekterfahrung

Benefits

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet

Wie es weitergeht

Du hast Lust, große Schiffe für die digitale Zukunft fit zu machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Portfolio und Lebenslauf oder dem Link zu deiner Website und deine Wünsche für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.

Bitte verrate uns in deinem Anschreiben, wann du zur Verfügung stehen würdest, zu wievielen Wochenstunden und was dein gehaltswunsch ist.

Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden

Dann freuen wir uns auf viele Fragen von dir und ein gutes Kennenlernen.
Denn bei einem ersten positiven Eindruck sprichst du kurz mit Nancy. Im zweiten Gespräch lernst du die Teamleitung kennen. Das dritte Gespräch findet dann mit der Geschäftsführung statt.
Uns ist bewusst, dass das ein langer Weg sein kann, uns ist aber auch wichtig, dass es am Ende ein volles Ja von dir wird, nachdem du die Chance hattest, alle Ebenen deines zukünftigen Wirkens bei den Taikonauten kennenzulernen.

Enjoy solving complex backend challenges, working with distributed systems, and having a real say in technical decisions?

Join our Email Security team as a Senior Backend Engineer and help build, improve, and evolve the backend services powering our cybersecurity products.

You'll work in a technically demanding environment where performance, scalability, reliability, and security matter. From improving existing systems to designing new services, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges and influence how our products evolve.

Full-time hybrid in Hanover.

Your Job

  • Take technical ownership of existing and new applications or services within our cybersecurity product ecosystem.

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

  • Lead and contribute to architectural decisions and help shape long-term technical direction.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other developers, product management, system engineers, UX/UI, and QA teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Mentor and support Junior Developers, fostering best practices and continuous improvement.

  • Work across multiple products, contributing to new features, improvements, and long-term maintenance.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Software Developer, with a strong focus on backend development.

  • Strong Python experience, experience with Java or Go is a plus.

  • Experience designing, operating, and optimizing relational or non-relational databases. Experience with Elasticsearch, SQL databases, or Redis is especially relevant.

  • Comfortable working in UNIX-based environments, especially Linux.

  • Strong experience building and maintaining scalable, high-quality software within complex, distributed systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, structured thinking, and a high sense of ownership.

  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in any of the following areas would be useful, but you don't need to tick every box.

  • Experience with designing and maintaining systems hosted on-premises.

  • Basic DevOps skills and experience with Ansible.

  • Experience in cybersecurity or email software.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted or agent-based development workflows.

  • Basic Angular knowledge.

Your Benefits

  • Room for innovation and autonomy in a fast-growing international company.

  • Temporary Employee Exchange Program – we provide the ability for you to work at our global office locations and explore the world (e.g. Berlin, Madrid, Malta, Montréal, Washington D.C.).

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.

  • Permanent contracts – we’re in it for the long haul and hope you are too!

  • Team events like Laser Tag, Office Movie Nights, Foodie Fridays and much more – let yourself be surprised!

  • FitKit subscription and private insurance for your health!

  • Referral Bonus: we pay 1500€ for each referral who is successfully hired by us!

Plus

  • A focus on work-life balance and sustainable performance.

  • A daily stand-up at around 14:00.

  • No Friday deployments.

  • No on-call shifts.

  • Support for long-term learning and development.

82a1505f6c3c257a.title: IT-Teamleiter (m/w/d)
82a1505f6c3c257a.description:
Bei der INCAS GmbH, einer Tochtergesellschaft der think about IT GmbH und einem seit fast 30 Jahren führenden Unternehmen in der Technologie-, Informations- und Internetbranche, bieten wir Ihnen die einzigartige Möglichkeit, als IT-Teamleiter (m/w/d) Teil unseres dynamischen Teams zu werden.

In dieser essenziellen Rolle bist Du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren mittelständischen Kundinnen und Kunden, unserem 12-köpfigen IT-Team und dem Vertrieb. Du bist verantwortlich für die technisch und kaufmännisch saubere Abwicklung von Projekten. Dies beinhaltet den Bereich Planung, Ausführung und Kontrolle. Mit Deinem tiefgreifenden Verständnis für IT-Sicherheit, IT-Netzwerke und Deiner Leidenschaft für Technologie wirst Du direkt dazu beitragen, die Daten und Systeme unserer Kundinnen und Kunden vor den ständig wechselnden Bedrohungen der digitalen Welt zu schützen. Wir bieten Dir ein herausfordernde Position in einem innovativen und wachsenden Unternehmen, in dem Deine Arbeit geschätzt wird und Du die Möglichkeit hast, Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung, Konzeption sowie Implementierung und Überwachung von ganzheitlichen IT-Sicherheitskonzepten

  • Durchführung von Sicherheitsanalysen und Risikobewertungen

  • Verwaltung von Firewalls, VPNs und anderen Sicherheitsinfrastrukturen

  • Mitgestaltung der weitergehenden Ausrichtung und Definition von Schwerpunkten im IT-Security- und Netzwerk-Team

  • Schulung von Mitarbeitenden zu Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Best Practices

Das bringen Sie mit

  • erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • erste Erfahrungen im Bereich IT-Sicherheit und IT-Netzwerk

  • Kenntnisse in der Admministration von Netzwerken und Servern

  • eigenverantwortliches und strukturiertes Aerbeiten

  • Teamfähigkeit sowie hohe Service- und Kundenorientierung

  • sichere Präsentationskompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke

  • Erfahrung im Projektteam

  • Personalverantwortung

Benefits

  • flexible Home-Office Regelungen

  • umfangreiches Onboarding ergänzt durch unser Buddy-Programm

  • vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur Vermögensbildung

  • einen repräsentativen, modernen und klimatisierten Arbeitsplatz

  • kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten vor der Tür

  • vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge

  • hoher Grad der persönlichen Entfaltung sowie individuelle Förderung

  • gemeinsame Freizeitaktivitäten

Freue Dich auf ein Team, welches auch abseits der Arbeit zusmmenhält. Auf unserer Website gewinnst Du einen ersten persönlichen Eindruck und erfährst, was die thinkGROUP auszeichnet.

Du und die thinkGROUP - das passt?

Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mmit Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

Bei fachlichen Rückfragen vermitteln wir Dir gerne schnell und unkompliziert den Kontakt zur Fachabteilung.

b710d919e7c59fe7.title: Working Student Communications (f/m/d)
b710d919e7c59fe7.description:
01 · Why this role exists

This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk.

RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. You'll change that.

02 · What you'll do

You'll be our communications all-rounder and work directly with the founders and the go-to-market team.

  • Storytelling: Turn customer projects, technology and energy-market developments into stories that a CFO or plant manager reads to the end.

  • Video: Make short videos about customer projects and RIZMO, from concept and editing through to sign-off with the customer.

  • PR: Pitch stories to business and trade media (Handelsblatt, manager magazin and others), write press releases and prepare interviews.

  • LinkedIn: Plan and write content for our company page, and help the founders and GTM team with their own posts. We don't do Instagram, TikTok or blogs. Our audience is on LinkedIn and reads Handelsblatt.

  • Events: Prepare our presence at trade fairs like E-world and Hannover Messe. That covers materials, booking meetings in advance and following up with the contacts we make.

  • B2B marketing for long sales cycles: Our deals take months and involve many decision-makers. You'll build case studies and one-pagers that support a deal from first contact to signature.

03 · What you bring

  • Student status: You're enrolled at a university. Your field doesn't matter (communications, journalism, business, industrial engineering, energy …) as long as you write well.

  • Languages: Excellent German and good English.

  • Curiosity: Energy, industry and AI interest you. We'll teach you the technical side.

  • Ownership: You work independently, ask when something is unclear, and deliver.

  • Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization.

  • Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer.

04 · What we offer

  • Pay: €16 per hour.

  • Real ownership: From day one, you'll help build our communications from the ground up.

  • Short paths: A direct line to the founders and fast decisions.

  • Stories worth telling: Customers everyone knows.

05 · How to apply

You love telling stories? Then tell us two. No cover letter needed:

  1. What topic could you explain for hours without ever getting bored?

  2. What experience from your studies shaped you more than any exam?

1cc941b15680a90f.description:
Wir suchen Dich:

Du kannst dich für Software, Hardware und Netzwerke begeistern?

Super, dann haben wir ein Match!

Wir suchen einen ambitionierten Auszubildenden zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (gn).

Wofür steht Remmert:

Remmert ist spezialisiert auf automatisierte Lager- und Logistiksysteme. Wir wissen, wie man Bleche, Langgüter und Werkstücke platzsparend lagert und vollautomatisch bewegt. Maschienenbau/ Automation/Logistik - eine Branche mit Zukunftsperspektive!

Seit 1945 sind wir ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen und das leben wir - Entwicklungsperspektiven, Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Aufgaben

Was du garantiert nach deiner 3-jährigen Ausbildung bei Remmert
kannst:

  • IT-Systeme wie Clients, Server und Netzwerkkomponenten planen, installieren, konfigurieren und in Betrieb nehmen

  • Netzwerke aufbauen und betreuen, von Switches und WLAN über VPN bis zur Firewall

  • Server, virtuelle Umgebungen und Cloud-Dienste verwalten und weiterentwickeln

  • Benutzer, Berechtigungen und Lizenzen verwalten, z. B. im Active Directory und in Microsoft 365

  • IT-Sicherheit umsetzen: Updates und Patches einspielen, Backups einrichten und prüfen, Schutzmaßnahmen nach Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorgaben umsetzen

  • Systeme überwachen, Störungen systematisch analysieren und dauerhaft beheben

  • Anfragen über das Ticketsystem bearbeiten, priorisieren und Lösungen sauber dokumentieren

  • IT-Projekte mitgestalten, z. B. Rollouts, Migrationen oder die Einführung neuer Software, auch an den Schnittstellen zu Produktion, Konstruktion und Verwaltung

Im Team unserer internen IT sorgst du dafür, dass bei Remmert alles läuft, von der Infrastruktur im Hintergrund bis zum Arbeitsplatz der Kolleg:innen. Dabei bist du Ansprechpartner für alle IT-Fragen im Haus.

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreicher Abschluss der Allgemeinen- oder Fachhochschulreife

  • Technisches Verständnis und erste relevante Kenntnisse

  • Analytisches und logisches Denkvermögen

  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und Teamfähigkeit

  • Aufgeschlossenheit, Einsatzfreude und Lernbereitschaft

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Optional:

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen im technischen Bereich durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten

Benefits

  • Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub

  • Ermöglichung eines Auslandsaufenthaltes für Azubis

  • Betriebliche Zusatzversicherung „Remmert Gesundheitskonto 600“ für jeden Mitarbeiter (gn): Jährliches persönliches Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 600 EUR Nettowert für z. B. ärztliche Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, Arznei-, Heil- und Hilfsmittel wie Hörgeräte und Sehhilfen (inkl. Sehschärfenkorrekturen), medizinische Massagen und Maßnahmen, Zahnersatz und Zahnprophylaxe, Naturheilverfahren u. v. m.

  • Bezuschussung von Zahnersatz von bis zu 70 Prozent

  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (u. A. Gesundheitschecks, Vorsorgemaßnahmen während der Arbeitszeit, Laufgruppen, Teilnahme an Firmenläufen)

  • Sonderboni wie Gewinnbeteiligung, Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter, E-Bike Leasing

  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr – auch während der Arbeitszeiten

  • Entwicklungsperspektiven in Form von jährlichen Gehalts- und Jahresgesprächen (360 Grad)

  • Förderung von Weiterbildungen mit vorhandenem Weiterbildungskatalog für alle Berufsgruppen

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge durch ein Zuschussmodell mit attraktiven Arbeitgeberbeiträgen

Dabei entwickeln wir uns kontinuierlich weiter und erschließen neue Anwendungsfelder für unsere Technologien. Gerade bei Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen entstehen neue Anforderungen und damit neue Möglichkeiten für moderne Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Sales Manager für Süddeutschland entwickelst du unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden weiter. Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, gewinnst neue Kunden, entwickelst bestehende Key Accounts und bringst unsere technischen Lösungen mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden zusammen.

Dabei bist du regelmäßig bei bestehenden und potenziellen Kunden vor Ort und baust dein Netzwerk in der Region kontinuierlich aus.

Kanzlei Brands unterstützt Kanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Gewinnung von Fachkräften, der Positionierung als Arbeitgeber und der Mandantengewinnung. Dafür entstehen bei uns jede Woche Videos, Social-Media-Posts, Anzeigen und Reports.

Wir suchen Dich als Werkstudent, der Videos schneiden kann und ein Gefühl für gute Inhalte hat.

Diese Stelle ist auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt:
Wenn es passt, übernehmen wir Dich nach Deinem Studium in eine Festanstellung im Content- und Performance-Marketing.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du schneidest Videos aus unseren Dreh- und Foto-Tagen, für unsere Kunden und für Kanzlei Brands.

  • Du erstellst Reels, Carousels und Anzeigen-Creatives in mehreren Varianten.

  • Du unterstützt uns bei Reports, Leadmagneten und Direktmailings mit Grafik und Layout.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing und unserer Social-Media-Betreuung zusammen.


Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Übernahmeperspektive: Nach Deinem Studium ist eine Festanstellung bei uns ausdrücklich das Ziel.

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung: Deine Arbeitszeiten passen wir an Vorlesungen und Prüfungsphasen an.

  • Echte Projekte: Deine Arbeit geht live, bei Kunden und in unseren eigenen Kampagnen.

  • Weiterbildung: Unser digitales Schulungssystem und regelmäßige Trainings bringen Dich weiter.

  • Gute Arbeitsmittel: Hochwertige Ausstattung, aktuelle Apple-Geräte und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische.

  • Zentraler Standort: Modernes Büro in der Hamburger Mönckebergstraße.

  • Wertschätzendes Team: Wir erreichen Ziele gemeinsam und feiern unsere Erfolge.

  • Gründliche Einarbeitung: Mit klaren Prozessen, Checklisten und digitalen Schulungen.



Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation, Design oder Marketing.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Premiere Pro, CapCut oder DaVinci Resolve sowie mit Canva oder Adobe.

  • Du hast ein Gefühl für Social-Media-Formate, Tempo und starke Einstiege.

  • Du hast ein Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben, die Du uns zeigen kannst.

  • Du bist zuverlässig und übernimmst gern Verantwortung.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch.

98ed93dee18665fb.title: Senior Simulation Engineering – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain (m/f/d)
98ed93dee18665fb.description:
About the role:

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. You will tackle complex technical challenges hands-on, challenge existing approaches, identify limitations, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our simulation environment.

As a senior engineer, you will also act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with engineers across autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex simulation needs into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces and requirements across teams and ensure that our simulation capabilities address real engineering challenges and become an integral part of autonomy development, continuous testing, and system-level verification.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of simulation capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the simulation systems used for autonomy development, testing, and verification.

  • Design and develop scalable simulation solutions, building realistic, reliable, and reproducible environments that enable autonomy software to be tested across complex scenarios before deployment on physical vehicles.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate autonomy and verification needs into technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into clear simulation concepts, priorities, and implementation plans.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating technical limitations, improving simulation fidelity and performance, and solving problems that require deep technical expertise.

  • Drive collaboration across the Land Domain, working closely with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams to identify where simulation provides the greatest engineering value.

  • Keep simulation closely connected to the real system, using field data, vehicle testing, real-world failures, and operational feedback to continuously improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing technical approaches, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards, development practices, and continuous improvement.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address scalability, maintainability, integration, and verification challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for simulation, communicating technical challenges, architectural decisions, dependencies, and opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.




What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous driving, physical systems, vehicle dynamics, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in simulation and autonomous systems, with experience designing, building, and evolving complex simulation environments used for development, testing, and verification.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience building or extending simulation infrastructure using technologies such as CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, or comparable simulation environments.

  • Solid understanding of physical simulation and autonomous systems, including areas such as vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), scenario-based testing, and the trade-offs between simulation fidelity, performance, determinism, and scalability.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around scalability, maintainability, reliability, and system quality.

  • Proven ability to solve complex engineering problems hands-on, including debugging system-level issues, evaluating technical trade-offs, challenging existing approaches, and developing pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across engineering disciplines, collaborating effectively with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams.

  • Experience connecting simulation with real-world systems, using vehicle testing, field data, operational feedback, and real-world failures to improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship, supporting other engineers through design discussions, code and architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, influence engineering decisions, align stakeholders, and drive technical topics across organizational boundaries.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.
