About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We'd love for you to become a key part of our Python Infrastructure team; a collaborative group that's always pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

In this role, you'll get to do it all: designing and integrating powerful new APIs that genuinely improve our customers' experience, optimising our lending platforms for performance and scale, and diving into the kind of deep architectural conversations that engineers get excited about.

No two days look the same here.

We're building something great, and we're looking for the right people to grow with us. If that sounds like you, we can't wait to hear from you.

Our Tech Stack

Our stack is built on Python and FastAPI, deployed via Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, with ArgoCD handling our continuous delivery pipeline.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong, modern Python development experience

  • A good understanding of a modern web framework - FastAPI

  • Strong automatic testing skills (unit, integration, functional)

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

  • If you’ve worked in a cross functional environment, it would be a plus but not needed

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with one of the team

  • A short coding exercise to complete in your own time

  • Technical Video Interview for 60 mins

    • Meet the team you’ll work with daily

  • Culture interview for 30mins

  • Final Interview

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

We’re looking for an Affiliate & Influencer Acquisition Executive whose core mission is sourcing brand-new partners — not just managing the ones we already have. Reporting to a Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll own the full new-partner funnel end-to-end: mapping affiliates and influencers we don’t work with yet, running outbound outreach, and negotiating CPA or fixed-fee deals structured so every partnership delivers measurable, incremental customer acquisition.

This is an acquisition-first partnership seat: you’ll spend as much time prospecting and pitching new affiliates and influencers as you do modelling payback economics. If you think in CPA, fixed-fee and incremental CAC as naturally as you think in relationships, this role is built for you.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

• Proven track record sourcing and closing brand-new affiliate or influencer partnerships from scratch this is a new-business role, not just account management

• 2-3+ years in affiliate marketing, acquisition or performance marketing roles for a consumer brand

• Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics – CPA, fixed-fee, LTV, ROI and blended CAC and confident structuring CPA or fixed-fee deals that guarantee incremental acquisition

• Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

• Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

• Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

• Strong account / relationship management skills

• Comfortable with the data — channel economics, attribution and ROI

• Highly organised and detail-oriented — you can run multiple activations in parallel

• Strong commercial communicator — you can hold your own with senior partners

• Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

• Experience in fintech or financial services

• Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

• Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize, Income access) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

• Experience building an affiliate or influencer programme from 0 to 1 in a consumer brand

You’re a good fit if you’re:

• An experienced affiliate marketer who has sourced new customer-acquisition channels, not just managed existing ones

• A natural relationship-builder — partners trust you, and so does your team

• Commercially literate first, relationship-led second – you measure success in growth, not vanity

• Data-fluent – you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

• Hands-on and resourceful — you make things happen

• Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

New Partner Acquisition:

• Proactively map the affiliate and influencer landscape to identify new partners who can drive incremental customer acquisition

• Run outbound outreach and pitch new affiliates and influencers, building and working a pipeline of prospective partners

• Negotiate and close new commercial deals primarily CPA or fixed-fee structured so every new partner is measurably incremental

• Own onboarding and activation of every new partner, from signed deal through to first live campaign

Commercial & Performance:

• Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners —

prioritising CPA and fixed-fee structures that tie partner pay to genuine incremental customer acquisition — and know which model fits each partner

• Own the unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

• Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

• Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

• Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end — brief, plan, ship, measure

• Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

• Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Affiliate Management:

• Own the affiliate relationship from first contact — be the trusted operator they call first, from outreach and onboarding through to ongoing management

• Manage budgets and timelines across activations

• Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

• Track partnership performance against targets — CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

• Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

• Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

• Partner with creative on activation assets

• Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

• Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

d34a7a77298825ea.title: Technical Lead
d34a7a77298825ea.description:
📍Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Street.co.uk is our game-changing CRM: a truly modern estate agency platform, creating a next-level digital experience for customers, putting transparency, user experience and beautiful design at the heart of our industry.

Spectre is our multi-award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%, covering direct mail, email, social media and digital reports.

As a Technical Lead, you’ll lead one of our Agent Experience teams, which owns Street’s core CRM and sales product. It’s used every day by tens of thousands of estate agents for managing viewings, valuations, sales, and other business critical operations making the customer impact tangible and measurable.

You’ll lead a small cross-functional team, contributing to discovery and ideation, and work alongside designers, product owners and engineers in order to identify, prioritise and solve problems iteratively.

Our Technical Leads stay hands-on, leading from the front to make sure we build the right thing, in the right way. It’s a key role to make sure we continue to regularly deliver amazing new products and features to our customers. You’ll also work closely with other Technical Leads and Engineering Managers to help guide wider-scale improvements to our platform.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Technical Lead at Street

  • Supporting, leading and coaching a small but highly talented cross-functional team

  • Being hands-on with building best-in-class software across a wide domain

  • Being a driving force behind best programming practices and taking your team on that journey with you

  • Working at scale, building tools and systems that can withstand rapid adoption and maintain stability long term

  • Collaborating closely with our in-house Data team, our customers, and commercial colleagues in the business in order to build the best product we can

A bit about you

  • You’re an experienced Engineer with existing or prior experience with production-grade PHP and JS (and you’re keen to remain hands-on)

  • Additionally, Laravel experience is advantageous.

  • You have experience with Cloud (AWS and/or GCP)

  • You’ve had some experience with building and working within distributed systems

  • You’re a passionate advocate for best practices, particularly around AI-first development, and continuous improvement

  • You’ve had experience building and operating production systems at scale

  • You have experience bringing people on a journey to build things better

  • You have strong empathy, communication and collaboration skills

  • You care about empowering your team and working together to find the best solutions

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working, you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🕒 Flexible working hours
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and were about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

 

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages plus a take home task = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview > Final interview with our Co-Founder and Head of Engineering.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

89d6a9211df20f53.title: Content Marketing Lead
89d6a9211df20f53.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

About the Role

Join a software team building AI-powered workflows for certification, inspection, and compliance. You will work directly with customers to understand their operations, then build and refine production software that addresses real-world needs.

What You'll Do

  • Embed with customer operations teams to understand how certification, inspection, and compliance work in practice.

  • Lead customer conversations, write specifications, and build end-to-end systems across the frontend, backend, data model, and AI layer.

  • Take ownership of product areas and ship working software quickly, iterating based on direct user feedback.

  • Assess which customer requests can serve broader needs and make sound decisions about what to build.

  • Review customer documents and outputs to develop AI-powered workflows for scheduling, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence.

What We're Looking For

  • Three to six years of experience as a software engineer or product engineer, with a record of shipping production systems.

  • Full-stack development skills, including Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or document intelligence.

  • Experience building products or systems from the ground up, ideally in an early-stage startup or customer-facing engineering role.

  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating complex operational workflows into software.

  • Background in SaaS or adjacent technology, with strong technical fundamentals.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: £100,000 to £160,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

On-site in England, United Kingdom.

af305ee4b793c539.title: Senior Customer Service Advisor
af305ee4b793c539.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. The Operations function within Allica has wide-ranging responsibilities supporting the customers of all product lines (Commercial Mortgages, Asset Finance, Deposits and Payment Account with aligned card activity), alongside our own internal stakeholders. We are particularly focused on the following, ensuring that the bank adheres to all relevant Regulatory requirements and our own internal policies and procedures at all times:

  • Slick digital account opening, and in life servicing.

  • Customer contact via telephony, email and in-app communications.

  • Payment and reconciliation activity.

  • Treasury operations.

  • Customer due diligence through Know Your Customer, Know Your Business.

  • Lending pipeline management.

  • Quality assurance and control.

  • Issue resolution.

  • Effective record keeping and data management.

  • Support of all change initiatives.

Role Description

The Customer Service Advisor will be responsible for 1st line customer service support for the Bank’s Retail and SME customers via Chat (Online) and Telephony, together with Back Office activities to support the smooth running of the function.

They will be the focal point for customers – delivering exceptional service whilst living our values and speaking a language our customers will understand and understanding the business and banking challenges our customers face.

Principal Accountabilities

• To field inbound communications from customers – either over voice, chat or social media – to action their requests, resolve their issues and manage complaints through to resolution.

• You’ll be responsible for case management, and this may include outbound customer communications, payments and letter writing.

• Some of the key exceptions you’ll be dealing with will include KYC, complaints, vulnerable customers, deceased/power of attorney cases and SME customers who might have complex needs.

• To proactively identify areas for process improvement and to seek new and innovative ways to better serve the customer.

• To live and breathe the Bank’s values, representing the Bank to customers and speaking to customers in a way that resonates.

• To support other teams as appropriate, where customer communication or engagement is required.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong customer service experience, having worked in customer facing and or telephone service roles.

  • Experience using core banking systems and familiar with the use and application of social media as a form of interaction.

  • Experience in dealing with complex complaints and in taking ownership of customer concerns through to resolution.

  • Experience of core processes (e.g. account opening, servicing and closing, payments processing, complaint handling, KYC case referrals, general enquiry management)

  • Experience in working with workflow / task management tools

  • Knowledge of financial services rules and guidelines

  • Excellent oral and written skills as they will be constantly communicating with customers

  • Quickly react and adapt to stressful and difficult situations

  • Enthusiastic and articulate, whilst being motivated by a need to help people

  • A problem solver and can create positive customer outcomes in diverse situations

  • Conform to our ethical standards and conduct

  • Perform administrative tasks related to the customer interaction

  • Deliver outstanding customer service as measured through customer satisfaction KPIs

  • Manage and monitor service providers for customer quality

  • Drive customer service innovation and continuous improvement of process to deliver better customer outcomes

  • Act as an ambassador/advocate for Customer within the Bank

  • Adhere to quality control requirements and ensure compliance with policy

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

Compensation: £30K – £33K • Offers Bonus

16d7fa042300fd3d.title: Associate Relationship Manager - South West
16d7fa042300fd3d.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME customers delivering outstanding customer service, building genuine and trusting relationships and develop a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses and their ambitions.

  • Deliver against a range of commercial targets including lending and new customer / deposit acquisition, as well as identifying and meeting a range of client needs through the provision of Allica products and services.

  • Build a trusted external network with SME advisers and the wider business community. Leverage this network to generate new business opportunities for the bank, in addition to signposting your clients to external support and advice as appropriate.

  • Ensure that Risk is managed effectively on your portfolio, with all required risk activities completed on time and to a high standard. Use customer data and internal Allica systems to identify signs of client stress and take proactive action to tackle early.

  • Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage customer information and requests, portfolio tasks and follow-up actions accurately and at pace.

  • Practical understanding of customer service, sales activity and account management disciplines, ideally gained in a B2B, financial services or relationship-led environment.

  • Confident using systems, CRM tools and data to manage activity, track progress and support strong customer and risk outcomes.

  • Experience using AI tools in a business environment would also be of benefit.

  • An energetic, resilient, hands-on approach, with the confidence to get into the detail, solve problems and take ownership of outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with customers, prospects, advisers, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong alignment to Allica’s values, with the judgement, integrity and energy to lead by example and help contribute to the next phase of the Direct Relationship Management channel.

cb5f3a8080e70b5a.title: Senior Product Manager
cb5f3a8080e70b5a.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.

Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.

As a Senior Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on important strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to clients at well-known organisations on their product and AI strategies.

  • Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

  • Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

  • Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

  • Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

  • Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

  • Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

  • Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

  • Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

  • Coaching and developing other product managers.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale.

  • You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

  • Strong commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with leaders.

  • You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

  • You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

  • You have demonstrable experience in working with cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development practices and processes.

  • You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

  • You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.

Desirable experience

  • You have meaningful professional services or consulting experience, ideally with large enterprises.

  • You’ve worked in at least one scaled-up, fast-moving product-led organisation, owning significant scope and achieving meaningful impact.

  • You have experience in public speaking about product development and/or product management.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.

 

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.

  • Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.

  • Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

  • You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.

  • You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.

  • You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.

f9f3e29b7ecdae84.title: Solutions Engineer (CS)
f9f3e29b7ecdae84.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Engineer to help customers and internal teams explore what Cirrus Logic’s technologies can do in Automotive and Industrial applications. You will turn product capabilities and emerging customer needs into working solutions, proofs of concept, and compelling technical demonstrations.

This role, based in our Edinburgh office, combines electronic design, software, system integration, and practical problem-solving. You will develop and deliver working solutions that demonstrate the benefits of Cirrus Logic technologies, taking ownership of technical work from concept and prototyping through system integration, evaluation, and demonstration. You will collaborate with design, applications, systems, marketing, customers, and external partners


Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop system-level solutions and demonstrations using Cirrus Logic products across Automotive and Industrial applications.
  • Translate customer needs, use cases, and product capabilities into practical technical concepts and proofs of concept.
  • Design, prototype, bring up, and debug electronic hardware, including PCBs, evaluation boards, and supporting circuitry.
  • Integrate ICs, sensors, embedded software, signal paths, communications interfaces, and mechanical components into complete working systems.
  • Develop or adapt software, scripts, and basic user interfaces to configure, control, test, and demonstrate systems.
  • Plan and carry out evaluations, investigate system-level issues, and use measurements and hands-on assessment to guide improvements.
  • Work with internal engineering teams and external partners to define requirements, coordinate technical work, and deliver functional prototypes and demonstrations.
  • Prepare clear setup guides, technical documentation, and presentation materials so others can evaluate, operate, and explain the solutions.
  • Support customer engagements, internal reviews, and industry events by demonstrating solutions and explaining their technical value.
  • Travel internationally to support customers, tradeshows, and other business activities, expected to be approximately 4–6 weeks per year.
  • Contribute to the mechanical design and integration of prototypes and demonstrations, working with internal specialists or external partners where needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • A degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging electronic systems that combine hardware and software.
  • PCB design experience, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, prototype bring-up, and verification.
  • Confidence using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies, and signal generators.
  • Practical software skills sufficient to get prototypes and demonstrations working, including writing or adapting scripts, configuring embedded platforms, integrating APIs, and debugging hardware–software interactions.
  • The ability to use AI-assisted software development tools effectively, while reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting the resulting code.
  • Familiarity with common hardware interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, and audio interfaces such as I²S or TDM.
  • A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to move from a system-level symptom to a practical solution.
  • The ability to take ownership of deliverables, manage competing priorities, and make sound engineering decisions.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical work to people from different disciplines.
  • A willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to develop practical solutions.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience with Automotive or Industrial electronic systems, semiconductor products, or mixed-signal applications.
  • Familiarity with one or more relevant technology areas, such as audio, haptics, sensing, clocking and synchronisation, or power management, and their integration into practical systems.
  • Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, evaluation platforms, or customer-facing demonstrations.
  • Knowledge of networking and communications technologies used in Automotive or Industrial systems, such as Ethernet, CAN, LIN, EtherCAT, or PROFINET.
  • Familiarity with single-pair Ethernet technologies, such as 100BASE-T1, 10BASE-T1S, or 10BASE-T1L.
  • Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, Tier 1 suppliers, or external development partners.
  • Familiarity with relevant functional safety, qualification, or electromagnetic compatibility standards, such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, AEC-Q100, or CISPR 25.
  • Experience with mechanical design and integration, including basic CAD, enclosures, fixtures, mounting arrangements, and rapid prototyping techniques such as 3D printing.
  • Experience with system architecture, product definition, feasibility studies, teardowns, or competitive analysis.

This role is based in our Edinburgh, UK office.

This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

#LI-Hybrid

We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

At Cirrus Logic, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are committed to encouraging an open and collaborative culture where different approaches, ideas, and points of view are respected and valued. We aim to promote a workplace where everyone can contribute irrespective of race, colour, national origin, religion or belief, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or disability.

8bb6c288fa31e449.title: Solutions Engineer
8bb6c288fa31e449.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

Cirrus Logic is looking for a Solutions Engineer to investigate new technologies in robotics. You will design and build prototypes, develop laboratory set ups, run experiments, analyse data, and translate results into practical recommendations. Your work will help internal teams and customers understand how Cirrus Logic products and technologies could support robotics and other emerging applications.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, build and maintain proof of concepts, prototypes and laboratory setups for new applications and technologies.
  • Coordinate third-party prototyping houses, mechanical design services, and software providers to deliver proof-of-concept projects.
  • Plan and run experiments, including measurement, debug and data capture.
  • Analyse results and communicate clear conclusions, limitations and recommendations.
  • Work with systems engineering, design, applications and marketing teams to understand customer systems, perform basic teardowns and assess technical challenges.
  • Support technical customer discussions with data, demonstrations and practical insight.
  • Explain how device-level capabilities, limitations and trade-offs affect the wider system.
  • Improve lab capability by making experiments more repeatable, efficient and informative, and document useful outputs such as test reports, reference setups and technical notes.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:

    We are interested in evidence of the following capabilities. You do not need to meet every preferred criteria to apply.

  • Prior practical experience working with electronics or hardware in a professional laboratory, test or prototyping environment.
  • Experience building or modifying bench setups, prototype circuits or evaluation hardware.
  • Experience with PCB design, schematic capture or rapid prototyping.
  • Experience using some common laboratory equipment, such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, signal generators or power-measurement tools.
  • Ability to collect, interpret and explain technical data clearly, in writing and in conversation.
  • Familiarity with data capture, scripting or automation for laboratory work.
  • Ability to take a structured approach to open-ended problems and decide what to investigate next.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, applications and marketing colleagues.
  • Interest in applying electronics and hardware to robotics or other emerging applications. Previous robotics or related experience is helpful but not essential.

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • BEng or MEng degree in electronics engineering or a related discipline is preferred.  Equivalent experience gained through employment, will also be considered.
  • This is an experienced role requiring proven commercial professional experience in electronics, engineering, laboratory, test or prototyping work, with the ability to operate independently.
  • Mechanical design or practical electromechanical systems.
  • Experience programming embedded systems and/or FPGAs, including developing, debugging, and integrating hardware–software solutions.
  • Breaking complex problems into clear, actionable questions.
  • Writing technical reports, notes or recommendations for internal or customer use.

    • This role is based in our Edinburgh, UK office.

    This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic. 

    Success in this role means applying a structured approach to unfamiliar problems, building useful experiments and sharing findings clearly with a range of colleagues. We value different experiences and perspectives and encourage applications from people who meet the core requirements even if they do not match every preferred criterion.

     

    #LI-PD1
    #LI-Hybrid


    Export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit candidates who are nationals of certain embargoed countries from working in this position without Cirrus Logic first obtaining an export license.  Candidates for this role must be able to access technical data without a requirement for an export license. We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

    At Cirrus Logic, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are committed to encouraging an open and collaborative culture where different approaches, ideas, and points of view are respected and valued. We aim to promote a workplace where everyone can contribute irrespective of race, colour, national origin, religion or belief, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or disability.

db59b7b4709b4018.description:
Who We Are:
 
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

The Marketing Managers are responsible for building integrated marketing campaigns that drive pipeline for the sales team. They are focused on driving high-quality account engagement thru the marketing/sales funnel that results in bookings and revenue for the business. Sr. Marketing Managers are results-driven, creative and data-driven. They partner with sales, BDRs and across functions to ensure that our resources are maximized and we are supporting to drive new business at every touchpoint. They participate in regular team meetings and brainstorms and provide meaningful, actionable data to leadership.

What you'll do:
  • Campaign Support and Execution: Proactively execute North EMEA short and long-term multi-channel campaigns to drive leads and sales pipeline
  • Lead Generation: Ensure a consistent flow of qualified leads for the North EMEA Sales teams, and measure and report on critical sales funnel metrics
  • Program Effectiveness: Measure and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs and campaigns to improve resource allocation, efficiency, and revenue generation
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, the global marketing team, the agencies, and partner teams to deliver full-funnel marketing programs
  • Local-First Campaign Execution: Focus on executing campaigns tailored to specific market needs and verticals
  • Market Feedback: Provide feedback to broader teams about market conditions, highlighting successful strategies and areas for improvement
  • Support Regional Goals: Assist in achieving North EMEA-wide marketing team goals and programs, ensuring their success in the region
  • Partner with the BDR team to ensure quality lead delivery and proper follow-up. Build a consistent feedback loop and continuously improve and optimize lead hand-off processes
  • Team Updates: Regularly update marketing, sales, and product teams about regional customer behaviours, buying preferences, and patterns
  • Post-Campaign Reporting: Conduct post-campaign analysis to report on effectiveness and ROI, providing insights for future campaign improvements
  • #LI-LH1
  • #LI-Remote

    • What we're looking for:
  • 5-7 years of Marketing experience
  • Regional Expertise: Extensive experience in the UK and also Benelux and Nordics with professional level English language skills
  • Marketing Experience: Proven track record in marketing or revenue-focused roles, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Campaign Execution: Strong experience in supporting and executing full-funnel and multi-channel marketing campaigns
  • Data-Driven: Proficient in leveraging data to track campaign effectiveness, ROI, and optimize performance
  • Continuous Improvement: Mindset geared towards continual improvement and optimization of campaign processes
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in dynamic global environments and resolve ambiguity quickly
  • Collaboration: Passion for working with sales and partner teams to execute cross-functional campaigns
  • Customer Focus: Strong interest in engaging with and understanding North EMEA customer needs to tailor campaigns effectively
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience working with stakeholders across multiple time zones to coordinate campaign efforts
  • Impact-Driven: Desire to make a significant impact and drive change through effective campaign execution
  • Curiosity: Solutions-oriented mindset driven by curiosity to explore new campaign approaches
  • Bachelor’s Degree required: Marketing or Business Degree preferred

d3cd0b6bfedacd03.title: Senior Strategy Manager
d3cd0b6bfedacd03.description:
Centre for Net Zero is a not-for-profit open research institute established in 2021 as an autonomous part of the Octopus Energy Group. Our mission is to understand the world's changing potential for demand flexibility and make our evidence open and useful, so the world can run on clean electricity sooner and at lower cost. 

We design, run and evaluate global field trials to establish rigorous real world evidence; leverage advanced data science and open source modelling; build open source data, tools, and communities; and work with policymakers, industry leaders, and grid operators to turn our evidence into real world action.

About the role:

As we scale our research and ambitions, we are looking for a senior strategy manager to join our London team. You will work across CNZ's leadership team to increase the reach and impact of our work, at times operating in a capacity similar to a chief of staff. 


What you'll do
Most of your time:
  • Develop and scale (including securing resources where necessary) CNZ's strategic assets to increase overall impact in alignment with CNZ's mission. Examples of our strategic assets include our visiting researchers programme and our Faraday AI model. 
  • Lead research, market insights, and intelligence by curating external thinking, partnering with leading third parties to challenge our perspective, and using inventive methods to shape our research programme.
  • Drive strategic and tactical projects from problem to delivery, and contribute to others. This is likely to include projects in support of fundraising, and may include unusual or complex field trials or modelling partnerships.
    • Some of your time:
  • Own and deliver strategic organisational development initiatives, including driving the adoption of AI across the business.
  • Work closely with the CEO and executive team to drive operational excellence, championing a high-performing culture of rapid execution and seamless information flow.

    • What you'll need
  • Around 5+ years experience in a strategy consulting setting, or working closely with C-level execs or founders in a venture-backed startup.
  • Demonstrable interest in the research ecosystem, in the UK and internationally.
  • Strong interest in energy, able to learn quickly and communicate complex topics across sectors.
  • A proven track record of working independently, driving multiple priorities at once, and seeing projects through to the finish line.
  • An entrepreneurial instinct, able to shape ambiguity into opportunity and to separate productive risk-taking from imprudent decision making.
  • Strong writing, analytical skills, and critical thinking; you could spot and explain an overconfident or incorrect AI contribution that others would miss. 
  • Able to work from CNZ's office near Oxford Circus, a minimum of three days per week to start.
    • A bonus if you have:
  • Experience of securing philanthropic, foundation or grant funding.
  • Recent experience of using AI-based technologies to make organisations, teams and products better.
  • Experience of open source technologies, tools, and communities.

    • Why else you'll love it here

Once you're in the interview process with one of our recruiters, it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first 🚀
     
    P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at ----- and we’d love to help!

We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!

259be7b411778c44.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
259be7b411778c44.description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

 


What You Will Own:

  • Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.

  • Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.

  • The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.

  • Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.

  • Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.

  • Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.

  • Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.

  • Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.


    • What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

  • High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve.

  • Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps.

  • AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint.

  • Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on.

  • Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit.


    • We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will:

  • Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails.

  • Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change.

  • Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

  • Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support.


    • What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one.

  • AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments.

  • A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling.

  • Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud.

  • Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements.

  • Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders.

  • Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones.


    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases.

  • Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS.

  • Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments.

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores.

  • Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting.

  • Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool.


    • What We Value:
    We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact.

    How You Will Work:

    You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Expect occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings.


    What We Offer:
  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
    • Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.
     
    Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.
     
    We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

87dae5cfae71d21b.title: Senior Product Manager
87dae5cfae71d21b.description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

What you will do

Find the problems that matter

  • Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

  • See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

  • Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

Build with AI, in your work and in our product

  • Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

  • Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

  • Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

Deliver with rigour

  • Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

  • Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

  • Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

  • Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

  • Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

  • Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

  • Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B platforms is helpful but not essential

  • You're excited about changing how people buy and sell cars

Benefits

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:

  • Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office, with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

  • Great work-life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and workplace nursery scheme... and much more!

AWS Infrastructure Cloud Architect - French Speaking

Location: Paris France ( Hybrid)

6months+ Contract

Experience: 12+ years

Job Summary:

Has the ability to gather application functionality and non-functional requirements understand them and convert them into the overall IT infrastructure designs and implementation solutions for client's Business services. The customer has a DC transformation objective, for which he wants to get his environment analysed, rightly sized for the future, designed, and implemented on the public cloud. Post-implementation migration of Virtual and physical infra from the as-is environment to newly built infrastructure on public cloud AWS (Azure will be an added advantage).

Job Responsibilities:

  • Craft the Infrastructure migration strategies, principles, and high-level & Low-level design documents for the public cloud.

  • Excellent command of Landing Zone creation following AWS CAF perspective,

  • Experience FinOps assessment.

  • Design Cloud-based DR solutions and deploy them.

  • Design Cloud-based DR solutions and deploy them.

  • Good experience in Hybrid cloud setup, networking & security

  • Excellent understanding of AWS cloud services

  • Evaluate and recommend infrastructure solutions to best meet the seamless migration need of the business services.

  • Assure us that the most appropriate IT practices measures are in place.

Skills required:

  • 12+ years of Hands-on experience in AWS Cloud Build projects, Cloud migration/ Transformation, Active Directory migration

  • Ability to understand business requirements and transform them into a robust and efficient solution at optimized efforts and within budgeted costs.

  • Minimum 6+ years of experience with IaC , automation & DevOps tools ( Terraform, ansible )

  • Hands-on experience in shell scripting.

  • Good experience in Hybrid Cloud setup and network integrations

  • Good experience in Hybrid cloud setup, networking & security .

  • Good experience in integration of SaaS offerings (especially in Infra domain, IAM, Azure AD etc.)

  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like

  • VMware Infrastructure 4.x/5.x/6.x, VMware Licensing

  • Hyper-V 2008R2/2012R2, System Center Virtual Machine Manager, Microsoft Licensing

  • AWS cloud services for Network, security, computing, storage & Disaster Recovery

  • Migration tools and data replication tools

  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with Microsoft technologies like

  • Windows 2008/2008R2/2012/2012R2 and Licensing

  • Active Directory Services

  • Failover Clustering Services

  • Technical knowledge of AD/LDAP/NTP/SMTP services with upgradation, Migration
