bd65c2ede6d0a758.title: Senior Director, Revenue Operations
bd65c2ede6d0a758.description:
Calabrio is now Verint! At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with the passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities.

About the Role:

Americas field operations is how the region plans, sells, and forecasts. This leader owns that function end to end and serves as a strategic and operational partner to the Americas CRO and a member of the Americas leadership team, with responsibility for territory and quota execution, sales operations, order operations and partner operations across the region.

This is a senior leadership role with broad scope and direct accountability for the operational foundation behind the region's revenue performance. The Americas business is in the process of consolidating onto a unified CRM platform and this role owns much of the operational cleanup and process rebuild that follows, while the region carries its largest target to date. The right person is energized by building something rather than maintaining it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Forecast discipline. Pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and the weekly cadence behind both.
  • Territory and quota execution. Design, assignment, coverage modeling, and in-year adjustments across the Americas.
  • Sales operations. Territory execution, forecasting cadence, and CRM/sales systems support for the field.
  • Commercial operations. Quote-to-order execution, booking accuracy, and cycle time.
  • Partner operations. Partner registration, deal flow, and channel operational support.
  • Reporting & Analytics. Field-facing reporting for the region and the Americas inputs into the global planning cycle.
  • Partnership with the Americas CRO. Translate regional priorities into operational plans with named owners and dates, represent field operations in regional and global leadership forums, and surface risk early with the context needed to act on it.
  • Team leadership. Build and lead a multi-layer Americas field operations organization, developing managers and succession depth across every function. Every recurring process carries a documented procedure and named coverage.
  • Global alignment. Shape global Revenue Operations strategy in partnership with the centers of excellence across planning, analytics, compensation and systems.

The Leader We Are Looking For

Verint's Americas organization brings together teams with different histories, different systems and different ways of working. This role sits directly on that line and the person in it will do as much through influence as through authority. We are looking for a natural leader. Someone who earns credibility by delivering rather than by title. Someone both sides trust because they are fair, consistent and easy to work with. Someone equally at home on a sales floor and in a finance review.

Requirements

  • 12+ years in revenue or sales operations, including 5+ years leading multi-function regional field operations organizations with managers reporting directly
  • Territory and quota design at scale in a global enterprise software business
  • Track record building process and documentation in environments where little existed
  • Proven experience as the senior operations partner to a CRO or regional sales leader for a large, multi-country business
  • Strong Salesforce skills; fluent with planning and analytics tooling such as Anaplan or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience with sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Gong
  • High attention to detail. Owns forecast and quota numbers as source of truth, zero tolerance for error
  • Executive presence. Credible in front of the C-suite, comfortable running and presenting in executive-level meetings
  • Has led a team through a systems migration, merger or organizational integrations
  • Comfortable operating across regions and time zones
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred
  • Proven ability to design, implement and scale operational processes, governance and documentation standards in environments undergoing transformation
  • Demonstrated success leading operational teams through complex systems implementations, mergers, acquisitions and organizational change.
  • Proven ability to influence, collaborate and drive results across geographically dispersed teams, regions and time zones.

Benefits

You've learned about what you'll be doing, here are some of the benefits you'll be getting when you join Calabrio:

  • Global team recognized for their passion and innovation
  • Innovative product culture and project exposure
  • Training and development from industry-leading experts
  • Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) with company matching; medical, dental, and vision insurance; disability and life insurance; flexible PTO; paid holidays and parental leave; tuition reimbursement and more
  • We offer market competitive pay and benefits based upon the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications. Base salary will be starting at $190,000.

Calabrio People are: Open, Clear, Ambitious, Accountable, Collaborative, Consistent

What we value most…workplace diversity and ensuring an environment of mutual respect.  We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our commitment is to continue to keep our people healthy, focused, and inspire creativity.  Our team members are offered comprehensive benefits for various life circumstances and needs, great opportunities for career development, and a balanced work-life to achieve personal and professional success (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). As an Innovator with Purpose, you’ll feel motivated and genuinely excited to come to work!

Calabrio celebrates and fosters a culture that thrives on diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Calabrio are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We celebrate the >40 nationalities of team members that contribute to our success.

We recognize diversity comes in many forms, to foster an inclusive hiring experience any applicants who qualify under the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended, or applicable state law, who are unable to comply with Calabrio’s application process due to their disability may be eligible for a reasonable accommodation. 864832a92f364a36.title: Senior Lead Marketing Data Platform Architect
864832a92f364a36.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Marketing Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving Lumen's marketing data platform architecture. This role provides technical leadership for the design and implementation of scalable data products, modern analytics capabilities, AI-ready data structures, and agentic operational frameworks that support the organization's marketing strategy.

As the lead architect for the marketing data ecosystem, this individual will establish the long-term platform vision, define architectural standards, and guide modernization initiatives that enable advanced analytics, personalization, audience activation, measurement, and AI-driven decision-making. The role requires close partnership with engineering, analytics, Adobe, Salesforce, and business stakeholders to ensure the platform remains scalable, governed, secure, and aligned with evolving business needs.

This position is ideal for a forward-thinking architect who is passionate about building AI-native data platforms, enabling intelligent automation, and creating modern data foundations capable of supporting both current and future marketing use cases.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the architectural vision, governance, performance, and long-term evolution of Lumen's marketing data platform.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and operational strategy of Databricks as the strategic platform for marketing data and intelligence.
  • Define and maintain scalable data architectures that support analytics, reporting, customer intelligence, personalization, activation, and AI-driven use cases.
  • Establish platform standards for data modeling, ingestion, orchestration, observability, testing, security, and environment promotion.
  • Design and govern reusable data products that enable trusted, consistent access to marketing data across the organization.
  • Drive modernization initiatives that improve platform scalability, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and accelerate delivery.
  • Define governance standards for metadata management, lineage, schema control, data quality, and lifecycle management.
  • Design for AI-native and agentic operations, including automated quality controls, monitoring, validation, testing, deployment, and operational intelligence.
  • Partner with Adobe, Salesforce, analytics, engineering, and business teams to ensure seamless integration across the marketing technology ecosystem.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns that improve platform performance, automation, and business value.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to engineers, analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Lead architecture reviews, establish design standards, and document technical decisions that support long-term platform sustainability.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Required Qualifications
    • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, platform architecture, data solutions architecture, or related disciplines.
    • Deep hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Spark, data engineering, governance, orchestration, and platform architecture.
    • Strong experience designing and implementing modern lakehouse architectures and enterprise-scale data platforms.
    • Advanced data modeling, SQL, and data architecture expertise.
    • Experience designing AI-driven or AI-native data solutions and implementing automation, testing, quality controls, and deployment practices.
    • Strong understanding of metadata management, lineage, observability, data governance, and platform operations.
    • Advanced understanding of Adobe's digital ecosystem, including Web SDK, Launch/Tags, Customer Journey Analytics, and Adobe Experience Platform.
    • Advanced understanding of Salesforce architecture, standard and custom object models, and customer data ecosystems.
    • Demonstrated success translating business requirements into scalable, secure, governed technology solutions.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business audiences
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience modernizing or transforming enterprise data platforms.
    • Experience designing agentic or AI-assisted operational frameworks.
    • Experience with MCP, Copilot, or similar AI orchestration technologies.
    • Experience implementing machine learning or generative AI capabilities within enterprise data environments.
    • Experience with DataOps, DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and automated testing frameworks.
    • Familiarity with marketing platforms including Marketo, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, and Quantum Metric.
    • Experience supporting customer data platforms, data warehousing, and advanced marketing analytics environments.
    • Azure platform expertise, including Key Vault, Azure Monitor, networking, and cloud governance.
    • Relevant Databricks, Microsoft Azure, Adobe, or Salesforce certifications.

Compensation

268fb983b670bea7.title: Senior High Performance AI Engineer, Agentic AI
268fb983b670bea7.description:
We are looking for outstanding Senior High Performance AI Engineers to build the next generation of agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem. Our team works across the full agentic AI stack—from training and improving models, to designing agent architectures and multi-agent systems, to building the systems, runtimes, and evaluation frameworks that make them effective at scale.


You will help develop intelligent agentic systems that can reason about, generate, optimize, and operate across NVIDIA's accelerated computing stack. This includes advancing model and agent capabilities, building scalable agent systems and runtimes, developing high-fidelity training and evaluation environments, and co-designing with NVIDIA's libraries, runtimes, compilers, and hardware. You will collaborate closely with internal NVIDIA software, model, and hardware teams to bring new capabilities into NVIDIA products.


What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem, including agent architectures, multi-agent workflows, tool use, memory, and orchestration.
  • Build the data, environments, verification, reward, and evaluation systems needed to continuously improve model and agent capabilities.
  • Co-design and optimize agentic systems across NVIDIA's software and hardware stack, from models and inference through compilers, runtimes, libraries, kernels, and GPUs.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; MS or PhD preferred.
  • 4+ years of relevant industry or academic experience in AI systems, machine learning, compilers, high-performance computing, or related areas.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following: agent systems, coding agents, reinforcement learning, or modern AI inference systems.
  • Strong C/C++, Rust, and Python programming skills, with solid software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience with GPU programming and performance optimization using CUDA or comparable accelerator platforms, and the ability to work effectively across system boundaries.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Track record of building high-impact coding agents, autonomous software-engineering systems, or developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing and deploying with TRT-LLM, SGLang, vLLM, or Transformer Engine.
  • Deep expertise in GPU systems and performance optimization, demonstrated through benchmark results, deployed systems, publications, or widely used software.
  • Publications or open-source leadership in deep learning, agentic AI, reinforcement learning, compilers, high-performance computing, or AI systems.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and hardworking people in the world working with us and our product lines are growing fast in some of the hottest state of the art fields such as Virtual Reality, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Autonomous Vehicles.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 15, 2026.

51017131efd16d5b.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, Kubernetes Scale - DGX Cloud
51017131efd16d5b.description:
The DGX Cloud organization at NVIDIA brings together cutting-edge hardware and software innovation to deliver industry-leading accelerated computing for the world's most adventurous AI workloads. We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!

What you'll be doing:

  • Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

  • Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

  • Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

  • Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

  • Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

  • Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

  • Engage efficiently with upstream communities — including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects — to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

  • 8+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

  • Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

  • Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

  • Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

  • Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

  • Proficiency in Golang/Python

  • Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

  • Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

  • Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

  • Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

  • PhD in relevant areas

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4, and 375,000 PLN - 650,000 PLN for Level 5.

75f8a8d14076c016.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Are you passionate about delivering high-quality, compassionate care and ready to make a difference from the comfort of your home? Join Teladoc Health, a leader in virtual healthcare, as a 1099 Nurse Practitioner (NP) and help provide accessible, patient-centered care to individuals across the country.


We are seeking experienced Family Nurse Practitioners who are board certified through the ANCC (American Nurses Credentialing Center) or AANP (American Association of Nurse Practitioners) and committed to delivering exceptional virtual care experiences.


In this role, you'll deliver comprehensive virtual care through on-demand visits through a variety of modalities to provide patients with timely, convenient care whenever and wherever they need it.

As an independent contractor, you can either add to your current clinical practice or build an entire telemedicine practice depending on the state(s) you are licensed in.


This position supports hiring 100% remote within the U.S.


What We Offer:

  • Teladoc Health APPs incorporate telehealth into their practices to help more patients access affordable, quality care. We offer a convenient way to increase your income without additional overhead expenses.   
  • Registered members using our services come from health insurance plans, employers, hospitals, and unions.
  • Common illnesses we treat include cold/flu symptoms, bronchitis, allergies, sinusitis and UTI’s. We offer strong clinical guidelines within our platform, along with required training prior to accepting consults.
  • Accessible and easy-to-use telehealth platform via the web or on our mobile app.
  • Simple documentation requirements using our proprietary software.   
  • Free medical malpractice insurance while practicing on the Teladoc platform, and continued coverage if you decide to leave Teladoc Health.  

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced Practice Registered Nurse with either a Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP)
  • 3+ years of clinical experience as a Nurse Practitioner with urgent care or emergency medicine.
  • Candidates must hold active, unrestricted licensure in a minimum of four (4) states at the time of hire.
  • Must hold an active Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA)
  • Must be nationally NP board certified: FNP-BC or FNP-C
  • Previous Telehealth experience preferred.
  • Must be eligible for and willing to enroll in applicable state and federal healthcare programs, with no exclusions that would prevent participation.
  • Must have a clean professional record with no board disciplinary actions
  • Strong clinical decision-making skills and confidence in practicing independently.
  • Tech-savvy and adaptable to telehealth platforms and evolving virtual care protocols.
  • Passion for creating meaningful patient relationships in a digital environment

The compensation for this position is $12.50/phone consult, $14/video consult, $6/async consult.


Teladoc Health maintains an open application for NP roles due to ongoing hiring needs, as multiple identical positions are filled on a continuous basis throughout the year.

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

b9d91b45f694773f.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS: As a Senior Software Engineer (Senior Associate) in Kainos, you’ll be responsible for developing high quality solutions which delight our customers and impact the lives of users worldwide. It’s a fast-paced environment so it is important for you to make sound, reasoned decisions. You’ll do this whilst learning about new technologies and approaches, with talented colleagues that will help you to learn, develop and grow as you, in turn, mentor those around you.

  • Experience of debugging and troubleshooting live applications

  • Experience of multiple programming languages and data storage technologies

Embracing our differences

39cf9a1071d9ca98.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
39cf9a1071d9ca98.description:
Purpose 

Delta Faucet Company is seeking a Salesforce Solution Architect to serve as the design authority for our Salesforce ecosystem within the Channel, Experience & Portfolio function of IT. This is a customer-side architecture role — you will partner closely with business leaders to shape the platform according to our roadmap, own how it evolves over multiple years, and guide its direction beyond how any single project is coded. 


Our environment spans B2B, B2C and B2B2C: wholesale distributors, trade professionals, retail partners, e-commerce and direct consumer service, supported by Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and CPQ/Revenue Cloud, integrated to ERP, PIM/DAM and analytics platforms. You will act as trusted advisor to business partners, set the architectural direction, and hold internal and third-party delivery teams accountable to that direction. 


You will succeed here if you enjoy owning the long-term integrity of a platform inside the company that runs it.


What Success Looks Like in Year One 

  • Within 90 days: You have documented the current-state Salesforce architecture, data model and integration landscape, and identified the top technical-debt risks with a remediation point of view. 
  • Within 6 months: You are the recognized design authority on all Channel & Experience initiatives — no significant design decision, internal or vendor-proposed, moves forward without your review. 
  • Within 12 months: A published multi-year platform architecture roadmap is in place and aligned to enterprise architecture standards; measurable reduction in custom code and rework on delivered releases; business partners come to you early, not after requirements are frozen. 

Key Responsibilities and Duties 

  • Design Authority: Own end-to-end solution design across multiple Salesforce Clouds — object and data model, security and sharing, automation strategy, and integration patterns — balancing near-term delivery against long-term maintainability. 
  • Roadmap Ownership: Translate business strategy into a multi-year platform architecture roadmap; recommend build vs. buy vs. configure, and sequence capability delivery accordingly. 
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Customer Solutions and channel partners; challenge requirements constructively and translate them into technical specifications. 
  • Technical Leadership: Guide internal and partner development teams on best practices, data modeling, automation and API integration; lead design reviews rather than perform hands-on build. 
  • Vendor Governance: Provide architectural oversight of third-party delivery partners and systems integrators — validate that proposed solutions leverage out-of-the-box functionality wherever possible, and hold external partners accountable to industry best practices, security protocols and our standards. 
  • Documentation & Governance: Maintain architecture artifacts and decision records; establish and enforce standards that minimize technical debt. 
  • Emerging Capability: Evaluate new platform capability — including Data Cloud, generative and agentic AI such as Agentforce — and form a defensible point of view on where it creates value while protecting brand, privacy and governance standards. 
  • Validation: Use prototypes and proof-of-concepts, built personally or directed through the team, to de-risk significant design decisions. 

Required Experience and Skills 

  • Experience: 8+ years working with the Salesforce platform, including 2+ years as the accountable architect on at least two full-lifecycle, multi-cloud implementations. 
  • Multi-Cloud Design Depth: Demonstrated design ownership across at least three of: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, CPQ/Revenue Cloud. 
  • Core Platform Knowledge: Deep command of data modeling, security and sharing architecture, declarative automation strategy, Lightning Experience and integration patterns (REST/SOAP, event-driven, middleware). 
  • Technical Fluency: Sufficient depth in Cross-cloud integration, Apex, LWC and API development to review, challenge and govern the work of developers — hands-on coding is not the primary function of this role. 
  • Governance Judgment: Track record of saying no to unnecessary customization and defending that position with business stakeholders and vendors. 
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to design solutions that align to long-term business goals and enterprise architecture standards. 
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, with a proven ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical and executive audiences. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Autonomy: Executes responsibilities with limited oversight required. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience as an in-house Salesforce architect at a customer organization or consulting experience in a long-term client engagement.
  • B2B, B2C or B2B2C commerce with distributor, dealer or trade-professional channel models. 
  • Manufacturing or consumer products industry background. 
  • Experience governing a systems integrator or managed-service partner, including reviewing SOW-driven deliverables. 
  • Practical exposure to generative or agentic AI on the Salesforce platform, including Agentforce, Einstein or Data Cloud-driven use cases. This is valued and will be developed on the job — it is not a screening requirement. 
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, PIM/DAM or enterprise analytics platforms. 

Certifications 

Architect-track certification preferred, not required. Demonstrated design ownership will always outweigh credentials. 

  • Preferred: Salesforce Certified Application Architect, System Architect, or B2B/B2C Solution Architect. 
  • Commonly held: Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I. 

Why Delta Faucet Company 

Delta Faucet Company is one of the largest and most recognized brands in kitchen and bath plumbing fixtures, and part of Masco Corporation. Our Salesforce footprint is expanding rapidly across sales, marketing and customer service, with a multi-year investment roadmap already funded. This role carries real design authority from day one and a direct line to IT and business leadership — the scope of an enterprise architect with the influence of a small team. 

Diversity & Inclusion 

At Delta Faucet Company, we view diversity as a mosaic of thoughts and perspectives that come from people’s varied cultural backgrounds, experiences, education, career paths and other influences that make each of us unique. For us, inclusion means welcoming differing opinions, collaborating, allowing people to come to work as who they are and recognizing everyone’s contributions. We know that in a diverse, inclusive company, ideas flow freely, all voices are heard and all perspectives are valued. Delta Faucet Company continuously strives to be this kind of organization. Diversity and Inclusion (D&I) supports our inherent values, makes us more relevant to customers and consumers and inspires innovation. It is not a goal or a program; it is a vital ingredient in our formula for success and a key to our future growth.

885916fe424a759e.title: Knack: Cloud Engineer
885916fe424a759e.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

6a57f279357b6259.title: OpenTable: Global Hotel Partnerships Manager (East Coast based)
6a57f279357b6259.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://opentable.com

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

 

About the Job

We are seeking a high-impact relationship builder to own and grow OpenTable's most strategic hotel partnerships worldwide. As the Global Hotel Partnerships Manager, you will be the primary architect of OpenTable's relationships with the world's leading hotel brands and management groups — sitting at the critical intersection of business development, product evolution, and global operations.

You will manage a portfolio of high-value, Tier-1 hotel partnerships, leading complex global negotiations, driving adoption of OpenTable's technology suite, and ensuring our products are seamlessly integrated into the world's most prestigious hotel portfolios. Success in this role means growing revenue and retention through a consultative, data-driven approach while serving as the connective tissue between partner executives, their technical teams, and OpenTable's internal functions.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary relationship owner for Tier-1 global hotel partners (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, IHG), overseeing relationship health, retention, and revenue growth across regions.
  • Lead end-to-end negotiation and contracting for global service agreements, co-marketing contracts, and technical addendums, structuring terms that maximize strategic value across diverse markets.
  • Develop and execute profitability and revenue strategies that exceed growth and retention goals — including auditing financial structures such as rebate programs and implementing pricing models that increase average partner revenue.
  • Drive global adoption of high-value features and products, including OpenTable Pro, Private Dining Instant Booking, and Automated Guest Codes.
  • Serve as the bridge between partner technical teams and OpenTable Engineering to deploy API products (e.g., Sync, CRM, Booking), and navigate enterprise-level security audits, SSO implementation, SOC 2 reporting, and complex data privacy requirements.
  • Build consensus across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales Ops) to align contract terms, product requests, and account plans, and provide end-to-end support for product releases and the subsequent go-to-market strategy.
  • Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and "Year in Review" performance audits for C-suite stakeholders, and design sales enablement and training materials that equip leadership and account management with hotel expertise.
  • Represent OpenTable at major industry trade shows and conferences, presenting on topics meaningful to the global travel and hospitality industry.
  • Own the administrative side of the partnership, including documentation of client engagement in Salesforce, stewardship of hotel-specific resource sites, and strategic communication flows.
  • The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in account management, strategic partnerships, or business development, ideally within the hospitality or travel technology sector.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing a portfolio of high-value accounts or partners against pre-set objectives.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to cultivate internal and external stakeholders at the Executive and VP levels.
  • Technical literacy: comfort discussing API infrastructure, data mapping, and system integrations fluently with engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical rigor, using data to build business cases and resolve technical or business roadblocks.
  • Self-starter who is comfortable taking full ownership in an unstructured, forward-thinking environment, with strong time management and comfort handling administrative tasks.
  • College degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Global mindset, with experience working within and representing a global organization across multiple time zones and cultures.
  • Deep industry knowledge of the hospitality and hotel-technology ecosystem.
  • Experience navigating ambiguous legal and financial structures and complex, multi-stakeholder procurement processes.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Google Suite, and Microsoft Office.
  • This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. 

 

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States located role is $110,000 - $130,000 USD.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

 

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

#LI-Remote

28d1e2040f8e5ad4.description:
Headquarters: United States

AI Data Quality Analyst

Job Title: AI Data Quality Analyst
Location: United States (Remote)
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Experience: 2–6 Years
Salary Range: $70,000 – $115,000 per year (USD)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Category: Artificial Intelligence / Data Analytics / Data Quality

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical AI Data Quality Analyst to join our growing AI and Data Engineering team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating, validating, cleaning, and maintaining datasets used in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications.

The candidate should have experience in data quality assessment, data validation, data annotation, SQL, Python, and AI/ML data workflows. This role involves ensuring data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability to improve AI model performance.

This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, validate, and maintain datasets used for AI and machine learning applications.

  • Identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, and inaccurate data.

  • Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and quality checks.

  • Evaluate training and testing datasets for accuracy and completeness.

  • Develop and maintain data quality standards and validation procedures.

  • Review AI-generated outputs and identify data-related errors or inconsistencies.

  • Perform data annotation, labeling, classification, and categorization when required.

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and Data Engineers.

  • Create SQL queries and Python scripts for automated data validation.

  • Monitor data quality metrics and prepare analytical reports.

  • Identify root causes of data quality issues and recommend corrective actions.

  • Maintain data documentation, validation logs, and quality reports.

  • Support continuous improvement of AI training datasets and data pipelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of experience in Data Quality Analysis, Data Analytics, or AI Data Quality roles.

  • Strong understanding of data validation, data cleaning, and data profiling.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and database management.

  • Experience with Python for data analysis and validation.

  • Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and data processing libraries.

  • Understanding of AI, machine learning, and data preparation workflows.

  • Experience with structured and unstructured datasets.

  • Knowledge of data annotation and labeling methodologies.

  • Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, and data visualization tools.

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Experience with AI/ML training data evaluation.

  • Familiarity with data quality tools and frameworks.

  • Knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehousing.

  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance standards.

  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs and Generative AI datasets.

Salary & Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $70,000 – $115,000 USD.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise.

  • 100% remote work opportunity.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid time off and holidays.

  • Retirement savings benefits, where applicable.

  • Professional development and training opportunities.

  • Career advancement opportunities.

Work Location

United States – Fully Remote

  • Candidates from eligible locations across the United States are encouraged to apply.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Ability to collaborate with distributed teams across different US time zones.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with contact details, relevant AI Data Quality experience, technical skills, and project portfolios.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse professional backgrounds and encourage applications from eligible candidates across the United States.

DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases multiple financial services use cases with flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many scalable financial service companies across the globe.

Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in AI, machine learning, security, big data, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!

Summary:

As a Senior Account Executive – Payments, you will be responsible for hunting and securing new accounts within a defined Payments sector target list. This is a visible quota-based position and is critical role aligning to the forecasted growth of the company. This candidate will drive the sales cycle from end-to-end as the “quarterback” of the deal, driving the supporting sales engineers, data scientists, delivery etc.   The candidate will need to partner with marketing, represent the organization at conferences, and take all measures to build a healthy new opportunity pipeline, and drive opportunities to closure.  The ideal candidate will have experience succeeding in a line positions within the payment industry, have exposure to SaaS solutions, fraud, and success leading enterprise sales.  They will have good technical knowledge of the payment transaction eco-system and be able to interact and influence the c-suite, product leaders, risk leaders and technology leaders. 

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline within the payments segment.
  • Understand the payments ecosystem, including a strong technical acumen of the segment.
  • Be able to communicate the challenges facing providers in the payment segment. 
  • Have a working knowledge of fraud risk.
  • Understand SaaS solutions.
  • Be a thought leader and build relationships at all levels within product, technology, and risk organizations.
  • Understand and be able to communicate the company value story, and the ROI story aligning to the dynamics in the payment segment in parallel to influencing technical feasibility. 
  • Drive the sales cycle from end-to-end. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams including marketing, sales engineering, system architects, delivery, finance, and legal.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce.com.
  • Lead contract negotiations to closure with time-sensitive urgency.
  • 15+ years total experience across a combination of payments, fraud, SaaS, and Sales.
  • History excelling in a quota driven environment.
  • Strong executive presence, and the ability to engage with C-level and VP-level executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive the sales process from end-to-end. Formal methodology training is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute territory and close plans.
  • Experience with contract negotiations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams both internally and within our client’s organizations.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Compensation range: $160K-$175K base salary per year, OTE $320 -$350K, uncapped and negotiable

Health Insurance, Stock options, 401k, PTO

cb5c781f17cfc573.title: WiseTech Global: E2open - US Area Sales Director (CPG) - Texas
cb5c781f17cfc573.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://wisetechglobal.com

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now

In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.

WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.

This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.
  • Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.
  • Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.
  • Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.
  • Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.
  • Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).
  • Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.
  • Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.
  • Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.
  • Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Additional Information

When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.

Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.

Before You Apply 

From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations.

  • Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly

    • To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg-texas

b06366713e89b091.title: EdgeQ Technologies Private Limited: IT Support Specialist
b06366713e89b091.description:
Headquarters: United States

IT Support Specialist

Job Title: IT Support Specialist
Location: United States (Remote)
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Experience: 1–5 Years
Salary Range: $45,000 – $75,000 per year (USD)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Category: Information Technology / Technical Support

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our growing IT team in the United States. The ideal candidate will provide technical assistance, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, support end users, and ensure smooth operation of IT systems.

This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to employees and end users through email, phone, and remote support tools.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and operating system issues.

  • Install, configure, and maintain computers, applications, and IT equipment.

  • Assist users with Windows, macOS, Microsoft Office, and other business applications.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues within established service-level agreements (SLAs).

  • Manage IT support tickets and maintain accurate documentation.

  • Support user account management, password resets, and access permissions.

  • Assist with network connectivity, VPN, Wi-Fi, and printer-related issues.

  • Monitor IT systems and escalate complex technical problems when required.

  • Maintain IT asset records and support equipment deployment.

  • Follow IT security policies and data protection procedures.

  • Provide clear technical guidance and excellent customer service.

b1003ee9e2a0be9a.description:
Headquarters: Egypt
URL: http://partneronecapital.com

Description

Company Overview  

PartnerOne is a long-term software investment group that acquires, operates, and scales successful enterprise technology companies worldwide. With over 30 years of experience, PartnerOne owns and manages a portfolio of high-growth software businesses that serve more than 2,000 leading corporations and government organizations globally. Our focus on operational excellence, sustainable growth, and continuous improvement creates a high-performance environment where accountability, ownership, and collaboration drive success.  

 Position Summary  

We are seeking a highly skilled CRM Software Engineer to support the development, customization, automation, and integration of enterprise CRM platforms, with a primary focus on Zoho CRM and the Zoho One ecosystem.  

This role is responsible for translating approved business requirements and CRM architecture designs into working solutions through configuration, scripting, coding, automation, integrations, and system enhancements. The CRM Software Engineer will work closely with the Corporate CRM Architect, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to build and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support multiple companies operating within a shared CRM framework.  

The ideal candidate has experience working across multiple CRM platforms including Salesforce, Sage, Quickbooks, HubSpot, and Zoho CRM, with strong software development and systems integration expertise.  

 

Key Responsibilities 

 

CRM Development & Configuration 

  • Configure and customize Zoho CRM modules, layouts, forms, fields, profiles, roles, and permissions. 
  • Develop and maintain custom functionality within Zoho CRM and related Zoho applications. 
  • Implement business workflows, blueprints, automation, approval processes, and notifications. 
  • Create custom reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions. 
  • Configure CRM environments based on established solution designs and implementation specifications. 

 

Software Development & Scripting 

  • Develop custom solutions using: 
    • Zoho Deluge 
    • JavaScript 
    • REST APIs 
    • Webhooks 
    • SDKs 
    • Custom Functions 
    • Serverless integrations 
  • Write, test, deploy, and support CRM scripts and automation. 
  • Create reusable components and development standards for multiple company implementations. 
  • Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing CRM functionality. 

 

Integrations 

  • Develop and maintain integrations between Zoho CRM and external systems including: 
    • ERP platforms 
    • Financial applications 
    • Support platforms 
    • Marketing automation systems 
    • eCommerce solutions 
    • Third-party APIs 
  • Build API connections and middleware solutions. 
  • Support data synchronization and workflow automation across platforms. 

 

Data Migration & Conversion Support 

  • Assist with data migration projects from: 
    • Salesforce 
    • NetSuite CRM 
    • Microsoft Dynamics 
    • HubSpot 
    • Legacy CRM platforms 
  • Perform data mapping, transformation, validation, and migration support. 
  • Develop import and validation scripts to improve migration efficiency and data quality. 

 

System Maintenance & Support 

  • Troubleshoot CRM issues and provide technical support. 
  • Monitor system performance and proactively address technical issues. 
  • Participate in testing, deployment, and release management activities. 
  • Maintain development, test, and production environments. 
  • Support CRM upgrades and new feature deployments. 


Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 4+ years of experience in CRM development, software engineering, or business systems development. 
  • Hands-on experience configuring, customizing, and developing within enterprise CRM platforms, preferably Zoho CRM. 
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, Sage Intacct, NetSuite CRM, or QuickBooks. 
  • Strong experience developing and supporting REST API integrations and third-party system integrations. 
  • Proficiency in Zoho Deluge scripting and workflow automation. 
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, SQL, JSON, and XML. 
  • Experience with CRM customization, workflow design, business process automation, and data migration. 
  • Experience implementing, enhancing, or migrating CRM solutions. 
  • Knowledge of integration architecture, data mapping, and system troubleshooting. 
  • Experience with Zoho One ecosystem, including Zoho Flow, Zoho Creator, Zoho Analytics, and Zoho Desk, preferred. 
  • Familiarity with Salesforce administration or development is a plus. 
  • Experience using Git or other source control platforms. 
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with the ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues. 
  • Detail-oriented with excellent documentation and organizational skills. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations. 
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with CRM, automation, and software development best practices.

df807360d4bec399.description:
Headquarters: Centro Corporativo el Cafetal, Heredia, Heredia, Costa Rica
URL: http://experian.com

Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. 

Job Description

The Salesforce CRM Team Lead will work within the Global CRM team to raise the operational maturity of our Salesforce platform and the team that supports it. You will support multiple business units and processes across Salesforce capabilities—including Experience Cloud and CPQ—as well as connected marketing automation, automated testing, and enterprise data warehouse platforms. 

You will combine advanced Salesforce administration, delivery management, data quality, process standardization, stakeholder partnership, and team leadership. The successful candidate will work with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, and CRM colleagues to improve service consistency and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions. 

Salesforce Platform Leadership 

  • Configure and maintain Salesforce using declarative tools, including custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, picklists, approval processes, and advanced Flow automation. 
  • Lead root cause analysis and design scalable solutions for increasingly complex business requirements. 
  • Oversee the configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce agents, Prompt Builder solutions, and intelligent automation features. 
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities and proactively recommend improvements. 

Delivery Management and Operational Excellence 

  • Monitor case queues and team workloads, assigning or reallocating work as needed to support timely resolution and appropriate case coverage. 
  • Collaborate with regional contacts to prioritize case assignments, ensuring the Global Salesforce team delivers effective user support and meets service requirements. 
  • Coordinate Scrum-based backlog management, sprint planning, and work prioritization across the CRM support team. 
  • Improve and maintain process documentation, Salesforce Knowledge articles, and support communications to promote service consistency and user adoption. 

Business Partnership 

  • Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders, development teams, and cross-functional partners. 
  • Translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and communicate effectively across technical and business audiences. 
  • Participate in requirements gathering, solution design discussions, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release activities, and post-deployment validation. 
  • Support informed decision-making through strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

Team Development and Leadership 

  • Mentor and coach CRM Analysts and other teammates, reinforcing established standards, governance, and operational best practices. 
  • Model accountability and professionalism while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and customer-focused service. 
  • Act as the escalation point for complex cases, providing hands-on support for critical or high-priority user issues when needed. 

Regional Business Support 

  • Strengthen multilingual support in English and Spanish across North American and Latin American user communities. 
  • Improve response times by serving as the CRM team’s first resource based in a North American time zone. 
  • Expand regional collaboration with business stakeholders across Latin America. 

Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator 
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder 
  • 5+ years of experience administering or supporting Salesforce in complex, multi-business-unit environments. 
  • 2+ years of experience leading Salesforce administration teams or delivery initiatives, including mentoring or coaching colleagues. 
  • Demonstrated experience with Salesforce Flow automation and process optimization. 
  • Experience with Scrum or other Agile delivery methodologies, including backlog management and sprint planning. 
  • Fluency in English and Spanish. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into system solutions, explain complex technical concepts clearly, and influence decisions across Sales, Marketing, and Finance. 
  • Ability to guide architectural discussions and technical direction without serving as the primary hands-on developer. 
  • Comfort incorporating AI-assisted solutions into day-to-day workflows, including prompting, testing, debugging, and documentation. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis on complex issues. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands in a fast-paced environment. 

Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Our benefits include: Medical, life and dental insurance, Asociacion Solidarista, International Share Save Plan, Flex Work/Work from home, Paid time off, Annual Performance Bonus, Education Reimbursement, Family Bonding, Bereavement Leave, Referral Program, and more.

This is a fully remote job opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
