71d7b0f7f37da6ea.title: Senior Solution Engineer (Pre-Sales)
71d7b0f7f37da6ea.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Zip Solutions Engineer, you are the primary pre-sales technical point of contact for the Zip solution suite. Your role is to be a champion for Zip, helping our prospects understand how our application will deliver value to their organisation, and where Zip fits with their procurement and technical landscape. You are a partner in selling, fostering collaborative relationships with account executives and sales managers to drive deals to closure.

You are a trusted advisor to our prospective customers, giving them confidence that Zip can address their pain points, and helping translate their needs to our post-sales solutions consultants to ensure a successful deployment. You are a subject matter expert on our solution capabilities and our roadmap. You funnel customer feedback to influence our product development efforts and help our sales partners understand how our newly developed solutions or enhancements are most effectively communicated.

You will be an integral part of the success for both our customers and Sales Team by performing technical discovery qualification, delivering product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts, delivering technical workshops, and making architectural recommendations. As a hardworking technologist and customer advocate, you will connect the dots between the technical solution to the business outcomes for the customer.

You Will

  • Actively contribute to Zip’s sales efforts by supporting prospective customer-facing conversations, effectively conducting discovery, demonstrating our solutions, handling questions, and overcoming objections to help our prospects see the value in choosing Zip.

  • Own responsibility for responding to customer asks, including follow-up questions, demos, RFx and IT security questionnaires.

  • Build and develop custom demos that match customer requirements

  • Lead, scope, and partner with Post-Sales to deliver POCs

  • Partner with the Sales team to deliver on our sales objectives.

  • Partner with the Post-Sales Solutions Consultants to ensure our customers experience a seamless transition from sale to onboarding - communicating their needs and objectives with proper expectations set for successful delivery.

  • Deliver feedback to help us grow and evolve - on processes and products.

Qualifications

  • Strong solution selling skills - able to articulate the value of software solutions to customers, with messaging focused on how a solution addresses customers’ core pain points in a way that differentiates the solution

  • Excellent presentation and composure abilities in front of all levels of technical and non-technical audiences

  • A skillset to establish trust with clients, and the ability to influence key decision makers

  • Excellent discovery skills - able to lead customers through focused conversations to uncover pain, value, and our path to sales success

  • Experience using REST APIs for enterprise integration, ideally with ticketing, ERP, or CLM systems

  • Self-starter and quickly able to grasp new technology

  • Willing and able to travel to onsites/customer meetings

  • Fluency in German (C1/C2 level or native proficiency) is required. This role involves working closely with German speaking customers and stakeholders across the DACH region.

Nice to Haves

  • CPA background a plus

  • Integration or development experience is a plus - especially with using REST APIs and middleware tools.

  • Experience with demoing, implementing or administering key applications such as ERPs (Oracle, Ariba, Workday), CLMs, GRC, procurement or AP automation platforms.

  • Industry and / or solutioning experience with P2P / Fin-tech tools related to procurement, AP automation or payments.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health Insurance

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Connectivity reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 💸 Pension Contributions

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

ff74aee9b4aa9fab.title: Principal Software Architect
ff74aee9b4aa9fab.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

  • Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

  • Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

  • Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

  • Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

  • Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

  • Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.

  • Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.

  • You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.

  • You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.

  • You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.

  • You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.

  • You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.

  • You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.

  • You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.

  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Opportunity

  • ZeitMind is an autonomous data engineer for mid-market businesses. Agents and people work the same company data: ingest, pipeline, clean, analyse, build operational apps

  • we are growing fast and will be onboarding multiple enterprise customers a week. The backend isn't ready yet, your impact will decide the speed at which we can grow

  • scale a multi-tenant Postgres under unpredictable load: query and I/O optimisation, read/write separation, horizontal scaling

  • manage the sandbox layer: Docker containers where agents run queries and reverse-engineer files, with compute and memory budgets

  • own connectivity into customer networks: SOCKS5 over WebSockets, authentication, routing

  • scope the architecture and build it

  • staff or principal level, still hands-on, writing production code

  • built and scaled multi-tenant data platforms in a B2B startup or platform company before

  • deep Postgres or database knowledge: query plans, locking, I/O, caching, replication, sharding

  • understands startup pace and ownership without specs

  • pragmatic over ideal, wants to build foundations right without overengineering

  • strong TypeScript

  • English C1, German a plus

Nice to have

  • experience at a data platform or warehouse company (Snowflake, Databricks, Cloudflare or similar)

  • networking depth: proxies, VPN, routing

Location

  • preferred: Munich, on-site. We support relocation within Europe

  • already in London? We can make that work. We have people here and are opening a small office, and we'd expect regular Munich travel. In-person culture is important to us

Tech stack

  • TypeScript end to end. Bun, tRPC, Postgres, Supabase. React frontend (Mantine, TanStack Query). Docker, job/process management, VPN/routing, agentic frameworks

3f14d399f4a5307e.title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
3f14d399f4a5307e.description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: $110K – $140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

30ccce052af4473c.title: Sales Manager
30ccce052af4473c.description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Manager at Artificial, you'll own new business growth across specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers in Germany and the broader DACH region. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll build pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close deals with senior stakeholders who are rethinking how their underwriting and claims operations run.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and manage a pipeline of specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers across Germany/DACH (and, over time, wider Europe)

  • Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders - Chief Underwriting Officers, Heads of Digital/IT, and other economic buyers

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo (partnering with our Pre-Sales Engineer for technical validation), proposal, negotiation, and close

  • Keep an accurate, disciplined pipeline in the CRM and forecast reliably against quarterly and annual targets

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to share market feedback and shape go-to-market strategy for the region and beyond

  • Represent Artificial at industry conferences and broker/carrier events across Europe

About you

  • A track record of success in B2B SaaS sales, ideally selling into insurance, financial services, or complex enterprise software

  • Alternatively: UWing/Broking??

  • Experience selling technical or API-driven products to enterprise buyers, and comfort running a consultative, solution-based sales process

  • Existing relationships or experience within the European (re)insurance market are a strong plus

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Based in Germany, remote, with willingness to travel within Europe as the role requires

  • A consistent history of meeting or exceeding quota

  • An entrepreneurial, self-directed approach — comfortable building process rather than just following it, in a fast-moving Series B environment

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.


    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.


    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.


    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

e9e9b17c8b1ade9b.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x)
e9e9b17c8b1ade9b.description:
About accilium

accilium is an award-winning strategy and management consultancy shaping the future of mobility and energy. We work with industry leaders in Automotive & Transport, Energy & Environment, and Public & Infrastructure. Founded in 2017, we've grown to 110+ people across 7 offices: Berlin, Munich, Vienna, Cologne, Hamburg, Bucharest and Warsaw. Our software subsidiary &amp (50+ developers) lets us deliver end-to-end. We've been ranked Top 10 in the brand eins/Statista "Best Consultants" list five years running and were named "Hidden Champion 2026/2027".

The role

As Forward Deployed Engineer, you work with our clients to turn breakthroughs in AI technology and research into production systems. Working at the intersection of bleeding edge technologies and the transformation of leading enterprises' core value chains, you will drive organizational transformation and help our clients re-architect work. 

You'll also help build accilium itself into an AI-native company. Through Project aIQ, our internal transformation program, we ship weekly builds of "acciliumOS", the agents and tools our own consultants work with.

You join the FDE team in our Technology Practice, and you'll help shape how it grows.

What you'll do 

  • Build agentic systems with our clients and embed them in their core processes, from first prototype to production. 

  • Ship concrete artifacts: agents, MCP servers, agent skills and integrations used in real workflows. 

  • Turn what works into reusable patterns, for accilium and, where we can, for the open-source community. 

  • Work on-site with client teams, explain what you built, and spot the next use case. 

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI development stacks. 

  • Expand accilium’s build capabilities for agentic systems and deploy solutions for our internal value chains 

 

What you bring 

  • A Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, engineering or similar. 

  • Hands-on coding in Python and/or TypeScript; you're comfortable with APIs, git and the command line. 

  • Things you've built and can show us: a GitHub profile, a side project, a thesis, a hackathon entry. Shipped is better than polished. 

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs: you've built with an agent framework, written a prompt or eval pipeline, or connected a model to real data. 

  • You enjoy explaining technical work to non-technical people and learning how their work actually runs. 

  • Process-design instinct and hands-on experience with analytical, generative and agentic AI stack (agent harnesses, context engineering, skills) 

  • Deep understanding of how model behavior affects enterprise outcomes 

  • You like figuring things out, can operate autonomously and thrive under ambiguity as well as under pressure 

  • Ambition to move fast and take risks 

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, problem-solving and interpersonal skills 

  • Willingness to work on-site with clients in DACH 1–3 days per week. 

  • German and English at C1 level*  

*Global scale - Table 1 (CEFR 3.3): Common Reference levels (coe.int)

How you'll grow

  • Structured onboarding with our FDE team and pairing with engineers at &amp.

  • A clear path from FDE to Senior FDE, with regular feedback and a named mentor.

  • Real ownership early: your first build reaches a client or internal team within your first weeks.

What we offer

  • Salary: €61,000 gross per year for graduates; €82,000 with 2 years of relevant full-time experience all-in contract.

  • Funded frontier-model API access with no token budget gating for experimentation.

  • Latest tech kit (Mac or Windows/ WSL), flat hierarchies and an open-door culture.

  • Up to 1 home-office day per week; client on-site days are part of the job.

  • Public transport ticket, corporate benefits, team events (reTreat, acc'sPerience, acc'smas Party).

Click Apply or reach out to Katrin Helm (

accilium is an equal opportunity employer.

ee70f38776117ca4.title: AI Solution Architect (m/w/d)
ee70f38776117ca4.description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy.

DEINE MISSION

Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure

  • Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection

  • Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration

  • Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry

  • Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers

  • Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken.

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights.

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert.

  • Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

682b80236258ddc6.title: Senior Product Designer - Berlin
682b80236258ddc6.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it.

The mandate

We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform.

This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers.

Responsibilities

Product design and leadership

  • Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints.
  • Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation.
  • Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team.
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data.
  • Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code.

Design systems and AI

  • Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code.
  • Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently.
  • Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully.
  • Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use.

Who we are looking for

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale.
  • 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area.
  • Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync.
  • An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance.
  • Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams.
  • Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus.

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Flexibility in working arrangements, offering hybrid or remote work options based on role requirements and location.
  • Matching pension schemes and/or 401k.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on RA merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • Regular company-wide Q&As with senior leadership, along with ongoing virtual educational training sessions for all staff.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

This role is a permanent position based in Berlin. Please note: This position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary for this role is €50k–€60k. If you have questions about the role, please contact

The mandate

RA is looking for a Chief Content Officer to lead our media team and shape how we tell the story of electronic music and club culture. The role covers every place our voice shows up: editorial, films, audio formats and social output. You'll bring these together as one multimedia strategy, not separate channels.

Content is central to how people discover music and events on RA. You'll make sure it serves the business as well as the culture: driving discovery, supporting promoters and our network, and building RA's long-term relevance.

You'll set the creative vision and empower the team to deliver it with autonomy. You'll bring strong editorial judgement and a clear sense of what RA stands for, thinking quarters and years ahead without losing sight of what goes out this week. You'll own how the team works: formats, frequency, planning and process. A Managing Editor runs this day to day, and section leads report to you. Your job is to set the direction, standards and rhythm, including how AI changes the way the team works.

Responsibilities

Direction

  • Set RA's editorial strategy across all media formats, grounded in RA's scope of coverage and tied to company goals.
  • Build a unified multimedia approach, planning stories across formats and choosing the right outlet, frequency and context for each.
  • Own RA's editorial judgement, point of view and tone. Decide what we cover, how we cover it and where we draw the line.
  • Stay close to the scenes, first-hand and through RA's network around the world, and turn what you see and hear into what RA covers next.
  • Make the final call on sensitive or high-profile content, resolve competing priorities and keep work moving.
  • Work closely with Growth, Product and the network so content drives discovery across RA's platforms and supports the wider business.

Oversight

  • Oversee the execution and efficiency of editorial, films, podcasts, mixes and social, including ambitious flagship and long-form projects.
  • Keep RA's coverage genuinely global, ensuring strong local stories reach a wider audience beyond the usual cities.
  • Shape the editorial direction of content from RA's global network, including Mix of the Day, RA Picks and local coverage, while giving contributors the autonomy and support to do their best work.
  • Bring RA's creative vision to events and live programming, working with the events team on curation.

Standards

  • Hold a high bar on accuracy, cultural ethics and integrity.
  • Work with 23:59, RA's brand studio, so commercial work feels native to RA while protecting editorial independence.

Team

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers, producers, video and audio makers, and social specialists.
  • Work with and develop strong section leads, giving them clear ownership and authority over their areas and offering constructive feedback.

Operations

  • Own the team's operating rhythm with the Managing Editor, so planning, commissioning, production and publishing hold up at pace, seven days a week.
  • Manage budget, resources and schedules.
  • Set objectives and reporting that make performance clear to the team and leadership.

AI

  • Lead how AI is used across the team, in research, fact-checking, production and distribution, wherever it improves quality or speed.
  • Set clear rules for its responsible use, in line with our editorial standards.

Audience

  • Know how audiences find and engage with modern media: long- and short-form video, podcasts, social media and RA's own platforms. Grow reach, engagement and loyalty across all of them.
  • Measure success on relevance and discovery, not reach alone. Use data and audience insight to inform decisions, not replace judgement.

Representation

  • Be a public face for RA in the industry, at events and in the media.
  • Build relationships with artists, labels, promoters, filmmakers and the wider scene.

Who we are looking for

  • A genuine stake in electronic music and club culture. You have an ear to the ground and real curiosity for what comes next, not just what's already happened.
  • A proven leader who's managed multidisciplinary teams and built structures that work without micromanagement.
  • A track record of commissioning ambitious work across written, visual and audio formats, including film, documentary and social projects.
  • Strong cultural judgement, editorial standards and confidence to make difficult decisions.
  • A global perspective, with an understanding of scenes beyond the dominant capitals, and how we can serve them.
  • A proven understanding of modern audience behaviour, distribution, data and AI, as well as experience managing budgets and competing priorities and a track record of connecting content to business outcomes.

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

c3457cc314edd758.title: Product Manager PRINCE2
c3457cc314edd758.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

407e7202fc2e5e7c.title: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin
407e7202fc2e5e7c.description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Natalie unter oder +49 157 92465807.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.

Software Fullstack Engineer Kasse & Support (m/w/d)

Hey du,

Freizeitparks, Trampolinhallen und Bäder verkaufen ihre Tickets über ticketbro. Seit Mitte Oktober 2026 läuft bei uns die ticketbro Kasse im Echtbetrieb, mit Stripe Terminal direkt am Tresen. Weitere Betreiber folgen. Für die Kasse suchen wir jemanden, der sie komplett übernimmt: Code, Rollout und die Betreuung der Anwender.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die ticketbro Kasse, vom Cloud-Backend bis zur Oberfläche am Terminal.

  • Du entwickelst neue Features und behebst Fehler, idealerweise basierend auf deinen eigenen Beobachtungen vor Ort.

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Betreiber bei technischen Rückfragen, gelegentlich auch am Wochenende.

  • Du richtest die Kasse bei Bedarf direkt beim Betreiber ein und schulst das Team vor Ort.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, um die Kasse im Alltag effizienter und benutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten.

Dein Profil

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Erfahrung mit React oder React Native und TypeScript sowie Grundkenntnisse in Node.js und AWS Lambda (Projekte aus Studium, Praktikum oder eigene Arbeiten sind ausreichend).

  • Du kannst komplexe Technik verständlich erklären und behältst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.

  • Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in GraphQL, AWS CDK, Erfahrung mit Payment- oder Kassensystemen sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B.

  • Du wohnst idealerweise in München, dies ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Was wir bieten

  • Echte Verantwortung für ein Produkt, das bei Betreibern live im Einsatz ist.

  • Anstellung als Werkstudent mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten oder in Vollzeit, unbefristet.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und bei Vollzeit 30 Tage Urlaub.

  • Hochwertiges Equipment.

  • Flache Hierarchien und direkter Austausch mit dem Management.

  • Büro in München.

Bewerbung

Schick uns ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, einen Link zu GitHub oder zu einem Projekt, dein frühestmögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung (als Werkstudent: Stunden pro Woche). Beantworte außerdem in zwei Sätzen: Ein Parkbetreiber ruft an, das Terminal verbindet sich nicht. Was fragst du als Erstes?

d9ab4a67c5a3e152.description:
About GlassFlow

GlassFlow builds data infrastructure for AI agents in production, featuring two core products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data across systems, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs agent behavior. Operating as a Berlin startup backed by Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, and the ex-CTO of Aiven, the team comprises serial entrepreneurs with over 10 years of experience.

What you will do

As a Founding Engineer, you will shape the platform's technical foundation in a hybrid role based in Berlin. You will collaborate directly with the founders to build and scale the infrastructure supporting AI agents.

  • Product Integration for Client Use Cases

  • Go-to Person for technical questions for the internal sales and marketing team

  • Building and developing the connector and ingestion layer

  • Part of the core development team

  • Creation of product tutorials and guides

What the role requires

This permanent position is offered at 40 hours per week with a 6-month probation period. You will work within a small, fast-paced team environment.

You are:

  • Fluent in Python

  • Knowledge of frontend frameworks like TypeScript and React is a plus

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)

  • Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions)

  • Worked in fast-growing environments and/or early-stage startups

  • Willing to work once a week in our Berlin office

Your first months at GlassFlow

You will dive straight into the core architecture, collaborating on initial feature rollouts for GlassFlow Tares and GlassFlow Rius. During your first months, you will establish foundational engineering workflows and contribute directly to the production codebase.

Working environment and perks

You will receive company stock options and flexible working hours to manage your schedule. The role includes public transportation benefits, home office options, and complete home office equipment alongside a company laptop and travel expenses compensation. Additional provisions include 28 vacation days per year, free beverages and snacks, team events, social activities, and a casual dress code.

  • Competitive salary with Stock Option Grant

  • Ticket for public transportation in Berlin

  • Company credit card with a monthly allowance

  • Newest tech of your choosing

  • Annual Learning budget for personal development

  • Generous WFH policy and a budget for home office setup

GlassFlow is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with diverse backgrounds and disabilities.

f721e4ead1030333.description:
ABOUT NAXON

Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones.

Why now: rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site.

Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM).

THE ROLE

You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there.

As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor

  • Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS

  • Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones

  • Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation

  • Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback

  • Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos

  • Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning

  • Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents

  • Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware

  • MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience

WHY JOIN NAXON

  • The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop

  • Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it

  • Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI

  • Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member

  • Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who have built, scaled and exited companies

  • A supportive and inclusive team that values ownership and creativity

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last.

It is not a support role. It is a build role, deployed forward, defining a new function rather than filling a seat. You will be based at our Hamburg factory, with roughly 30 to 50 per cent of your time embedded at other sites. We are open to graduate and experienced engineers. The package includes equity.

  • Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators.

  • Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed.

  • Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status.

  • Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer.

  • Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap.

What you bring

  • The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision.

  • Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows.

  • Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site.

  • The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue.

  • Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems.

ea5651e1550faf19.title: SAP Integration Architect
ea5651e1550faf19.description:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

  • Fulltime • €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

For the French market, that means understanding how people search, how competitors appear in search results and where content can perform better. At idealo, you will support our France SEO work with research, reporting and hands-on optimisation tasks while learning SEO through real projects. You will work closely with an experienced SEO manager and contribute to projects around Google Search, content and emerging search technologies. When your research helps uncover an optimisation opportunity, you can see how your work feeds directly into improvements on idealo.fr.

About your new role

  • Monitor SEO performance and support recurring reporting for idealo.fr.

  • Research competitors, search results and developments in the French market.

  • Support keyword research, content optimisation and SEO testing.

  • Prepare analyses for important French commercial and sales events.

  • Keep SEO documentation, meeting notes and project follow-ups up to date.


Skills & Requirements

Must-have

  • You are currently studying marketing, business, digital or a related field.

  • You speak French fluently and communicate confidently in English.

  • You are comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and online research.

  • You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.

Nice-to-have

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Data Engineer


Are you technically skilled, enjoy exploring new approaches, and want to avoid being held back by existing structures and processes? As a Data Engineer, you will join an environment where many things are being built from the ground up and where you can actively contribute your own technical ideas. From architecture and data pipelines to data quality and AI interfaces, you will have the opportunity to develop modern solutions while taking ownership of their implementation. Apply now and take advantage of the technical freedom this position offers. 

Your benefits as Data Engineer

  • Compensation: Enjoy an attractive salary with an additional variable component that reflects your experience and technical expertise. 

  • Creative Freedom: Help build a central data platform from the ground up and bring your own technical ideas to the table. You will have plenty of room to explore modern solutions and actively shape the technical architecture. 

  • Flexibility: Organize your working day largely on your own and work flexibly from home or anywhere in Germany. At the same time, you should be willing to attend important meetings, workshops, and in person collaboration when required. 

  • Workation: Take up to four weeks of workation within the EU and, subject to agreement, potentially beyond the EU. 

  • Pension: Benefit from an occupational pension scheme with a 50% employer contribution. 

  • Development: Take advantage of individual training opportunities, language courses, and personal learning programs. 

  • International Environment: Work in an international environment where both German and English are used as business languages. 

Your tasks as Data Engineer

  • Data Layer: Take ownership of operating and further developing the Databricks based data platform, including workspaces, jobs, and permissions. 

  • Data Pipelines: Develop robust ETL and ELT pipelines for banking, treasury, payments, export finance, and other data sources. 

  • Architecture: Design Data Lake and Lakehouse structures as well as scalable and high performance data models. 

  • Data Quality: Implement automated quality checks and ensure data completeness, timeliness, and consistency. 

  • Monitoring: Build monitoring and alerting for pipelines, jobs, latency, and errors. 

  • Governance: Document data flows and lineage and support data classification, access controls, and regulatory requirements. 

  • AI Enablement: Provide suitable data and interfaces for AI use cases and MLOps. 

  • Collaboration: Support business teams with data analysis and work closely with Architecture, Platform, Risk, and Compliance. 

Your profile

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification provides the foundation for this role. 

  • Experience: Several years of experience in Data Engineering and building productive data platforms. 

  • Technology: Very good knowledge of Databricks, SQL, and modern ETL and ELT patterns. 

  • Architecture: Experience with Data Lake or Lakehouse architectures, data modelling, and data quality. 

  • Cloud: Experience with Infrastructure as Code in cloud environments is important, ideally complemented by Azure or AWS knowledge. 

  • Operations: Experience with monitoring, error handling, and operationalizing productive data pipelines. 

  • Communication: Strong communication skills and very good English at C1 level. 

  • Additional Skills: Experience with banking, finance, Power BI, DORA, SFTP, or AI and ML data pipelines is an advantage.

Do you have your own ideas about how a modern data platform should be built and want the freedom to put them into practice? Then this role offers the technical freedom you rarely find within established structures.
