a8683a0504c52f20.description:
Intro

Bei Arvana bauen wir die erste AI-native Go-to-Market-Firma in DACH. Seit 2024 sind wir auf über 5 Mio. € ARR und mehr als 30 Leute im Team gewachsen, und wir legen gerade erst richtig los. Über 200 Unternehmen wie Swisscom, monday.com, Enpal, Talkdesk und FreeNow setzen bereits auf uns.

Als Founders Associate übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für strategische Projekte, baust Prozesse mit Tools wie n8n und Claude auf und treibst sie eigenständig voran. Starten kannst du ab sofort.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für die Finanzplanung, von der Budgetierung bis zum Forecast, und entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse für nachhaltiges Wachstum.
  • Du findest Optimierungspotenziale und automatisierst operative Abläufe mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code und OpenClaw und Plattformen wie n8n, Make.com und Zapier.
  • Du baust moderne Business-Intelligence-Strukturen auf, zum Beispiel mit Snowflake und Looker Studio, und schaffst so datengetriebene Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Du bist Sparring für unsere Gründer bei strategischen und operativen Entscheidungen und bringst eigene Perspektiven in den Wachstumsprozess ein.
  • Du entwickelst neue Business-Ideen und Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie von 0 auf 1 um.
  • Du schaffst Klarheit in komplexen Themen durch saubere Analysen, strukturierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und klare Umsetzungspläne.

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.
  • Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen und 1 bis 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in schnellen Umfeldern wie Startups, Consulting oder VC gesammelt.
  • Führung: Du hast erste Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeitende oder Praktikanten zu führen, und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.
  • Unternehmergeist: Du interessierst dich für den Aufbau von Unternehmen und willst ständig Neues lernen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du bist zielstrebig, proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung.
  • Anspruch: Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an dich und andere und motivierst dein Umfeld mit einer Can-do-Mentalität.
  • Englisch: Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch.

Benefits

  • Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.
  • Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.
  • 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote.
  • Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook.
  • Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket.
  • Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.
  • Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.

Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln?

Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

1. Kurzes Kennenlernen
Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 20-minütigen Call lernen wir uns kennen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob wir zusammenpassen.

2. Personal Fit
Im zweiten Gespräch (ca. 30–45 Minuten) lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen.

3. Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team
Vorab bekommst du eine Case Study aus unserem Alltag, die du zu Hause vorbereitest und dann bei uns im Office in der Rosenstraße 17 vorstellst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten.

Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts.

Das erwartet dich

  • Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte.
  • Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss.
  • Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline.

Was du mitbringst

  • B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich.
  • Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst.
  • Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln.
  • Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren.
  • Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Warum uns?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener.
  • Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

ad226b685e0357ff.title: SAP Senior Consultant (f/m/d)
ad226b685e0357ff.description:
Who We Are

BeNeering was founded in 2007 by experienced SAP solution architects who had spent years working inside global corporations. We know from first-hand experience where procurement gets slowed down and how to fix it. As a German software company and certified SAP partner, we started out in consulting and became a solutions provider in 2013. Our core development team from that time is still with us today.

Our main product is the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform. It uses AI-powered guidance and automation to make indirect procurement easy. The platform connects to SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA in real time, so SAP remains the system of record while employees shop in a modern, intuitive interface that feels like a web shop. Many of our customers use it as the modern replacement for SAP SRM.

BeNeering is privately owned and has no outside investors. We don’t chase short-term targets. We build long-term partnerships and develop our product together with our customers.

About the Job

Are you an experienced SAP procurement consultant who wants to move beyond configuring standard modules and help shape a modern, AI-powered procurement platform? At BeNeering you will bring our solutions to life at some of the world's largest companies, working hand in hand with customers, developers and product management.

Responsibilities

  • Lead implementations of the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform at customers running SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA, from kickoff to go-live and hypercare

  • Run workshops with procurement and IT stakeholders, analyze purchasing processes and translate requirements into solution designs

  • Configure the integration between BeNeering and SAP MM, MM-SRV, PM and SRM, including roles, workflows, catalogs and service procurement

  • Guide customers migrating from SAP SRM or classic MM purchasing to a modern, Clean Core procurement setup

  • Act as the bridge between customers and our development team: write functional specifications and support testing and acceptance

  • Lead project workstreams, coach junior consultants and help onboard partners on BeNeering solutions

  • Train key users and contribute to best practices, documentation and the evolution of our product

Who You Are

  • University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration or a related field

  • 5+ years of SAP consulting experience, including at least 2 full-lifecycle implementation projects

  • Strong functional knowledge of SAP procurement: SAP MM (purchasing, contracts, service procurement MM-SRV) and/or SAP SRM

  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA

  • Solid technical understanding of SAP integration (BAPIs, RFC, OData) and enough ABAP knowledge to read code and debug

  • Confidence leading customer workshops and presenting to stakeholders

  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Fiori/UI5 or SAP Integration Suite

  • Experience with SAP Ariba, catalog management or guided buying solutions

  • SAP certifications, for example S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement

  • Interest in using AI in SAP projects

Why Work With Us

  • Take on responsibility from day one and help shape our company and technology

  • Contribute your ideas to a fast-growing team with flat hierarchies

  • Use AI in your daily work and bring new ideas to how we work

  • Work closely with experienced experts from procurement and technology

  • Individual bonus payments based on performance

  • Flexible hours that adapt to your schedule, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl

  • A hybrid model that combines office time and working from home

  • A laptop and company phone, which you can also use privately

  • Additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve

  • Regular team events and an annual company event with networking opportunities

2cbaca1c606c1c57.title: Founder Associate / Assistenz der Geschäftsführung (m/w/d) - - Vollzeit
2cbaca1c606c1c57.description:
Du willst nicht zuschauen, wie ein Unternehmen gebaut wird – du willst es mitbauen.

besser zuhause baut Badezimmer für Menschen um, die zu Hause alt werden wollen. Unser Kernprodukt ist der Umbau von der Badewanne zur barrierearmen Dusche, komplett aus einer Hand: Beratung, Planung, Zuschuss der Pflegekasse, Umsetzung, Abrechnung. Wir arbeiten stark standardisiert, mit einem eigenen Duschsystem, einem Netz aus Wohnberatern und Handwerkspartnern. Unsere Standorte sind Hamburg, Berlin, Hannover und Bremen.

Der Markt wächst, weil die Gesellschaft altert. Unser Ziel ist ein skalierbares System für altersgerechtes Wohnen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der eng mit der Geschäftsführung arbeitet und uns den Rücken freihält.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und bist in alle wichtigen Themen eingebunden. Nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung übernimmst du schnell eigene Verantwortung. Am Anfang begleitest du Projekte, später führst du sie selbst. Deine Schwerpunkte:

Personal

  • Recruiting steuern: Stellen ausschreiben, Bewerber vorqualifizieren, Prozesse in Personio sauber halten

  • Onboarding, Vertragsvorbereitung und HR-Prozesse mitgestalten

  • Bei Vergütungs- und Provisionsmodellen mitarbeiten

Finanzen

  • Liquiditätsplanung und Reporting vorbereiten (Profit Center, KPIs, Power BI)

  • Offene Forderungen im Blick behalten, vor allem gegenüber Pflegekassen

  • Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung aufbereiten

Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Neue Geschäftsfelder und Partnerschaften bewerten und aufbauen, z. B. mit der Wohnungswirtschaft oder für Treppenlifte

  • Den Markteintritt in neue Regionen vorbereiten

  • Prozesse analysieren, standardisieren und mit AI und Automatisierung verbessern

Und alles dazwischen: Du übernimmst, was gerade am wichtigsten ist, und bringst es zu Ende.

Was du mitbringst

  • Einen sehr guten Abschluss, z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fach

  • Erste Berufserfahrung, z. B. in Beratung, Startup, Private Equity oder einer operativen Rolle. Praktika zählen.

  • Analytische Stärke: Excel ist kein Fremdwort für dich, Zahlen erzählen dir Geschichten

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du schreibst nicht nur Konzepte, du setzt sie auch um

  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten, auch wenn zehn Dinge gleichzeitig brennen

  • Klare Kommunikation, mit Handwerkern genauso wie mit Vorständen von Wohnungsunternehmen

  • Neugier auf AI-Tools und Lust, Abläufe zu automatisieren

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch, weil unsere Kunden, Partner und Teams Deutsch sprechen

Was wir dir bieten

  • Lernkurve: Du siehst das ganze Unternehmen, von der Baustelle bis zur Gesellschafterebene

  • Echte Verantwortung: Nach der Einarbeitung führst du eigene Projekte mit spürbarer Wirkung

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Wir sind Sparringspartner und Mentoren, keine Chefs, die nur delegieren

  • Perspektive: Founder Associates entwickeln sich bei uns in Führungsrollen weiter, z. B. als Head of People, Finance oder Expansion

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit: Was wir bauen, sorgt dafür, dass Menschen länger sicher zu Hause leben können

Vergütung

Das Gehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 42,000–55,000 pro Jahr.

4e76f2d5117f3f42.title: Kfz-Prüfingenieur mit Betrauung (m/w/d) – mit Perspektive zum Abteilungsleiter
4e76f2d5117f3f42.description:
Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit.

Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg.

Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo:

  • Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ

  • Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Qualitätssicherung, Einarbeitung neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, fachliche Ansprechperson im Team

  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)

  • Abgasuntersuchungen (AU)

  • Änderungsabnahmen nach §19(3) StVZO

  • Wenn bereits Qualifizierung vorliegt: Begutachtungen im Rahmen des Technischen Dienstes, z. B. für Sondereintragungen, Umbauten und Importfahrzeuge

  • Tätigkeit im Außen- und Innendienst

Schrittweise hinzukommen:

  • fachliche Qualitätssicherung und Einhaltung der amtlichen Vorgaben an allen Standorten

  • fachliche Anleitung, Einarbeitung und Schulung des Teams

  • Ansprechperson für die GTÜ, z. B. bei Audits und fachlichen Rückfragen

  • Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden: Großkunden, Fuhrparks, Werkstätten, Autohäuser oder Einzelkunden

  • Mitwirkung an Dienstplanung, Prüfausstattung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

  • Betrauung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur – gern auch von einer anderen Überwachungsorganisation, den Wechsel zur GTÜ begleiten wir

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung

  • Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Team fachlich zu führen

  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch

  • Freude am Umgang mit Kunden und Kollegen

  • Bereitschaft zum Einsatz an unseren Standorten

Was noch fehlt, bauen wir gemeinsam auf

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

  • individueller Plan mit regelmäßigen Entwicklungsgesprächen

  • Weiterbildungen zu Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Konfliktmanagement

  • fachliche Weiterbildungen, z. B. zum Unterschriftsberechtigten des Technischen Dienstes oder zum Kfz-Sachverständigen (inkl. IfS-Zertifizierung)

  • In-House-Schulungen – keine Anreise nötig, flexible Terminplanung

  • Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen, die ihr Wissen gerne weitergeben

Leistungen der Anstellung

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung bei der von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH

  • Grundgehalt ab 4.000 €/Monat (Vollzeit) – je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation mehr; mit wachsender Verantwortung entwickelt sich selbstverständlich auch Ihr Gehalt weiter

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive mit klarer Entwicklung zur Führungsposition

  • Arbeit an modernem Prüf-Equipment

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und planbare Einsatzorte per Dienstplan

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Ein Team mit sympathischen Kollegen und familiärer Arbeitsweise

  • Mitarbeiter Boni über Probonio

  • Gemeinsame Events wie Weihnachtsfeiern u. v. m.

Kontakte

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und möglichem Eintrittstermin. Schreiben Sie uns gerne auch, wo Sie sich noch weiterentwickeln möchten.

Bewerben Sie sich mit dem Button auf dieser Seite.

Standorte: Stadtkoppel 21, 21337 Lüneburg (Zentrale) · Glüsinger Weg 27, 21481 Lauenburg/Elbe · Röntgenstraße 52, 22335 Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel

822ddab2ffdaef59.title: SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d) bis zu 80%-Remote
822ddab2ffdaef59.description:
Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen und Teil einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden. Moderne, hochautomatisierte Fertigungsprozesse, eine hohe Variantenvielfalt und eine leistungsfähige Logistik prägen das industrielle Umfeld. SAP bildet dabei die zentralen Geschäftsprozesse über nahezu alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg ab.

Zur Verstärkung des internen SAP-Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d), der eigene Lösungen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und die anstehende Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA aktiv mitgestaltet.

Aufgaben

  • Sie entwickeln und optimieren SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysieren Sie Anforderungen und übersetzen diese in technische Konzepte und praxistaugliche Lösungen.

  • Sie begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Tests und Dokumentation.

  • Sie wirken an der Umstellung auf SAP S/4HANA und der Modernisierung der bestehenden Systemlandschaft mit.

  • Sie unterstützen produktionsnahe SAP-Prozesse, insbesondere im Umfeld von SAP PP und der Maschinenanbindung.

  • Sie entwickeln Schnittstellen zwischen SAP, Produktion, Lager sowie angrenzenden EWM- und MES-Systemen weiter.

  • Je nach Aufgabenstellung setzen Sie moderne Technologien wie SAP Fiori, SAP UI5 und die SAP Business Technology Platform ein.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit den internen IT-Kollegen, den Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern zusammen.

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.

  • Sie haben mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten.

  • Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ABAP und ABAP Objects.

  • Sie bringen Erfahrung mit SAP PP sowie der Maschinenanbindung im Zusammenspiel mit EWM und MES mit.

  • Sie verstehen SAP-Prozesse und können fachliche Anforderungen analysieren und technisch umsetzen.

  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbstständig und verantwortungsbewusst und schätzen einen hohen Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und verfügen über gute Englischkenntnisse.

Damit ergänzen Sie Ihr Profil idealerweise:

  • Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA, beispielsweise aus Entwicklungs- oder Transformationsprojekten.

  • Kenntnisse in SAP Fiori und SAP UI5.

  • Kenntnisse der SAP Business Technology Platform sowie Erfahrung mit Schnittstellentechnologien wie OData, IDoc oder BAPI.

Benefits

  • Attraktiver Gehaltsrahmen: Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation etwa 70.000 bis 90.000 Euro brutto jährlich auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Gleitzeit sowie die Möglichkeit, in Vollzeit mit 40 Wochenstunden oder in einem individuell abgestimmten Teilzeitmodell zu arbeiten.

  • Homeoffice: Nach der Einarbeitung sind bis zu 80% Homeoffice möglich. Auch gebündelte Präsenzphasen (1 Woche vor Ort, 3 Wochen Homeoffice) sind umsetzbar.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Fachlicher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliche Entwicklungsaufgaben und die Möglichkeit, die SAP-S/4HANA-Transformation unmittelbar mitzuprägen.

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Fachliche Qualifizierungen und SAP-Schulungen nach Bedarf und Abstimmung.

  • Unterstützungsoption bei einem Umzug

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Massageangebote, Corporate Benefits, ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket und vergünstigte Lademöglichkeiten für Elektrofahrzeuge. Nach der Probezeit stehen außerdem Dienstrad-Leasing und eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung zur Verfügung.

Ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Sie möchten mit Ihrer SAP-Erfahrung die digitale Weiterentwicklung eines produzierenden Unternehmens mitgestalten?

Dann melden Sie sich zeitnah – wir freuen uns auf ein erstes Gespräch!

b98178c65ab08118.title: (Stellvertretende/Assistant) Store Manager | Filialleitung (m/w/d) Mode und Accessoires
b98178c65ab08118.description:
Siamo noi – das sind wir Unsere Mission:

das italienische Lebensgefühl - la dolce vita - in die Welt zu tragen. AUST ist ein erfolgreiches Modeboutique-Konzept mit einer exklusiven italienischen Kollektion. Kreativität, Herzblut, Begeisterungsfähigkeit, Vertrauen und Verbindlichkeit machen uns zu dem, was wir sind.

Für unsere Casa (unser Wort für Boutique) in Hamburg-Eppendorf suchen wir eine (stellvertretende) Store Manager / Filialleitung (m/w/d) die unsere Kundschaft begeistert, verwöhnt und freudig mit anpackt.

Aufgaben

  • Du bist Gastgeber:in und bietest Deinen Kund:innen ein besonderes Shopping-Erlebnis durch Premium-Beratung und charmanten Zusatzverkäufe
  • Du baust stetig Deinen Kund*innenstamm aus, indem Du Dir passende Events überlegst und diese selbstständig organisierst und durchführst
  • Du planst, koordinierst und entwickelst (zusammen mit der Filialleitung) Dein Team, dabei steht AUST Dir zur Seite
  • Du trägst zur Einhaltung der Arbeitsabläufe bei und verbesserst diese stetig mit Hilfe von kennzahlenbasierten Auswertungen (KPIs)
  • Du nimmst Waren an, erfasst diese im System und führst Inventuren durch
  • Du setzt die Visual-Merchandise-Vorgaben um und sorgst dafür, dass die Waren mit Liebe zum Detail präsentiert ist
  • Du bist für die Ordnung, Sauberkeit und den Flair in der Filiale mitverantwortlich

Qualifikation

  • Du bist erfolgsorientiert, hast ein sicheres Auftreten und eine starke Kommunikation
  • Du berätst leidenschaftlich, hast einen ausgeprägten Sinn für Mode und Freude daran mit Menschen zu arbeiten
  • Du trägst durch Dein Management, gute Organisation und Koordination zum Erreichen der Unternehmensziele bei – und behältst dabei stets den Überblick
  • Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und packst gern selbst mit an. Deine Kolleg:innen schätzen Dich für Deine Zuverlässigkeit und Deine empathische Art
  • Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre im Einzelhandel (Mode, Hotel, Restaurant) gearbeitet und bestenfalls eine Ausbildung in diesem Bereich abgeschlossen
  • Du bist flexibel und bringst Bereitschaft mit auch am Wochenende zu arbeiten
  • Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

Benefits

  • Variable Arbeitszeiten in geplanten Schichten von Montag bis Samstag
  • Ein herzliches Team, regelmäßig Verkaufstrainings und tolle Kund*innen
  • Sehr, sehr attraktiven Personalrabatt
  • Eine individuell gestaltete Filiale mit Wohlfühlgarantie und italienischem Flair im Herzen von Hamburg-Eppendorf
  • Sollten Dir in einigen Bereichen Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen fehlen, unterstützen wir Dich sehr gerne durch abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungen

Über uns

AUST Fashion ist ein Unternehmen, das auf eine mehr als 55-jährige Erfolgsgeschichte zurückblicken kann. Es ist unsere Mission, das italienische Lebensgefühl in die Welt zu tragen und Menschen zu inspirieren, das süße Leben zu genießen und auch die kleinen Momente in vollen Zügen auszukosten. 38491a44188c5faa.description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.


We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London office. Office attendance is required at least twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays out of our Moorgate office for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.

Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the United Kingdom.

The Ironclad Adoption Strategist (AS) is a strategic role designed to accelerate customer adoption, increase user engagement, and maximise the business value of an organisation's Ironclad investment. The Adoption Strategist is Ironclad's primary customer-facing owner for enterprise and strategic accounts, responsible for leading customers from the first pre-sales service engagement through foundational adoption.

Working cross-functionally with Customer Value, Product, Sales, and Engineering teams, the adoption strategist develops adoption frameworks, accelerates user engagement, and designs implementation and adoption paths that are designed from the start to activate AI-powered workflows and deliver measurable outcomes that support long-term customer success.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong consulting mindset, exceptional communication skills, experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives, and deep knowledge of SaaS platforms, AI technologies, organisational change, and customer adoption methodologies.


What you'll be doing:

  • Partner with executive stakeholders to define business objectives, adoption strategies, and success metrics.

  • Develop and execute adoption roadmaps that accelerate user engagement and business value realisation for Ironclad’s enterprise and strategic customers.

  • Translate Ironclad's AI capabilities and evolving product motion into language and a delivery plan that resonates with executive stakeholders.

  • Partner closely with Contract AI Services to ensure that implementation and AI configuration work is designed to support the customer's long-term adoption path.

  • Own project execution end-to-end: manage timelines, track deliverables, identify and escalate risks, and maintain stakeholder alignment across internal and customer teams

  • Manage escalations with confidence — reset expectations, realign stakeholders, and resolve scope conflicts without waiting for leadership to intervene

  • Contribute to the improvement of delivery methodology, scoping playbooks, and adoption frameworks that scale the function's effectiveness over time

  • Monitor adoption metrics, customer health, and business outcomes; recommend continuous improvements based on data and customer feedback.

  • Collaborate across Customer Success, Professional Services, Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering to ensure a seamless customer experience and identify opportunities for growth and expansion.

  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies, SaaS capabilities, and industry best practices to continuously enhance customer value.


What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Organisational Development, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Technology Consulting, Digital Transformation, Change Management, or Enterprise SaaS adoption.

  • Experience leading enterprise technology adoption or digital transformation initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, AI technologies, organisational change management, and customer success methodologies.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, facilitate cross-functional collaboration, and communicate complex concepts to both technical and business audiences.

  • Experience using adoption metrics and analytics to measure customer success and business outcomes.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and executive leadership teams.

  • Private Medical & Dental insurance, covered at 100% for you and dependents

  • Life assurance and Income Protection

  • Generous leave policies, including parental leave, medical leave, and compassionate leave

  • Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) phone use

  • Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

  • And most importantly, the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

  • 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)

  • Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

  • And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

3aadd384847ce5fd.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

 

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. 3c398e871156b209.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Libraries
3c398e871156b209.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our AI Platform Team

Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.

 

🙌 You should apply if

You have deep Python expertise and a proven track record of leading the design, delivery and long-term evolution of high-quality software systems at scale. You can turn complex requirements across ML teams into stable, reusable libraries and clear APIs, set technical direction, and raise the bar for software architecture, testing and observability. You remain hands-on while guiding other engineers and driving projects end to end, from shaping requirements through to adoption and maintenance. Experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing is important; familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a Staff-level software and platform engineering role, not an ML modelling position.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Recruiter screen

  • Competency Interviews

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

d0be999ed3d84456.title: Compliance Manager - Credit
d0be999ed3d84456.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Pillar Labs Ltd is LemFi's regulated credit entity, and this is its core compliance hire. You'll sit inside a small, growing second-line function, reporting directly to the Compliance Lead and MLRO (SMF16/SMF17). The role spans the full width of a consumer credit business: day-to-day conduct oversight, financial crime, Consumer Duty, financial promotions, FCA returns and deputy MLRO cover. It's broad by design, because the function is lean and the business is building.


This is a hands-on role with real visibility. You'll give practical regulatory advice to Customer Support, Collections and Complaints, review and approve customer-facing content before it goes live, carry out first review of financial crime escalations and internal SARs, and prepare the MI that lands in front of the Board and ExCo. You'll also work directly with the SMF16/17 on new product launches, regulatory change and FCA engagement. If you want to own a wide brief in a business you can actually see growing, this is it.

What you'll build and own

  • Deliver day-to-day second-line oversight across complaints handling (DISP), collections and arrears (CONC 7) and customer support, reporting findings and themes to the SMF16/17

  • Review and approve all customer-facing content before it goes live: marketing, app journeys, servicing emails, arrears communications and partner promotions, assessed against the financial promotions rules, Consumer Duty and the CAP Code

  • Act as deputy MLRO: carry out first review of financial crime alerts, escalations and internal SARs, prepare them for MLRO decision, and cover MLRO duties when needed

  • Run Consumer Duty outcomes monitoring and testing, including vulnerable customer identification and support, and prepare the Board and ExCo MI pack

  • Prepare scheduled FCA returns and ad hoc data requests ready for sign-off, and maintain the compliance breach log, issues log and actions tracker

  • Carry out day-to-day oversight of third parties, including vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring (IARs)

  • Support the SMF16/17 on new product and product change reviews, regulatory change projects and the firm's financial crime framework, using AI tooling to move faster on drafting, analysis and QA

Your experience

  • 3 or more years in a compliance role at an FCA-regulated firm, with direct exposure to consumer credit products

  • Hands-on financial crime experience: reviewing alerts and escalations, drafting or reviewing internal SARs, and solid working knowledge of POCA and the Money Laundering Regulations

  • Practical experience reviewing and approving financial promotions and customer-facing communications against the FCA rules

  • Working knowledge of Consumer Duty and DISP complaints handling, with experience running second-line oversight or QA of complaints, collections or customer support

  • Comfortable preparing written reports and MI for senior stakeholders, and giving clear, practical regulatory advice to first-line teams under time pressure

  • At ease working in a lean team where you pick up the brief early, work through ambiguity and get things done without a large support structure around you

Nice to have

  • Experience acting as deputy MLRO or nominated officer cover, and familiarity with vulnerable customer frameworks and Consumer Duty outcomes testing

  • Experience of FCA regulatory returns, outsourcing oversight (IARs) and CONC in a fintech or fast-growing credit business

  • A relevant qualification such as the ICA Certificate or Diploma in Compliance or Anti Money Laundering


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

5ad338e45a0a1952.title: Manager, Payments/Scheme Economics
5ad338e45a0a1952.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance.

  • Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules.

  • Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics.

  • Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions.

  • Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

  • Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

Role Overview

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. To support our global operations and ensure nuanced, localized oversight, we are looking for dedicated, in-region sanctions specialists across EMEA/UK.

In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly translate complex regional regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements across the business and multiple geographies.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an in-region Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject.

  • Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

  • Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

  • Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

  • Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

  • Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

  • Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

  • Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

  • Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

  • History of assessing current sanctions frameworks and recommending enhancements to strengthen the program, including designing and scaling sanctions programs.

  • Demonstrated understanding of in-region sanctions regulations and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of US sanctions in addition to in-region expertise is strongly preferred.

  • History of executing the operationalization of sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, adhering to global policies, in-region procedures, and risk appetite.

  • A history of interacting or supporting engagement with external stakeholders such as regulators or financial institution partners on sanctions matters.

  • Expert knowledge of financial and trade sanctions within the European Union (EU) framework and UK regulations administered by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) and corresponding export control bodies.

  • Strong understanding of the EU/UK Blocking Statute and how to navigate conflicting regulatory obligations within European jurisdictions and the UK.

About the Role

We hire builders with founder-level energy—people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do.

As Director, Regulatory Compliance (UK), you will serve as the senior compliance authority and strategic partner for Airwallex’s rapidly expanding UK presence. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) supervised by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Airwallex requires compliance leadership that sees regulatory integrity not as a roadblock, but as a critical commercial enabler and competitive differentiator.

In this role, you will lead our UK compliance framework, serve as the primary interface with local regulators and industry bodies, and work cross-functionally across Product, Strategy, Commercial, and Operations to safely launch cutting-edge payment infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UK Regulatory Compliance: Lead a UK-based team of regulatory compliance professionals; own and continuously evolve the UK compliance management system, policies, registers, and operational controls to ensure ongoing compliance with FCA handbooks, PSRs, EMRs, and UK AML/CTF regimes.

  • Drive FCA Engagement: Act as the principal point of contact for the FCA, handling regulatory inquiries, notifications, audits, thematic reviews, and routine reporting with transparency and authority.

  • Product & Commercial Advisory: Partner early with Product, Commercial, and International Expansion teams to design compliant-by-default cross-border payment, issuing, acquiring, and embedded finance architectures.

  • Safeguarding & Governance: Oversee compliance aspects of key UK regulatory regimes including safeguardingand Consumer Duty in close partnership with Finance, Risk, Product, and other teams.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor domestic and international regulatory developments (e.g., Consumer Duty, operational resilience, PSR APP fraud reimbursement schemes) and proactively translate emerging rules into pragmatic technical and operational roadmaps.

  • Team Leadership & Culture: Build, coach, and scale a high-caliber UK compliance advisory and operations team while fostering a company-wide culture of risk accountability and ethical rigor.

  • Board & Committee Reporting: Prepare and deliver clear, actionable regulatory compliance reporting and key risk indicator (KRI) updates to executive leadership, local operating boards, and audit/risk committees.

What We’re Looking For

Essentials

  • 10+ years of regulatory compliance experience within UK fintech, payment services (EMIs/APIs), neo-banking, or modern global financial institutions.

  • Leadership Track Record: At least 4+ years managing and developing high-performing compliance teams in high-growth environments.

  • Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Expert grasp of UK financial regulations, including the Payment Services Regulations (PSRs), Electronic Money Regulations (EMRs), FCA Principles for Businesses, and Consumer Duty standards.

  • FCA Interface Experience: Direct track record of managing formal regulator relationships, supervisory inspections, or key authorization filings with the FCA.

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements through a first-principles lens, providing creative, commercial, and defensible paths forward.

  • Executive Presence: Strong communication, negotiation, and written advocacy skills capable of influencing board members, executive partners, and external regulatory bodies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience holding an approved person / Senior Management Function (SMF) role under the FCA regime.

  • Background handling regulatory aspects of cross-border multi-currency schemes, merchant acquiring, or credit/lending adjacencies.

  • Relevant legal qualification or industry certifications (e.g., ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk & Compliance).

You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You own the outcome: You don't wait for permission to solve structural bottlenecks—give you a complex regulatory challenge, and you chart the solution.

  • You’re commercially astute: You understand that compliance is an enabler of sustainable hyper-growth, not an isolated checklist.

  • You balance technical precision with plain-English clarity: You can dissect statutory instruments line by line, then distill the essence clearly for engineers, sales leads, and executives.

  • You’re not precious about traditional playbooks: You push hard from first principles, challenging legacy banking compliance norms with modernized, technology-driven solutions.

  • You value in-person collaboration: You thrive working shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional leaders in our London hub.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a comprehensive assessment of our existing UK compliance controls, policies, and FCA commitments; build alignment with key UK commercial leads and partner banks.

  • Within 6 Months: Streamline product approval compliance workflows; enhance local risk governance reporting; and lead strategic readiness for any pending UK regulatory changes.

  • Within 12 Months: Institutionalize a top-tier UK compliance function that scales seamlessly with transaction volume and new market offerings while maintaining an immaculate standing with the FCA.

Why Join Airwallex

  • Competitive base salary, performance incentives, and meaningful equity.

  • High autonomy to build, scale, and influence the core infrastructure powering the global digital economy.

  • Comprehensive health, wellness, pension, and parental leave coverage.

  • Dynamic, global culture with clear paths for rapid professional development.

502e82bfed7e253f.title: Content & Growth Marketer
502e82bfed7e253f.description:
About Tradeaze

Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live.

The role

You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it.

What you will do

  • Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office
  • Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch
  • Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design
  • Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches
  • Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good
  • Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand

Who you are

  • Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it
  • You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours.
  • You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional
  • You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follower will stop for
  • You already use AI in your work. You can show us something you shipped with it and talk us through how you use it
  • You've taken a campaign from the idea to launch: the message, the words and the design
  • You come to a conversation with ideas and you enjoy bouncing them off someone
  • You're personable: comfortable with sales reps, a room full of branch managers, and sitting with a merchant head office's marketing team to run a joint campaign
  • You'd rather get it live this week and improve it than plan it for a month
  • Nice to have: paid ads (you've run paid social or search with a budget), events (you've helped run a trade show stand) and email copy (you've written emails that get people to take one clear action)

Not for you if:

  • You want a brief handed to you
  • You need an agency to make things
  • You'd rather plan than ship

How we work

You will report to our GTM Engineer, and you both report to Jack, our CEO. You will work with the GTM Engineer day to day. They own the systems: the CRM, the email platform, the data and the sends. You own the message and the content. You will plan together, brainstorm together, and look at the numbers together every Monday. Jack opens the door with merchant head offices; you and the GTM Engineer run what happens next.

You will see your work on a live dashboard: what shipped, what it reached, and which branches ordered because of it.

What you get

  • £40k to £48k
  • Stock options
  • 25 days holiday
  • A laptop

How to apply

With your application, send us:

  1. 3 to 5 pieces of content you made yourself, ideally including one video you filmed and cut yourself (a phone is fine). Other examples: a social post or carousel, a campaign from idea to launch, a printed piece, a case study. For each one, a line on what you did and what it led to
  2. A few lines on how you use AI: which tools, for what, and one thing it let you ship

How we will hire

  1. Send us 3 to 5 pieces you made and a few lines on how you work with AI
  2. A call with Jack, our CEO
  3. A short campaign task, then a call with our GTM Engineer to talk it through
  4. Present your idea to the team in person: the same idea, updated with what you'd change. 15 minutes, no new deck needed

f58427ba95037d7e.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:


Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

  • Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality


Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it
